articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文作為指南，針對如何改善閱讀習慣提供了具體的實作建議。

articles.title: Alex Imas and Phil Trammell – What remains scarce after AGI?
articles.summary_en: This discussion explores the long-term economic implications of AGI, specifically identifying human-centric services and physical constraints as the primary sources of lingering scarcity. By contrasting scalable robotic production with non-scalable human roles, the authors analyze which sectors will remain premium in an automated future.
articles.summary_zh: 這場對談探討了通用人工智慧 (AGI) 對長期經濟的影響，指出以人為本的服務與物理限制將成為未來稀缺資源的主要來源。透過對比可規模化的機器人製造與難以複製的人類角色，作者分析了在自動化未來中哪些領域仍具備核心價值。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content focuses on theoretical economic concepts and the conceptual nature of post-AGI resource scarcity.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該內容側重於探討經濟學理論概念，以及通用人工智慧時代資源稀缺性的觀念分析。

articles.title: How Long Does It Take to Plan a Bridge?
articles.summary_en: This article explores the growing perception that infrastructure projects in the United States are taking significantly longer to complete than in the past. It initiates a deeper investigation into the factors contributing to these extended timelines in modern construction.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了美國基礎建設項目耗時日益增長的普遍現象。作者旨在深入分析導致現代工程建設週期延長背後的各項因素。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on explaining the phenomenon of delayed infrastructure projects and setting the stage for a conceptual investigation.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文旨在探討基礎建設項目延遲這一現象，並為後續的概念性分析奠定基礎。

articles.title: gittuf - a signed log for git refs
articles.summary_en: The article discusses the vulnerabilities of current git hosting platforms, where branch protection and security policies reside on the forge rather than within the git repository itself. It highlights historical security incidents, such as the PHP and Gentoo compromises, to demonstrate why forge-managed security can be easily bypassed or exploited.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了現有 Git 代管平台的脆弱性，指出分支保護與安全策略依賴於代管平台而非 Git 儲存庫本身。透過分析 PHP 和 Gentoo 等歷史安全事件，作者說明了這種將安全管控託付給代管平台的模式容易被繞過或惡意利用。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual analysis of the security architecture of git hosting platforms and the inherent risks of relying on forge-level enforcement.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文對 Git 代管平台的安全架構進行了概念性分析，並探討了依賴平台層級強制執行的潛在風險。

articles.title: "Sixteenth of a year", a 1.8 KiB art piece
articles.summary_en: The author shares a 1.8 KiB digital art piece created for Taper magazine that divides time into sixteenths. The project uses simple date math and custom minification to explore the passage of time through code.
articles.summary_zh: 作者分享了一件為 Taper 雜誌創作的 1.8 KiB 數位藝術作品，透過將時間劃分為十六分之一來呈現。該作品利用基礎的日期運算與自訂代碼壓縮技術，探索了時間流逝的不同視角。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the conceptual approach behind a creative coding project rather than providing a tutorial or raw data.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文主要闡述創意程式設計專案背後的概念發想，而非教學指南或數據分析。

articles.title: The Latin of Linux
articles.summary_en: This article draws a parallel between learning Latin and understanding Linux, noting that both act as foundational languages for modern systems. By studying the roots of these systems, users can better comprehend the vocabulary and structures that permeate their respective fields.
articles.summary_zh: 本文將學習拉丁語與理解 Linux 進行了類比，指出兩者都是現代系統的基礎語言。通過研究這些系統的根源，使用者可以更深入地理解各自領域中常見的術語與結構。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the analogy of Latin as an ancestral language to explain the foundational importance of understanding Linux architecture.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文使用拉丁語作為祖語的類比，來解釋理解 Linux 架構的基礎重要性。

articles.title: Integrating smooth periodic functions
articles.summary_en: This post examines the properties of the smooth, periodic function f(x) = cos(sin(x) + x). It highlights the function's unique behavior, specifically its flatness at odd multiples of π where the first five derivatives vanish.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了週期性平滑函數 f(x) = cos(sin(x) + x) 的特性。文中重點介紹了該函數在 π 的奇數倍處呈現極度平坦的現象，即其前五階導數皆為零。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the mathematical properties and behavior of a specific function, focusing on conceptual analysis.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文解釋了特定函數的數學性質與行為，側重於概念性的分析。

articles.title: Partitions over permutations
articles.summary_en: The author examines the behavior of a cosine-based Gaussian approximation, noting that while it works well along the real axis, it diverges significantly along the imaginary axis. The discussion explores mathematical properties and the limitations of such approximations.
articles.summary_zh: 作者探討了一個基於餘弦函數的高斯近似式，指出該式在實數軸上表現良好，但在虛數軸上卻會產生顯著的誤差。文章進一步分析了這類數學近似的特性與其局限性。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on explaining the behavior and theoretical limitations of a specific mathematical approximation.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文重點在於解釋特定數學近似式的運作行為及其理論上的侷限性。

articles.title: Rotation revisited: A shocking discovery about gcc’s unidirectional rotation algorithm
articles.summary_en: This post revisits a technical analysis of the GCC compiler's bitwise rotation implementation. It explores how the compiler optimizes unidirectional rotation operations and addresses unexpected behaviors found in the generated machine code.
articles.summary_zh: 本文重新檢視了 GCC 編譯器在處理位元旋轉（bitwise rotation）運算時的實作機制。作者探討了編譯器如何優化單向旋轉指令，並分析了在生成的機器碼中發現的技術細節與潛在問題。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post provides a technical analysis and specific investigation into compiler behavior, functioning as evidence-based discovery.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供了針對編譯器行為的技術分析與深入調查，屬於基於實證發現的內容。

articles.title: Giving your Go apps Tigris superpowers
articles.summary_en: This article explores how to integrate Tigris into Go applications to enhance their functionality. It provides a guide on leveraging Tigris features within the Go ecosystem to improve database operations.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討如何將 Tigris 整合至 Go 應用程式中以增強其功能。文中提供了如何在 Go 生態系統中使用 Tigris 特性來改善資料庫操作的指引。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on the practical implementation and integration of Tigris within Go applications, acting as a technical guide.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文側重於 Tigris 在 Go 應用程式中的實際實作與整合，屬於技術指南性質。

articles.title: IPv6 zones in URLs are a mistake
articles.summary_en: The article critiques the design of IPv6 address representation in URLs, specifically the inclusion of zone identifiers. It warns developers to avoid dealing with these identifiers due to their inherent complexity and potential for implementation errors.
articles.summary_zh: 本文批判了 IPv6 位址在網址（URL）中加入區域識別碼（zone identifiers）的設計方式。作者建議開發人員盡量避免處理這些識別碼，以免陷入技術陷阱與實作困難。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article presents a critical conceptual argument regarding the architectural flaws of network addressing standards.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對網路定址標準的架構缺陷，提出了一種概念性的批判與論述。

articles.title: Book Review: Accessible Communications by Lisa Riemers and Matisse Hamel-Nelis ★★★★★
articles.summary_en: This book review highlights a practical guide to creating accessible communications written by Lisa Riemers and Matisse Hamel-Nelis. The book balances theoretical frameworks and legal requirements with actionable advice for making information accessible to everyone.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇書評介紹了由 Lisa Riemers 與 Matisse Hamel-Nelis 合著的無障礙傳播指南。該書不僅涵蓋了理論基礎、法律規範與商業案例，更提供了實用的操作建議，協助讀者製作人人可用的資訊內容。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content serves as a review of a conceptual work that explains the 'what' and 'why' behind accessible communications.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文是對一本概念性著作的書評，旨在解釋無障礙傳播的內涵與重要性。

articles.title: Pluralistic: Delusion as a service (04 Jun 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: Cory Doctorow uses the example of Disney's 'Mission: Space' ride to illustrate how extreme systems can reveal latent vulnerabilities in individuals who would otherwise remain healthy. The post reflects on systemic risk, arguing that mass-scale infrastructure acts as a diagnostic tool that exposes hidden, potentially dangerous flaws.
articles.summary_zh: Cory Doctorow 以迪士尼的「太空任務」遊樂設施為例，探討極端系統如何揭露個體隱而未顯的潛在脆弱性。文中透過此案例反思系統性風險，指出大規模基礎設施往往成為一種診斷工具，進而觸發原本隱藏且危險的隱患。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the analogy of a high-intensity centrifuge ride to explain broader concepts of systemic vulnerability and catastrophic failure.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章透過高強度離心力遊樂設施的比喻，來闡釋更廣泛的系統性脆弱與災難性失效等概念。

articles.title: Quoting Emanuel Maiberg, 404 Media
articles.summary_en: This post highlights a change in Google's internal messaging regarding AI, specifically the removal of a commitment to keeping humans in the loop. It draws attention to a 404 Media report about internal employee dissatisfaction with Google's current AI performance.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章指出了 Google 在人工智慧政策敘述上的調整，特別是刪除了有關「保持人為介入」的承諾。文中並引用了 404 Media 的報導，揭示了 Google 內部員工對現有 AI 效能的不滿。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content acts as evidence or reporting on corporate behavior and internal AI development culture.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該內容作為企業行為與內部人工智慧開發文化的報導證據。

articles.title: Anti-AI nostalgia and the cult of the past
articles.summary_en: This article examines the growing cultural trend of anti-AI nostalgia, exploring why society often romanticizes the past in the face of rapid technological change. It critiques the ideological reliance on human tradition as a benchmark for authenticity in creative and intellectual pursuits.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了日益興起的反人工智慧懷舊情緒，分析了社會為何在面對技術快速變革時傾向於美化過去。文章批判了在追求創意與智力活動時，過度將人類傳統視為評判真實性之唯一標準的意識形態。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article is a conceptual critique that explores themes of cultural philosophy and technological evolution.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文屬於概念性評論，探討了文化哲學與技術演變的相關議題。

articles.title: Is datacentre sovereignty really that important?
articles.summary_en: The article critically evaluates the UK's push for domestic AI datacentres. It argues that common justifications like latency, taxation, and sovereignty are largely unsupported by technical and economic realities.
articles.summary_zh: 本文批判性地評估了英國推動建設本土AI數據中心的趨勢。作者認為，關於數據主權的常見論點，如延遲、稅收與控制權，在現實層面大多缺乏足夠的說服力。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article presents a conceptual argument challenging the prevailing political and economic theories surrounding data sovereignty.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提出了一項概念性論點，挑戰了圍繞數據主權的現行政治與經濟理論。

articles.title: Welcoming the Philippine Government to Have I Been Pwned
articles.summary_en: The Philippine government has joined the Have I Been Pwned (HIBP) free government service. The National CERT and the Department of Information and Communications Technology will now use the platform to monitor official domains for data breaches.
articles.summary_zh: 菲律賓政府正式加入「Have I Been Pwned」的免費政府服務計畫。菲律賓國家電腦緊急應變小組（CERT）與資通訊科技部將利用該平台監控官方網域，以即時掌握資安外洩風險。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article reports on a specific event and the implementation of a security service as a case of adoption.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文報導了具體的合作事件，說明政府機關採用該安全服務的實例。

articles.title: A survey of inlining heuristics
articles.summary_en: This article explores the fundamental role of inlining in just-in-time compilers for dynamic languages like Ruby. It explains how inlining serves as a critical optimization lever to reduce method call overhead and memory traffic, enabling further compiler optimizations.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了動態語言（如 Ruby）的即時編譯器中，「內聯（inlining）」技術的核心作用。文章解釋了內聯如何作為關鍵的優化手段，以減少方法呼叫開銷與記憶體存取，從而為編譯器進行後續優化鋪路。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual explanation of why inlining is necessary for compiler optimization in dynamic languages.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章針對動態語言編譯器中為何需要「內聯」技術提供了概念性的解釋與說明。

articles.title: Skills Registry Threat Models
articles.summary_en: This article explores the security threat models associated with AI agent skills registries, which distribute prompts, scripts, and dependencies. It highlights how these registries inherit risks from traditional package managers while introducing new vulnerabilities like prompt injection and uncontrolled code execution.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了人工智慧代理技能註冊表的安全威脅模型，這些註冊表負責分發提示詞、腳本和依賴項。文章強調這些註冊表不僅繼承了傳統軟體套件管理器的風險，還引入了提示詞注入和不受控代碼執行等新漏洞。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a theoretical analysis and conceptual breakdown of the security landscape and threat models for AI agent registries.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對 AI 代理註冊表的安全態勢與威脅模型提供了理論分析與概念性的剖析。

articles.title: Naively summing an alternating series
articles.summary_en: This article explores the pitfalls of naively summing alternating power series, such as the exponential function, using standard floating-point arithmetic. It highlights how stop conditions based on term tolerance can lead to significant precision errors due to catastrophic cancellation and inherent numerical instability.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了使用標準浮點運算來計算交錯級數（如指數函數）時，常見的誤差問題。作者指出，僅以項的數值大小作為停止條件，會因災難性抵銷與數值不穩定性而導致顯著的計算錯誤。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post functions as a technical case study demonstrating the failures of specific computational methods through numerical examples.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章作為技術案例研究，透過數值範例具體展示了特定計算方法可能產生的失敗結果。

articles.title: Rotation revisited: Another unidirectional algorithm
articles.summary_en: This post revisits the topic of rotation algorithms by introducing an alternative unidirectional method for moving in a straight line. It continues the ongoing technical series on programming patterns found in 'The Old New Thing'.
articles.summary_zh: 本文重新探討了旋轉演算法，並介紹了一種用於直線移動的替代性單向方法。這是《The Old New Thing》部落格中關於程式設計模式系列文章的延續。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on a specific programming algorithm and its implementation method.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這篇文章專注於特定的程式設計演算法及其實現方法。

articles.title: London Data Store Relaunch
articles.summary_en: The London Data Store has undergone a significant modernization sixteen years after its initial launch. This update includes both back-end infrastructure improvements and a front-end refresh to better serve the city's open data mission.
articles.summary_zh: 倫敦數據儲存庫（London Data Store）在成立十六年後進行了重大更新。此次改版涵蓋了後端架構升級與前端介面優化，旨在持續推動開放數據的應用並改善市民生活。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post provides a conceptual overview and background information regarding the platform's update and evolution.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章提供了關於平台更新與演變的概念性概述與背景資訊。

articles.title: Now that your newsletter is AI-generated, I've Unsubscribed
articles.source: Software and Tech stories from an Insider - iDiallo.com
articles.summary_en: The author argues that readers subscribe to newsletters for the authentic human voice and personal experience, not just information. They explain why AI-generated content often erodes trust and fails to provide the genuine connection that human-written stories offer.
articles.summary_zh: 作者認為讀者訂閱電子報是為了追求真實的人性觀點與個人經驗，而不僅僅是獲取資訊。文章指出 AI 生成的內容往往會破壞讀者信任，無法提供與人類作者之間那種真誠的連結。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article is a conceptual critique exploring the value of human authorship versus AI-generated content.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這是一篇概念性評論，探討了人類作者身份相對於 AI 生成內容的價值。

articles.title: Uber Caps Usage of AI Tools Like Claude Code to Manage Costs
articles.summary_en: Uber has implemented a $1,500 monthly spending cap per AI coding tool for its engineers to control skyrocketing costs. The author analyzes this policy, noting that it represents a significant investment of roughly 11% of an engineer's median total compensation.
articles.summary_zh: Uber 為控制急劇上升的 AI 使用成本，已對員工使用 Claude Code 等 AI 編碼工具設下每月 1,500 美元的預算上限。作者分析認為這是一項合理的政策，並指出這筆開支約佔工程師平均總薪資的 11%。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses current company data and budget figures to provide evidence of how enterprises are adjusting to the high costs of AI agents.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文引用了具體的企業數據與預算金額，展示了企業如何應對 AI 代理高昂的使用成本，具有實證分析性質。

articles.title: datasette-agent-micropython 0.1a0
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison has released an alpha version of datasette-agent-micropython, a tool designed to allow Datasette Agent to execute Python code safely within a sandbox. articles.pacer_reason_en: The post functions as a release announcement for a software project and reports on the initial testing/performance of its sandboxing capabilities.

articles.title: micropython-wasm 0.1a1
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison has released micropython-wasm version 0.1a1. This update includes fixes for limitations encountered during the development of datasette-agent-micropython.

articles.pacer_reason_en: The post serves as a release announcement and reference for a specific software version update.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章作為軟體版本更新的發布公告與參考資訊。

articles.title: micropython-wasm 0.1a0
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison has released an alpha version of micropython-wasm, which bundles a customized MicroPython build for WebAssembly. This tool allows users to execute Python code within a sandboxed environment using the wasmtime runtime.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 發布了 micropython-wasm 的 alpha 版本，該工具將自定義的 MicroPython 構建封裝為 WebAssembly。它允許開發者透過 wasmtime 運行時在沙盒環境中執行 Python 程式碼。

articles.title: I went on the Built for Turbulence podcast
articles.summary_en: Martin Alderson discusses the shifting economics of software in the age of AI agents. He highlights the risks of executing human-written code without AI audits and explores the implications of the 'Figma Trap' on software development.
articles.summary_zh: Martin Alderson 在節目中探討了 AI 代理如何改變軟體經濟學。他強調了在沒有 AI 審核的情況下執行人工編寫代碼的風險，並分析了「Figma 陷阱」對軟體開發的影響。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content focuses on explaining concepts and theories regarding the future of software development and AI economics.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該內容側重於解釋關於軟體開發未來與 AI 經濟學的概念與理論。

articles.title: An Ode to the Exacting Pedantry of Computers
articles.summary_en: The author reflects on how computers traditionally demanded extreme precision and pedantic logic, which forced developers to think critically about their designs. articles.title: Resurfacing posts
articles.content_snippet:
One of the things I like best about blogs is that posts stick around (or at least they should). I enjoy scrolling through historic posts of bloggers and reading about what they were thinking about 1, 5, or even 10 years ago—if I'm lucky.
I've noticed that my most recent posts get the more attention than the rest of my blog. This makes sense, as I have the most recent 5 posts on my homepage, alongside the fact that newer posts go out to my email subscribers and are more likely to find themselves on link aggregators, Twitter feeds, and RSS readers.
I'd like to take this opportunity to resurface some posts you may have missed, or may enjoy revisiting. I also encourage you, if you happen to be a blogger, to do the same. There's so much great writing buried by more recent posts that could do with some additional attention. This is also the reason I've added a Random tab to the discovery feed.
I recently got back from a month-long trip to Japan where Emma and I visited some of the big cities, but spent most of our time in rural Japan and hiked a well-preserved portion of the Nakasendo trail. While in Japan, I had the privilege of meeting up with some bloggers: Seio for some tea in a lovely old tea house in Tokyo, and Daiki for some delicious okonomiyaki in Kyoto. Thanks to both of you!
With that in mind, I'd like to resurface the post Yes, I will have coffee with you where I invite people to meet up with me, if we happen to be in the same city. I love meeting new people, and enjoy the opportunity to share my city, or take part in theirs.

articles.title: CHAOSS Metrics in 2026
articles.content_snippet:
The CHAOSS project has spent the last eight years writing down careful, implementation-agnostic definitions for the things people measure about open source projects: how many issues get opened, how long they take to close, how many distinct people commit, how stale the dependencies are. The point of writing them down is that two dashboards computing “issue response time” should at least be computing the same thing, and the released metric set has become the closest thing the field has to a shared vocabulary.
Most of those definitions were drafted between roughly 2018 and 2023, against a background where contributions were produced at human speed, security advisories arrived a few times a year per ecosystem, and a maintainer who stopped maintaining usually stopped committing too. All three of those conditions are changing, and a lot of the metric definitions encode them without saying so. The common thread is that most of the catalogue counts repository events, and event counts were informative because producing an event used to cost a person something. An issue cost someone ten minutes to write up, a PR cost someone an afternoon. That cost is being removed from one side of the interaction and not the other, so the counts increasingly measure how much of the cheap thing is being pointed at a project rather than anything about the community behind it.
I went through the current released set, in roughly the order the catalogue groups them, and tried to sort out which metrics depend most on those assumptions. This is the same territory as The Mismeasure of Open Source and Centrality is not vitality, but applied to a specific published metric set rather than to research practice in general.

Object permanence: Manuscript rabbits; "What Will Come After"; Pastejacking; Terrorism phrenology; Vaccine waivers were promised 20 years ago. Upcoming appearances: London, Kansas City, LA, Menlo Park, Toronto, NYC, Edinburgh. Recent appearances: Where I've been. Latest books: You keep readin' em, I'll keep writin' 'em. Upcoming books: Like I said, I'll keep writin' 'em. Colophon: All the rest. AI and a world without migrants (permalink) I don't care who you are, there will always be times when hell is other people. Not because other people are horrible – quite the opposite! Other people are wonderful, but boy are they ever stubborn. From boardgames to romance, team sports to movement politics, business ideas to construction projects, there's so much important, enjoyable and essential stuff you can't do alone. But other people insist on having their own priorities and goals, and they mulishly refuse to organize their lives to suit your priorities. Our species has put a lot of work into resolving this conundrum. Not only did we evolve a whole brain structure – the neocortex – that helps us understand others' perspectives, but we also evolved many social structures (like laws and teams and governments and families and committees and bureaucracies) to help us coordinate with others to do superhuman things (that is, things that exceed the capacity of a single human). These structures are imperfect, but they're better than the alternative: coercion. Persuading others is not without its pitfalls, but compared to forcing others to bend to your will, "persuasion" is the hands-down favorite. Not for everyone, though. articles.title: How Many Tokens Did You Burn Today
articles.source: Software and Tech stories from an Insider - iDiallo.com
articles.content_snippet:
Early in my career, a manager at one of the big firms where I worked made a request so absurd it remains etched in my memory. I walked back to the team, repeated what he had asked, and couldn't finish the story without laughing. He wanted me to create a pie chart, of lines of code, per developer, per week.
We all lost it. Our lead developer asked if, by any chance, the manager's eyes looked glassy. We laughed even harder. Because yes. Yes, they did. He was always high.
That was twenty years ago. I've repeated that story countless times, and it always drew chuckles as we discussed the disconnect between software teams and management. Any software engineer could relate. We all knew that lines of code were a meaningless metric. A junior could write a thousand lines of spaghetti. A senior could fix the same problem with forty elegant ones.
But then, last week, I found my name at the top of a leaderboard.
My employer had been exploring productivity tools and trialed one they thought would be useful. After the trial, they were quoted $500k a year. The tool tracked developer productivity and integrated with Atlassian products, Microsoft, and many other services we used. The price was too steep, so it was dropped. A couple of months later, the same company came back with a discount. The exact same tool for just $50k a year. My employer jumped at the opportunity.
How many bytes did you use today?
I'm looking at this dashboard right now and I see my name at the top of the leaderboard. I click on the widget, and a pie chart appears. There it is: a breakdown of the total lines of code my team has produced using AI, by individual.
This isn't limited to my employer. Every company is putting something together to track AI usage and justify the investment. Instead of tracking project completions, we're tracking how many lines of code each developer generated with AI. And the joke's on me, because nobody is laughing. articles.title: The pressure
articles.content_snippet:
The pressure

Daniel Stenberg on the unprecedented level of pressure the curl team are facing right now thanks to the deluge of (credible) AI-assisted security issues being reported.

The rate of incoming security reports is 4-5 times higher than it was in 2024 and double the speed of 2025 -- meaning that on average we now get more than one report per day. The quality is way higher than ever before. The reports are typically very detailed and long. [...]

For the first time in my life, my wife voiced concerns about my work hours and my imbalanced work/life situation. I work more than I’ve done before, but the flood keeps coming. [...]

This is a never-before seen or experienced pressure on the curl project and its security team members. An avalanche of high priority work that trumps all other things in the project that is primarily mental because we certainly could ignore them all if we wanted, but we feel a responsibility, we have a conscience and we are proud about our work.

The good news is that curl is a very solid piece of software, so the vulnerabilities people are finding tend not to be of high severity:

What is also a good trend: almost no one finds terrible vulnerabilities. All vulnerabilities found the last few years in curl have all been deemed severity LOW or MEDIUM. I'm not saying there won't be any more HIGH ever, but at least they are rare. The most recent severity high curl CVE was published in October 2023.

Via Lobste.rs

It's been around since 1991, and is still updated today—in fact, the two latest updates (version 509 and 510) contain patches I sent in to get iozone to compile on Apple Silicon Macs running newer releases of macOS.

articles.title: Copying Remote Command Output to Your macOS Clipboard
articles.content_snippet:
I use Apple devices very often. Overall, I like macOS. Certainly more than Windows.
One of the things I find extremely useful is a command I discovered not too long ago: pbcopy.
pbcopy can be used to copy to the clipboard whatever it receives from standard input. For example, when I am in a shell, I often use a command like this:
cat filename.md | pbcopy

At that point I know that the content of the file is in the clipboard, and I can paste it wherever I need, calmly and without any additional steps.
There is one limitation, though: this only works locally. It works when I am using my Mac and I want to copy something from the macOS shell.
When I connect to a remote (*BSD, Linux, illumos based) server via ssh, pbcopy is not available. Or, more precisely, even if I create a command with the same name on the server, that command cannot directly talk to the clipboard of my Mac in the usual way.
Luckily, modern terminal emulators have a few tricks available.
I use iTerm2 for most of my ssh sessions and, once I realised how useful it would be to have something similar to pbcopy in remote sessions too, I created a small script that works both on Linux, the BSDs and illumox based OSes. 
The caveat is that the remote server cannot "magically" access the clipboard of my Mac. So the trick works because the remote command prints a special terminal escape sequence, and the local terminal emulator interprets it.
The sequence is called OSC 52. In short, it allows a program running inside the terminal to ask the terminal emulator to put some base64-encoded text into the local clipboard. This means that support depends on the terminal emulator I am using locally.
I use iTerm2, which supports OSC 52. Other terminal emulators support it too, so the idea is not tied exclusively to iTerm2. However, Apple's default Terminal.app does not appear to support OSC 52, so I would not expect this specific solution to work there.
So, in practice:

articles.title: Clanker: A Word For The Machine
articles.content_snippet:
In my last post I used the word “clanker” as an
alternative to “agent” quite consistently and probably excessively.  That choice
ended up attracting a lot more attention than I expected in the Hacker News
comment section of that post and a number of folks had a very strong reaction:
to them it sounded like a slur, in one case even something adjacent to the
n-word.
That reaction surprised me somewhat, but it also made me realize that I should
write down what I mean by the word for future reference.
For me “clanker” is useful because it creates distance from the machine and that
is a quality which is important to me.  The machine is not a person, not a
co-worker, not a friend, not a little spirit in the terminal. It is just a
machine, a tool, and nothing more.
Why Not Agent?
I dislike the word “agent” for these LLM based tool loops with a UI attached.
In everyday use an agent is someone who acts on behalf of someone else and it
has agency and more importantly: responsibility.  An agent decides, represents,
negotiates, acts, and can be blamed.  In the current AI discourse we
increasingly do a lot of anthropomorphizing and the term “agent” is now
frequently being used to put blame on an abstract machine.  But the machine
cannot be responsible, whoever is wielding it is.  If it drops your
database
it was not at fault, you were.
Agent makes the machine sound like a person with delegated authority and I do
not think that is healthy.
What we actually have is a language model attached to a harness, a prompt, some
tools, a bit of context, and a boring tool loop.  Sometimes the loop is very
capable and it surprises us by editing code for a really long time and produce
genuinely amazing and even valuable outputs.  But the agency is not in the model
or harness but in the human and in the organization that deployed it.  If my
coding tool opens a pull request, I opened that pull request, not the machine.
If my machine spams someone’s issue tracker, I spammed someone’s issue tracke

articles.title: Amber Alert sends Spam URL?
articles.content_snippet:
Well that was weird. I just received an Amber Alert and the link led to a spammy looking website. 
Spam?
The link leads to a 3gp file converter which is highly unusual. But the more I look at it, I have the impression it's a mistake. Most likely, they have exceeded the maximum number of characters for the Emergency Service alert.
Here is the message:
AN AMBER ALERT HAS BEEN ACTIVATED BY THE CALIFORNIA HIGHWAY PATROL. DALEZA FREGOSO WAS LAST SEEN ON MAY 24, 2026 AT 0400 HOURS IN LOS ANGELES COUNTY. THE SUSPECT VEHICLE IS A WHITE 2019 WHITE LAND ROVER DISCOVERY CA 9DAW715. CLICK ON THE LINK FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION. https://bit.ly/A0
It seems like the total character count is 288. I'm not sure if the title should be included but if I add Child abduction (Amber alert) and the double space after, then we have 320 characters. Is this the character limit for emergency services?
When I clicked on it, it took me to the bitly preview page:
And clicking on the continue to destination button, I'm taken here:
Suspicious Link
I was starting to wonder if this was even a real Amber alert, and if somehow this was a spam message that was sent through. But unfortunately, it is a real amber alert, as I was able to find the matching alert on missingkids.com. However, I don't see a way to request a correction.
I understand that bitly was often used to shorten links, but there should be a way for a service like amber alert to test those links before they are sent. At least on my android, once I click on the link, the alert is dismissed never to be seen again. When the link is incorrect, now we have this problem where we can never get the information back. In this case, I was only able to get the link because I received the alert on both my phones. 
Also I've learned that Amber alerts have a character limit of 360 characters. So I'm still not sure what went wrong with this one.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Cowork Exfiltrates Files
articles.content_snippet:
Microsoft Copilot Cowork Exfiltrates Files

The biggest challenge in designing agentic systems continues to be preventing them from enabling attackers to exfiltrate data.

In this case Microsoft Copilot Cowork (yes, that's a real product name) was allowing agents to send emails to the user's own inbox without approval... but those messages were then displayed in a way that could leak data to an attacker via rendered images:

Because these messages can contain external images that trigger network requests to external websites, data can be exfiltrated when a user opens a compromised message sent by the agent.

Since OneDrive can create pre-authenticated download links, a successful prompt injection could cause those links to be leaked, allowing files to be downloaded by the attacker.

Via Hacker News

articles.title: FediMeteo, timezones, and the art of not breaking what already works
articles.content_snippet:
I have already written about how FediMeteo was born, and about how HAProxy helps reduce the number of requests that reach snac.
Seen from the outside, FediMeteo almost seems still. There is a static homepage, regenerated every hour. There are the city pages, with their forecasts. There are RSS feeds waiting to be fetched, JSON objects waiting to be requested, Fediverse instances refreshing data, subscribing, unsubscribing, retrieving profiles, and reading notes.
That is the visible part.
Behind it, however, FediMeteo is much more than a homepage, a few ActivityPub accounts, and a well-behaved reverse proxy. It is a chain of small pieces, in proper Unix style, each trying to do one thing and do it as well as possible.
That chain, although almost invisible from the outside, was not born already tidy. It changed, was rewritten, adapted to new countries, timezones, ambiguous city names, external service limits, and also to my own mistakes.
Some mistakes were small. Others were much less so.
Because FediMeteo is a human project and, as such, imperfect. Imperfect in the way humans are imperfect, which today almost seems unfashionable. I like that.
The first version of the bot was almost embarrassingly simple, and I was proud of that.
It took a city name as input, asked Nominatim for the coordinates through geopy, called the Open-Meteo API for the current weather and the next several days, and printed a markdown block with current conditions, the forecast for today, the next twelve hours, and the coming days. The text was in Italian. The cities were Italian. The timezone was Europe/Rome. There was nothing to calculate.
Around the script, a small sh wrapper read a list of cities and, for each one, ran the Python program and piped its output into snac note_unlisted. A cron job ran the wrapper every six hours. The output was loose markdown, which snac happily renders, and the integration was: standard output goes into standard input. Nothing fancier than that.

articles.title: GitHub Actions security in Python packages
articles.content_snippet:
This is a written version of a talk I gave at PyCon US 2026 in Long Beach. Slides (PDF), scripts, and datasets are at github.com/andrew/pycon.
Of the roughly 864,000 packages PyPI lists, about 387,000 declare a repository URL on GitHub, mapping to 343,000 distinct repositories once you collapse the monorepos. 152,000 of those have something in .github/workflows/, and for practical purposes open source Python has one CI system: Travis CI, the previous default, accounts for 11% of the same population and stopped offering free open source builds in 2023, with everything else below 2%.
Around 56,000 of those repositories reference pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish somewhere in a workflow file, which is to say they tag a commit, a runner spins up, a wheel gets built, and twine upload puts it on PyPI. About 22% of them have migrated to trusted publishing, where PyPI accepts a short-lived OIDC token minted by the workflow instead of a stored API key, and the publisher configuration on PyPI’s side names the repository, the workflow file, and optionally a deployment environment. The other 44,000 or so still have a PYPI_API_TOKEN sitting in repository secrets.
I think trusted publishing is one of the better things to have happened to Python packaging in years, and it also means the workflow’s identity is now the credential, so PyPI’s trust in a release rests on the integrity of an Actions run. PEP 740 attestations, Sigstore signatures, and SLSA provenance all bind an artifact to the workflow and commit it came from, which tells you where it was built but says nothing about whether something tampered with the workflow before the upload step ran. Signing is the last thing that happens, so every preceding step is in scope for an attacker who can reach any of them, which is the argument I made at length in GitHub Actions is the weakest link last month.

articles.title: Distributing LLM inference in DwarfStar

High end NVIDIA cards, and the server and power needed to run them, cost a lot of money, especially if you plan to reach enough VRAM to run massive models. The alternative, so far, has been Apple hardware, or the DGX Spark that, even if severely limited because of memory bandwidth, still allows to run LLMs prompt processing (prefill) fast enough. The Mac Studio provided up to 512GB unified memory, a solution with modest memory bandwidth (but much better than the Spark) and compute at a price that was, after all, given the current situation, relatively fair.

For instance, with DwarfStar the Mac Studio M3 Ultra 512GB can run DeepSeek v4 PRO at 150 t/s prefill and ~10-13 t/s decoding, not great but at a level that is usable for certain use cases. Even 2-bit quantized, DeepSeek v4 PRO resists very well, like Flash at the same quantization (today I made PRO write a C compiler, I'll publish the video soon). I would not consider a trivial fact to run a frontier model at home, with a ~12k total spending.

One could expect this to get better and better, but the situation at the horizon appears cloudy. There is almost zero hope that NVIDIA setups will get less expensive, and even a small company can’t afford to easily purchase and handle a small data center for local inference. At the same time the RAM shortage is making it not exactly likely that we will see a Mac Studio with an M5 Ultra, maybe 1.2T/s memory bandwidth and more compute (the M5 Max is already faster, compute wise, and has the Neural Accelerators inside each GPU core that help with certain models).

So the current situation for local inference is that the best machine is probably a laptop. The M5 Max 128GB can run DeepSeek v4 Flash and Mimo V2.5, 2-bit quantized, at very decent prefill and decoding speeds. articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對 AI 代理在軟體開發中的侷限性提出了概念性的觀點，並反思了當前業界的主流認知。

articles.title: Childhood Computing
articles.summary_en: The author reflects on their childhood introduction to computing in a 1992 school computer lab. By sharing personal anecdotes about using limited, disk-based IBM PCs and learning the Logo programming language, the piece highlights how resource constraints fostered deep engagement with technology.

articles.title: Signing is for the bad days
articles.summary_en: The article explains why digital signatures and supply chain security tools like Sigstore and in-toto are essential, even when they provide no visible benefit during normal operations. It highlights how these tools protect against build server compromises and malicious software substitution, while profiling the contributions of Santiago Torres-Arias to these security frameworks.

articles.title: Walking the dog with Claude
articles.summary_en: Matt Godbolt discusses the challenge of balancing technical accuracy with engaging presentation in content creation. By using an LLM to interview him, he explores the gap between subject matter experts and effective communicators, citing examples of creators who successfully bridge this divide.

articles.title: Building Pi With Pi
articles.summary_en: The author reflects on using the AI tool 'Pi' to develop Pi itself, noting how it has shifted the nature of issue tracking. He warns that AI-generated issues often contain confident but inaccurate diagnostic information, creating extra work for maintainers when users submit content not written in their own voice.

articles.title: News about Raspberry Pi 6 and Microcontroller Development
articles.summary_en: Raspberry Pi engineers held an AMA session on Reddit, providing insights into the development timeline for future hardware. Based on historical product launch cycles, it is projected that the Raspberry Pi 6 will likely be released around 2026 or 2027.
articles.summary_zh: Raspberry Pi 工程師在 Reddit 上舉辦了問答活動，分享了未來硬體開發的相關見解。根據過往的產品發布週期推算，預計 Raspberry Pi 6 最快可能在 2026 年至 2027 年間問世。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses historical launch data to perform an analysis and project a future outcome.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章利用過去的產品發布數據進行分析，藉此推估未來的發布時間點。

articles.title: StubZero: $148,337 RCE in Google Cloud Production
articles.summary_en: This article details a security research journey that led to discovering a $148,337 Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerability in Google Cloud. It highlights how fragmented information and quick action during a submission window can uncover critical production flaws.
articles.summary_zh: 本文介紹了一項安全研究發現，揭露了 Google Cloud 生產環境中價值 148,337 美元的遠端代碼執行（RCE）漏洞。內容強調了碎片化資訊與在時限內採取行動，對於發現關鍵系統漏洞的重要性。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article serves as a real-world case study and empirical evidence of a critical vulnerability discovery process.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文作為一個真實世界的案例研究，提供了關於關鍵漏洞挖掘過程的實證紀錄。

articles.title: Planescape: Torment, Part 1: From the Tabletop…
articles.summary_en: This article explores the historical transition of Dungeons & Dragons from tabletop gaming to computer adaptations. It specifically sets the stage for the development of the iconic Infinity Engine games.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了《龍與地下城》從桌上角色扮演遊戲過渡到電腦遊戲的歷史。同時也為開發經典的 Infinity Engine 遊戲系列奠定了背景敘述。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides historical context and explains the conceptual background behind the evolution of classic RPG titles.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供了歷史背景，解釋了經典角色扮演遊戲演變背後的概念性緣由。

articles.title: Reiner Pope – Chip design from the bottom up
articles.summary_en: Reiner Pope explains the fundamentals of chip design, tracing the evolution from basic logic gates to complex processing architectures. The discussion explores the structural design choices behind GPUs, TPUs, FPGAs, and the human brain.
articles.summary_zh: Reiner Pope 解釋了晶片設計的基本原理，追溯了從基礎邏輯閘到複雜處理器架構的演進過程。對談探討了 GPU、TPU、FPGA 以及人類大腦在架構設計上的選擇差異。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content focuses on explaining the underlying theoretical frameworks and architectural reasoning behind different types of processors.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容重點在於解釋不同類型處理器背後的理論框架與架構邏輯。

articles.title: Dependency Pruning
articles.summary_en: The article advocates for regular dependency pruning as a crucial strategy for supply-chain security, arguing that unused dependencies represent unnecessary attack vectors. Instead of merely patching vulnerabilities, developers should prioritize removing unused packages to reduce risk and maintenance overhead.
articles.summary_zh: 本文主張定期清理依賴項是強化軟體供應鏈安全的重要策略，並指出未使用的套件會帶來不必要的安全隱患。作者建議開發者在面對漏洞報告時，應優先考慮直接移除無用套件，而非僅僅進行修補，以降低風險與維護成本。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the conceptual necessity of pruning dependencies for security rather than performance, focusing on the 'why' and strategic approach.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文闡述了基於安全而非效能考量進行依賴項清理的觀念，重點在於說明其必要性及策略思維。

articles.title: TIL: Symlinking NixOS Dotfiles
articles.summary_en: The author explores a method for declaratively managing symlinks on NixOS by leveraging systemd-tmpfiles. This approach allows users to manage dotfiles without relying on complex external tools like home-manager or manual scripting.
articles.summary_zh: 作者探討了一種透過 systemd-tmpfiles 在 NixOS 上以宣告式方式管理符號連結的方法。這種方式讓使用者無需依賴 home-manager 或手動腳本，即可簡便地管理設定檔。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a specific, actionable solution and configuration example for a common technical task.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章針對常見技術問題提供了具體的解決方案與配置範例，屬於教學類內容。

articles.title: Why do you say that a COM STA thread must pump messages if I see sample code creating STA threads and not pumping messages?
articles.summary_en: This article clarifies the necessity of message pumping in COM STA threads. It explains that while message pumping is generally required when idle, threads may appear to function without it if they are constantly occupied.
articles.summary_zh: 本文釐清了 COM STA 執行緒為何需要處理訊息迴圈的疑問。作者指出，雖然 STA 執行緒通常需要處理閒置訊息，但若執行緒始終處於忙碌狀態，則可能觀察不到顯式的訊息處理行為。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the underlying theoretical requirement for message pumping in the COM STA model.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文解釋了 COM STA 模型中關於訊息處理的底層理論需求。

articles.title: How do I use Win32 structures from the Windows Runtime?
articles.summary_en: This post addresses the technical impossibility of directly using Win32 structures within the Windows Runtime. It suggests that while direct integration is unsupported, developers may be able to simulate or 'fake' the desired behavior.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了在 Windows Runtime 中直接使用 Win32 結構的技術限制。文中指出雖然無法直接整合，但開發者或許可以透過模擬的方式達到類似的效果。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post provides a conceptual explanation regarding the compatibility constraints between two Windows programming environments.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章針對兩種 Windows 程式開發環境之間的相容性限制，提供了概念性的解釋。

articles.title: How to Talk to Your Coworkers
articles.summary_en: This article explores the communication gap between technical developers, who rely on structured instructions, and non-technical colleagues, who prefer conversational context. It suggests that developers should embrace repetition as a tool rather than frustration, recognizing that different roles process information through different frameworks.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了依賴結構化指令的開發人員與習慣口頭對話的非技術同事之間的溝通鴻溝。作者建議開發人員應將重複溝通視為一種工具，而非感到挫折，並理解不同職位處理資訊的方式存在差異。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the analogy of 'two different languages' to explain the structural disconnect between technical and non-technical communication styles.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章運用「兩種不同語言」的類比，解釋了技術與非技術溝通風格之間的結構性隔閡。

articles.title: Lawmakers Demand Answers as CISA Tries to Contain Data Leak
articles.summary_en: Congress is demanding accountability from CISA following a significant data breach where a contractor exposed sensitive AWS GovCloud keys and agency secrets on GitHub. The agency is currently working to mitigate the security risks and invalidate the compromised credentials.
articles.summary_zh: 在 KrebsOnSecurity 報導 CISA 承包商將 AWS GovCloud 金鑰與機密資料公開於 GitHub 後，美國國會議員要求該機構給予交代。目前 CISA 仍在努力控制此次資料外洩事件，並嘗試註銷已遭洩露的憑證。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains a current event and the conceptual implications of a security failure within a government agency.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文旨在說明當前發生的事件，並解釋政府機構資安缺失所帶來的概念性影響。

articles.title: The memory shortage is causing a repricing of consumer electronics
articles.summary_en: The article explains how the surging demand for HBM memory in AI data centers is cannibalizing wafer capacity from consumer-grade RAM. This supply shift is forcing manufacturers to prioritize high-margin AI chips, leading to higher costs and the potential disappearance of budget-friendly consumer electronics.
articles.summary_zh: 本文解釋了人工智慧資料中心對高頻寬記憶體（HBM）的巨大需求，正排擠消費級記憶體（RAM）的晶圓產能。由於製造商優先考量高利潤的 AI 晶片，這將導致消費性電子產品成本上升，平價手機市場恐將面臨萎縮。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual explanation of market dynamics and the economic causal relationship between AI growth and hardware pricing.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供了市場動態的概念性解釋，說明人工智慧發展與硬體定價之間的經濟因果關係。

articles.title: FTC to Require Cox Media Group, Two Other Firms to Pay Nearly $1 Million to Settle Charges They Deceived Customers About “Active Listening” AI-Powered Marketing Service
articles.summary_en: The FTC has settled charges against Cox Media Group and other firms for deceiving customers about an 'active listening' marketing service that claimed to use AI to target ads based on real-time voice data. The investigation confirmed that the companies were misleadingly marketing standard ad-targeting practices as voice-activated technology.
articles.summary_zh: 美國聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）與 Cox Media Group 等公司達成和解，這些公司曾謊稱利用人工智慧進行「主動聆聽」來獲取語音數據並投放廣告。調查證實，這些行銷服務並未使用語音數據，僅是誇大其詞地包裝了現有的廣告投放技術。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post provides evidence from an official FTC investigation to debunk specific marketing claims about AI technology.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章引用美國聯邦貿易委員會的官方調查報告作為證據，藉此駁斥關於人工智慧技術的虛假行銷說法。

articles.title: Digitale autonomie: wat kunnen organisaties NU doen
articles.summary_en: Organizations are increasingly concerned about digital autonomy after years of dependency on American technology. Bert Hubert notes that regaining independence is a long-term challenge that requires acknowledging past outsourcing mistakes rather than seeking immediate quick fixes.
articles.summary_zh: 隨著對數位自主權的擔憂日益增加，許多大型組織開始尋求如何應對技術過度依賴美國的問題。Bert Hubert 指出，經過 15 年的技術外包，重建自主權是一個漫長的過程，無法一蹴而就，必須先正視過去的決策失誤。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content addresses the conceptual challenge of digital autonomy and the systemic difficulty of shifting away from long-term technological dependencies.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該內容探討了數位自主權的觀念性挑戰，以及擺脫長期技術依賴在系統層面上的難度。

articles.title: Magic the Gathering format: Fun 40
articles.summary_en: This article introduces 'Fun 40,' a custom Magic: The Gathering format designed for casual play. It outlines the specific deck-building constraints and gameplay philosophy intended to simplify the game experience.
articles.summary_zh: 本文介紹了名為「Fun 40」的《魔法風雲會》自訂賽制，旨在提供更輕鬆休閒的遊戲體驗。文章概述了該賽制的套牌構築限制以及簡化遊戲流程的設計理念。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as a guide for setting up and playing a specific custom game format.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章的作用是引導讀者設置並遊玩特定的自訂遊戲賽制。

articles.title: Book Notes: “Poor Charlie’s Almanack”
articles.summary_en: This post summarizes key insights from 'Poor Charlie’s Almanack,' focusing on Charlie Munger's pragmatic approach to investing and life. It highlights his philosophy of seeking simple solutions, learning from mistakes, and prioritizing practical judgment over complex academic theories.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章整理了《窮查理的普通常識》中的核心智慧，強調查理·蒙格在投資與生活上的務實觀點。作者指出蒙格偏好尋找簡單的解決方案，並認為面對錯誤的態度與避免複雜化比追求學術理論更為重要。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content explains the conceptual framework and mental models of Charlie Munger's decision-making philosophy.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容闡述了查理·蒙格決策哲學中的概念性架構與心智模型。

articles.title: The stock market returns 4 %
articles.summary_en: This article challenges common optimistic stock market return assumptions, arguing that many figures ignore compounding, inflation, and hidden costs. It proposes a more conservative 4% annual return as a realistic baseline for long-term financial planning.
articles.summary_zh: 本文質疑大眾對於股市報酬率過於樂觀的假設，指出許多數字忽略了複利效應、通貨膨脹及投資成本。作者建議在財務規劃中應採用較保守的 4% 作為實際年化報酬率的基準。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the theoretical components of investment returns, providing a conceptual framework to debunk common misconceptions.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文解釋了投資報酬率的理論構成，提供了一個概念性框架來釐清並反駁常見的財務誤區。

articles.title: The $500 Price Increase
articles.source: Tedium: The Dull Side of the Internet.
articles.summary_en: Plex has significantly increased the price of its lifetime subscription from $249.99 to $749.99. This move highlights the growing tension between the company's need for sustainable recurring revenue and its user base, which historically prefers self-hosting to avoid traditional SaaS models.
articles.summary_zh: Plex 將其終身訂閱價格從 249.99 美元大幅調漲至 749.99 美元。此舉凸顯了公司對持續性經常性收入的需求，與偏好透過自行架設服務以規避傳統軟體訂閱制（SaaS）的用戶群體之間的矛盾。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article analyzes a specific business decision and pricing data point as a case study for the evolving software subscription model.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文分析了具體的商業決策與定價數據，適合作為探討軟體訂閱模式演變的案例研究。

articles.title: The Rise of Build-to-Rent Housing
articles.summary_en: The build-to-rent sector is experiencing a significant surge, characterized by the development of single-family homes designed exclusively for rental markets. This shift reflects evolving housing preferences and investment strategies within the current real estate landscape.
articles.summary_zh: 「租賃住宅專用」(Build-to-Rent) 市場近年來迅速興起，這類住宅是專為出租目的而建造的獨棟房屋。此現象反映了房地產市場中投資策略與住宅需求模式的重大轉變。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains a market trend and defines the core concept of build-to-rent housing.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章旨在解釋市場趨勢，並定義了「租賃住宅專用」這一核心概念。

articles.title: Read Cindy Cohn's new book, Privacy's Defender: My Thirty-Year Fight Against Digital Surveillance
articles.summary_en: This post recommends the book 'Privacy's Defender' by Electronic Frontier Foundation Executive Director Cindy Cohn. The memoir chronicles her career and covers three major legal battles against digital surveillance.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章推薦了電子前哨基金會執行董事 Cindy Cohn 所著的《隱私捍衛者》。這本回憶錄記錄了她的職業生涯，並詳述了她在對抗數位監控過程中的三次重大法律戰役。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content serves primarily as a book recommendation and reference to an external publication.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容主要是對書籍的推薦，並作為外部出版物的參考資訊。

articles.title: RFC: Artificial Contributors to Open Source
articles.summary_en: This Internet-Draft proposes a set of best practices for governing non-human, AI-driven contributions to open source projects. It mandates strict disclosure requirements, defines the responsibilities of human operators, and establishes standards to ensure code quality and accountability in an era of automated code generation.
articles.summary_zh: 這份網路草案為開放原始碼專案中的非人類（AI）貢獻者提出了治理準則。內容規範了揭露義務、定義了人類操作者的責任，並建立了相關標準，以確保在自動化程式碼生成時代的品質與問責制度。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The document functions as a standard, defining terminology, requirements, and best practices for a specific domain.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文件作為一種標準規範，為特定領域定義了術語、要求以及最佳實踐準則。

articles.title: Nobody is destined for greatness.
articles.summary_en: The article uses the story of Demosthenes, who initially failed as an orator, to argue that greatness is not an innate destiny but a result of persistent effort. It challenges the notion of predetermined success, highlighting how overcoming initial defeat is essential to achievement.
articles.summary_zh: 本文透過狄摩西尼最初演說失敗的經歷，論證偉大並非天生註定，而是持續努力的成果。文章挑戰了宿命論觀點，強調克服最初的挫折是邁向成功的關鍵。
articles.pacer_reason_en: Uses an historical anecdote about Demosthenes to draw a parallel between past failures and the potential for future greatness.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 利用狄摩西尼的歷史故事作為類比，說明過去的失敗與未來成就之間的關聯。

articles.title: Couth and uncouth function pairs
articles.summary_en: This article discusses the mathematical concept of inverting non-invertible circular and hyperbolic functions. It explains how mathematicians restrict domains to create 'couth' function pairs, allowing for functional inversion.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了圓函數與雙曲函數等不可逆函數的數學反轉概念。作者解釋了如何透過限制函數定義域來建立「合適」（couth）的函數對，從而實現函數的反運算。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the theoretical concept of restricting function domains to allow for inversion.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文解釋了透過限制函數定義域以實現反運算的理論概念。

articles.title: Circular and hyperbolic functions differ by rotations
articles.summary_en: This article explains the mathematical relationship between circular and hyperbolic functions, showing they are linked by rotations in the complex plane. It illustrates this with the specific identity cosh(z) = cos(iz), demonstrating how multiplying by i represents a rotation.
articles.summary_zh: 本文闡述了圓函數與雙曲函數之間的數學關係，指出兩者透過複數平面的旋轉即可相互轉換。文中以 cosh(z) = cos(iz) 為例，說明乘上虛數單位 i 在數學上代表了一種旋轉操作。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content explains the underlying theoretical relationship and conceptual definitions connecting circular and hyperbolic functions.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容解釋了連接圓函數與雙曲函數的潛在理論關係與概念定義。

articles.title: The classic TreeView control lets me sort by name or by lParam, but why not both?
articles.summary_en: This post explains the technical limitation of the classic TreeView control regarding sorting. It suggests that developers must manually bridge the gap between sorting by name and sorting by lParam.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了經典 TreeView 控制項在排序功能上的技術限制。作者指出，若開發者想要同時支援依名稱與依 lParam 排序，必須自行實作轉換邏輯。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post provides a brief technical hint on how to handle a specific programming limitation in a UI control.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章針對 UI 控制項的程式設計限制，提供了具體的技術解決思路。

articles.title: "No way to prevent this" say users of only package manager where this regularly happens
articles.summary_en: The article critiques the recurring issues and reliability problems associated with a specific package manager. It uses satire to highlight the frustration users feel regarding the software's persistent, preventable technical failures.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章諷刺了某個軟體套件管理器頻繁出現的問題與可靠性挑戰。作者透過反諷的手法，點出了使用者對於該工具一再發生可預防性故障的挫折感。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content functions as a satirical commentary on software quality and development practices rather than a technical guide or data report.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文屬於針對軟體品質與開發實務的諷刺性評論，而非技術指南或數據報告。

articles.title: "No way to prevent this" say users of only language where this regularly happens
articles.summary_en: This blog post critiques programming language design flaws, specifically addressing how certain languages allow recurring, preventable errors. It highlights user frustration with languages that fail to implement safety features despite clear patterns of failure.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇部落格文章批判了程式語言設計的缺陷，特別探討了某些語言如何導致經常發生的可預防錯誤。文章強調了當程式語言在明知錯誤模式的情況下仍未導入安全機制時，使用者所面臨的無力感與挫折。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on the conceptual discussion of programming language design and the philosophical implications of recurring software flaws.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章重點在於對程式語言設計概念的探討，以及反覆出現的軟體缺陷所帶來的哲學性意涵。

articles.title: Whale Fall
articles.summary_en: This article explores the biological phenomenon of 'whale falls,' where deceased whales sink to the deep ocean floor. It reflects on the immense scale of these creatures and their final descent into the abyss.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了「鯨落」這一自然現象，即鯨魚死亡後沉入深海海底的過程。作者感嘆這些巨大海洋生物的宏偉，以及牠們最終歸於深海的生命循環。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content explains the 'what is' and the biological nature of whale falls, focusing on the conceptual understanding of the process.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容解釋了鯨落的定義與生物學本質，重點在於對該現象的概念性說明。

articles.title: Pluralistic: Shopping isn't politics (21 May 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: Cory Doctorow argues that 'voting with your wallet' is a futile and anti-progressive concept that inherently favors the wealthy. He asserts that this market-based approach undermines democratic processes and solidarity by reducing complex societal issues to mere consumer demand signals.
