articles.title: Shame them, shun them, ban them, beat them!
articles.summary_en: This article explores the psychological and social dynamics of shame, ostracism, and punishment in modern society. It examines how these mechanisms influence human behavior and group cohesion through a historical and experimental lens.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了現代社會中羞辱、排斥與懲罰行為背後的心理與社會動力。透過歷史與實驗視角，分析了這些機制如何影響人類行為與群體凝聚力。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article discusses the theoretical and conceptual underpinnings of social punishment and behavior.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文探討了社會懲罰與行為背後的理論基礎與概念。

articles.title: Welcoming the Bangladesh Government to Have I Been Pwned
articles.summary_en: The Bangladesh government has joined the 'Have I Been Pwned' free government service, becoming the 43rd nation to participate. Their BGD e-GOV CIRT department can now utilize APIs to monitor and query government domains for potential data breaches.
articles.summary_zh: 孟加拉政府正式加入「Have I Been Pwned」的免費政府服務計畫，成為全球第 43 個合作國家。該國的 BGD e-GOV CIRT 部門現在可以透過 API 全面監控政府網域，並即時查詢未來的資料外洩風險。
articles.pacer_reason_en: This post functions as a report on a real-world case study of institutional adoption and service implementation.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 此文章報導了一個真實的機構採用與服務落實案例，屬於實證資訊。

articles.title: Building Software Requires Digestion
articles.summary_en: The author argues that modern chatbot interfaces, which prioritize rapid interaction, discourage the deep reflection necessary for effective software development. By drawing on the Japanese concept of 'Ma,' the post emphasizes that pausing and 'digesting' information are critical, active components of the creative problem-solving process.
articles.summary_zh: 作者指出，現代聊天機器人介面過度追求快速互動，反而阻礙了軟體開發中所需的深度思考。文章引用日本「間」（Ma）的概念，強調暫停與資訊「消化」是創意問題解決過程中不可或缺的積極組成部分。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article discusses the theoretical impact of interface design on human cognitive processes and proposes a conceptual framework for better problem-solving.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章討論了介面設計對人類認知過程的理論影響，並提出了改善解決問題能力的觀念框架。

articles.title: Regatta Starting Stations – Chi-squared Continued
articles.summary_en: This article investigates a statistical anomaly in the Henley Royal Regatta, where the Berkshire starting station yields a significantly higher win rate than the Buckinghamshire one. The author uses historical data to challenge the assumption that both stations are identical and fair.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了亨利皇家賽船會中一個統計異常現象，即伯克郡（Berkshire）起點站的勝率明顯高於白金漢郡（Buckinghamshire）起點站。作者透過歷史數據挑戰了兩條航道完全相同且公平的假設。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on analyzing historical race data and statistical benchmarks to prove a deviation from expected outcomes.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文重點在於分析歷史賽事數據與統計基準，以證明現有結果偏離了預期。

articles.title: Not a Security Issue
articles.summary_en: The author demonstrates how providing AI scanners with a project's specific vulnerability disclosure policy allows them to automatically filter out non-security bugs. By context-loading curl's policy, the tools successfully classified issues like minor leaks and crashes as low-priority quality bugs rather than false-positive security alerts.
articles.summary_zh: 作者展示了將專案的漏洞揭露政策載入 AI 掃描器後，能有效自動過濾非安全性漏洞。透過將 curl 的政策作為上下文，掃描工具能自動將小型洩漏或崩潰等問題歸類為一般品質瑕疵，而非偽陽性的安全性警報。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides an experimental demonstration of using policy-aware AI scanners on the curl codebase to reduce false-positive security reports.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文透過在 curl 程式碼庫中使用具備政策感知能力的 AI 掃描器進行實驗，展示了減少偽陽性安全性報告的實作案例。

articles.title: Position or Perish: The Narrative Blueprint
articles.summary_en: This article explores how Avis transformed its market position by embracing its status as the number two car rental company. By leveraging a counterintuitive narrative, they turned their competitive disadvantage into a memorable and highly profitable brand identity.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了 Avis 如何透過擁抱市場第二名的地位來轉型。透過運用反直覺的敘事策略，他們將競爭劣勢轉化為令人印象深刻且獲利豐厚的品牌形象。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the historical case study of Avis to draw parallels between business positioning strategies and narrative development.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文透過 Avis 的歷史案例研究，歸納出商業定位策略與敘事發展之間的類比關係。

articles.title: Learning Software Architecture
articles.summary_en: The author argues that software architecture is best learned through practical experience rather than formal theory. He highlights that software design is deeply influenced by organizational social structures, often referred to as Conway's Law, rather than just technical coding skills.
articles.summary_zh: 作者認為軟體架構應透過實際經驗而非形式理論來學習。他強調軟體設計深受組織社會結構（即康威定律）的影響，而不僅僅是程式碼編寫技巧。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual framework for understanding how software architecture is learned and how it relates to organizational incentives.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供了關於如何學習軟體架構以及其如何與組織激勵機制相關聯的概念性框架。

articles.title: Initialize and print 128-bit integers in C
articles.summary_en: This article discusses the nuances of initializing and printing 128-bit integers in the C programming language. It highlights the complexities of handling these non-standard types and provides guidance on the correct implementation techniques.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了在 C 語言中初始化與列印 128 位元整數的細節。作者說明了處理這類非標準資料類型的複雜性，並提供了正確的實作建議與技術指導。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on how to correctly perform specific coding tasks related to 128-bit integer handling in C.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文重點在於說明如何在 C 語言中正確執行與 128 位元整數處理相關的程式編碼任務。

articles.title: Hacking the lehmer64 RNG
articles.summary_en: This article explains how to recover the internal state of the lehmer64 random number generator using a sequence of its outputs. It explores the vulnerability of this generator, noting that its simple implementation allows for efficient state reversal.
articles.summary_zh: 本文介紹了如何透過 lehmer64 隨機數生成器的輸出序列來反推其內部狀態。文章指出該生成器因結構簡單，使其狀態逆向分析變得相對容易。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as a technical walkthrough or 'how-to' guide for reversing the state of a specific cryptographic algorithm.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文屬於技術實作指南，解釋了如何針對特定隨機數生成演算法進行狀態逆向操作。

articles.title: Euler function
articles.summary_en: This post discusses the probability that a random n×n matrix over a finite field with q elements is invertible. It explores how this probability converges as n increases, highlighting the connection to the Euler function.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了有限體上隨機 n×n 矩陣可逆的機率。文章分析了隨矩陣維度 n 增加時，該機率如何快速收斂，並探討了其與歐拉函數之間的關聯。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post analyzes mathematical probabilities and convergence patterns based on specific algebraic definitions.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章基於特定的代數定義，對數學機率和收斂模式進行了分析。

articles.title: I'm really frustrated that GitLab is doing layoffs
articles.summary_en: The author expresses deep frustration and disappointment regarding the recent layoffs at GitLab. The piece reflects on how the company could have achieved success without resorting to these workforce reductions.
articles.summary_zh: 作者對於 GitLab 近期的裁員決策表達了深切的挫折感與失望。文中反思了該公司本可以在不採取裁員手段的情況下，依然達成成功的願景。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article is a commentary on corporate decision-making and workplace sentiment rather than a guide, data report, or reference material.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文屬於對企業決策與職場情緒的評論，而非教學指南、數據報告或參考資料。

articles.title: Pluralistic: A fascist paradigm (12 May 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: This article explores the application of systems thinking to political change, drawing on Donella Meadows' canonical work. It distinguishes between complicated mechanical systems and complex adaptive systems, arguing that understanding these interconnected relationships is essential for effective intervention.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了系統思維在政治變革中的應用，並借鑒了 Donella Meadows 的經典著作。文章區分了複雜的機械系統與複雜適應系統，強調理解這些相互關聯的關係對於進行有效干預至關重要。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content explains the conceptual framework of systems thinking and differentiates between complicated and complex systems.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容解釋了系統思維的概念框架，並區分了複雜（complicated）與複雜（complex）系統的差異。

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary_en: Major tech companies including Apple, Google, and Microsoft have released a record number of security patches this month. This surge highlights the increasing role of AI in both uncovering vulnerabilities in human-written code and potential future security risks.
articles.summary_zh: 包含蘋果、Google 和微軟在內的各大科技公司本月發布了創紀錄數量的安全更新。這波修補潮凸顯了人工智慧在檢測人類編碼漏洞方面的關鍵作用，以及其帶來的潛在安全影響。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article reports on current industry trends and data regarding security patch volumes and the evolving role of AI.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文報導了關於安全更新數量與人工智慧應用發展的產業現況與數據。

articles.title: Thoughts on GitLab's workforce reduction" and "structural and strategic decisions"
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison analyzes GitLab's recent announcement regarding workforce reductions and organizational restructuring as they pivot toward an 'agentic' product strategy. The post highlights GitLab's shift to reduce its global country footprint, flatten management layers, and reorganize R&D into smaller, autonomous units.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 分析了 GitLab 最近關於裁員與組織重組的公告，以及其轉向「代理人（agentic）」產品策略的舉措。文章重點介紹了 GitLab 縮減全球營運國家布局、精簡管理層級，並將研發部門改組為更小型、具備端到端所有權的團隊。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides commentary and conceptual analysis on organizational shifts and industry trends rather than acting as a technical guide or raw data set.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對組織轉型與產業趨勢進行評論與概念分析，而非提供技術指南或原始數據集。

articles.title: Bambu Lab is abusing the open source social contract
articles.summary_en: Jeff Geerling expresses concerns over Bambu Lab's move toward restrictive, cloud-dependent printer management. He details the technical steps he took to regain control of his hardware, including firewall restrictions and switching to open-source software.
articles.summary_zh: Jeff Geerling 對 Bambu Lab 轉向依賴雲端的限制性管理模式表示擔憂。他詳細介紹了自己如何透過防火牆限制及改用開源軟體等技術手段，重新奪回對硬體的控制權。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a practical, step-by-step account of how the author bypassed manufacturer restrictions on his hardware.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供了一份具體的操作步驟指南，說明作者如何繞過製造商對其硬體的限制。

articles.title: Thinking Machines and interaction models
articles.summary_en: This article explores the evolving landscape of interaction models for AI-driven systems. It examines how human-machine interaction is shifting from traditional command-based inputs to more intuitive, cognitive-aligned frameworks.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了人工智慧系統互動模型的演變趨勢。文章分析了人類與機器之間的互動模式如何從傳統的指令式輸入，轉向更直觀且符合認知邏輯的架構。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on the theoretical framework and conceptual understanding of how humans interact with intelligent machines.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文聚焦於人類如何與智慧機器互動的理論架構與概念理解。

articles.title: Welcoming the Costa Rican Government to Have I Been Pwned
articles.summary_en: The Costa Rican government has joined the 'Have I Been Pwned' free service, becoming the 42nd nation to do so. Their CSIRT can now monitor government domains to identify and respond to data exposures more effectively.
articles.summary_zh: 哥斯大黎加政府正式加入「Have I Been Pwned」免費服務，成為第 42 個參與的國家。該國的資安應變小組（CSIRT）將能監控政府網域，並即時識別潛在的資料外洩威脅。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post functions as an update on a real-world implementation case involving a government agency.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 此文章為關於政府機構導入實際案例的更新報導。

articles.title: Weekly Update 503
articles.summary_en: Troy Hunt reports on the ongoing Instructure data extortion case involving the ShinyHunters group. The company has opted to issue a vague statement rather than comment further as a deadline for their ransom demand approaches.
articles.summary_zh: Troy Hunt 報導了涉及 ShinyHunters 組織的 Instructure 數據勒索案。隨著贖金勒索截止日期臨近，該公司選擇發布一份模糊的聲明，拒絕進一步置評。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content reports on specific, timely news and documented events regarding a cybersecurity incident.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文報導了關於網路安全事件的特定時事與已記錄的現況。

articles.title: Out With the JS, In With the HTML
articles.summary_en: The author replaces a client-side JavaScript-based icon resizing widget with a simpler, navigation-based approach. By pre-rendering four distinct versions of the icon pages, the author eliminates redundant client-side logic and avoids potential synchronization errors between server and client templates.
articles.summary_zh: 作者將原本基於 JavaScript 的客戶端圖示調整大小功能，改為更簡單的導航式設計。透過預先渲染四種不同尺寸的頁面，作者消除了冗餘的客戶端邏輯，並避免了伺服器與客戶端範本之間不同步的問題。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the contrast between the old JS-based method and the new navigation-based method to illustrate a paradigm shift in web architecture.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文透過對比舊有的 JavaScript 方法與新的導航式方法，闡述了網頁架構設計觀念的轉變。

articles.title: The Problem of Pedagogy in Advanced Mathematics
articles.summary_en: This article discusses the persistent challenges in mathematical pedagogy, noting that poor instructional methods occur not just in schools but also at the graduate level. The author highlights how obscure textbook proofs often lack necessary intermediate steps, requiring significant effort from students and experts alike to achieve true clarity and understanding.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了數學教學中持續存在的挑戰，指出教學問題不僅限於基礎教育，也存在於研究所階段。作者強調許多數學教科書中的證明過於簡略且缺乏中間步驟，導致學生甚至專業人士需要投入大量心力才能真正理解其邏輯。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article is a conceptual exploration of the problems inherent in how mathematics is taught and presented in literature.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文是對數學教學方式及文獻呈現問題的概念性探討。

articles.title: proxy
articles.summary_en: The author introduces 'proxy', a lightweight Go binary that acts as a universal local caching mirror for numerous package registries including npm, PyPI, and Cargo. By intercepting registry requests, it enables faster testing cycles and provides a simple, self-hosted alternative to heavy enterprise solutions like Artifactory.
articles.summary_zh: 作者介紹了一款名為 'proxy' 的輕量級 Go 二進位檔案，它能作為 npm、PyPI 和 Cargo 等多種套件註冊中心的通用本地快取鏡像。透過攔截註冊中心請求，該工具不僅能加速測試流程，還為尋求輕量級方案的用戶提供了 Artifactory 或 Nexus 的替代選擇。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains how to solve the problem of testing against external registries by providing a tool and examples of how to implement it locally.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文介紹瞭如何透過提供工具及其實作範例，解決開發過程中對外部註冊中心進行測試的問題。

articles.title: Fear is information.
articles.summary_en: This article challenges the common view of fear as an enemy to be conquered, suggesting instead that it should be viewed as valuable information. It critiques the motivational industry's tendency to frame fear through a martial lens that encourages suppression or combat.
articles.summary_zh: 本文挑戰了將恐懼視為必須戰勝之敵的普遍觀點，主張應將恐懼視為有價值的資訊。文章批評了勵志產業傾向於使用軍事化語言，鼓勵人們壓抑或對抗恐懼。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual shift in how to frame and understand the emotion of fear.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對如何定義與理解「恐懼」這一情感，提供了概念上的轉變。

articles.title: Inverse shift
articles.summary_en: This article explores the technical nuances of sequence shifting, highlighting that shifting right and left are not perfectly inverse operations due to data loss. It explains how shifting a bit sequence results in the loss of information, making the operations asymmetric.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了序列位移技術中的細節，指出由於數據丟失，向右移位和向左移位並非完全互逆的操作。文章解釋了位元序列在移位過程中會導致信息流失，使這些運算在數學上呈現非對稱性。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the concept of bitwise operations and why they do not function as perfect mathematical inverses.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章解釋了位元運算的概念，並說明了為什麼它們在數學上無法構成完美的逆運算。

articles.title: Probability that a random binary matrix is invertible
articles.summary_en: This article explores the mathematical probability of a random n x n binary matrix being invertible. It introduces the problem and discusses different methodologies for calculating this likelihood.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了隨機二元矩陣可逆的數學機率問題。文章介紹了該問題的背景，並討論了計算此類矩陣可逆機率的不同方法。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on explaining a mathematical concept and the theoretical framework behind determining matrix invertibility.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文重點在於解釋數學概念，以及探討判定矩陣可逆性背後的理論框架。

articles.title: Additional notes on controlling which handles are inherited by Create­Process
articles.summary_en: This post discusses methods for managing handle inheritance when using the CreateProcess function in Windows programming. It specifically highlights the technique of isolating handles within a private container to control access.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了在使用 CreateProcess 函數進行 Windows 程式開發時，如何管理控制代碼（handle）繼承的問題。文中特別介紹了將控制代碼放置於私有容器中，以精確控制存取權限的技術。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content provides technical instructions and implementation techniques for a specific programming task.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容提供了針對特定程式開發任務的技術指導與實作技巧。

articles.title: Find blog posts with missing featured images - and missing alt text - without a plugin
articles.summary_en: This post provides a tutorial on using WP-CLI to identify WordPress blog posts that lack featured images or alt text. By leveraging command-line tools, users can efficiently audit their site's media metadata without relying on additional plugins.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章介紹了如何利用 WP-CLI 指令行工具，在不使用外掛的情況下找出 WordPress 網站中缺乏精選圖片或替代文字的部落格文章。透過指令行操作，使用者可以更有效率地稽核與管理網站的媒體中繼資料。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a step-by-step technical guide on using command-line tools to solve a specific administrative task in WordPress.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章提供了逐步操作的技術指南，教導如何使用指令行工具來解決 WordPress 中的特定管理任務。

articles.title: Hosting a website on an 8-bit microcontroller.
articles.summary_en: The author demonstrates how to host a functional website on an 8-bit AVR microcontroller by utilizing the Serial Line Internet Protocol (SLIP). The project bypasses complex Ethernet hardware in favor of a minimal, low-resource software stack to handle IP packets and basic HTTP responses.
articles.summary_zh: 作者展示了如何透過串列線路網際網路協定 (SLIP)，在 8 位元 AVR 微控制器上架設網站。此專案避開了複雜的乙太網路硬體，改採精簡的軟體堆疊來處理 IP 封包與基礎的 HTTP 回應。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article serves as a technical walkthrough detailing the implementation steps for hosting a web server on restricted hardware.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文屬於技術實作指南，詳細說明了如何在受限的硬體環境中架設網頁伺服器的步驟。

articles.title: Pluralistic: 2024 (apart from the obvious) (11 May 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: This post critiques the 2024 U.S. presidential election strategies, arguing that the Democratic platform's perceived continuity failed to offer voters a compelling alternative to the establishment. The author suggests that the dissatisfaction with the status quo, combined with the lack of focus on significant policy changes, pushed voters toward the disruptive alternative represented by Donald Trump.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章評論了 2024 年美國總統大選的競選策略，認為民主黨延續前任政府的路線未能為選民提供具吸引力的替代方案。作者指出，選民對現狀的不滿加上缺乏實質政策變革，使得選民傾向選擇川普所代表的顛覆性路線。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content is primarily a conceptual analysis and critique of political strategy and voter behavior.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容主要針對政治策略與選民行為進行概念性分析與評論。

articles.title: We Are Not Going to Agree on AI
articles.summary_en: The article argues that AI is best viewed as a capable tool rather than a transformative, all-encompassing solution. The author highlights the current polarization in public and professional opinion, suggesting that consensus is unlikely due to extreme hype and contradictory evidence.
articles.summary_zh: 本文主張人工智慧應被視為一種實用工具，而非包羅萬象的革命性方案。作者指出目前大眾與專業領域對 AI 的意見分歧，認為由於過度炒作與矛盾的證據，我們將難以就 AI 的定位達成共識。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The author uses the analogy of shopping for a stud finder at Home Depot to illustrate the conflict between practical utility and excessive, complex features in AI.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 作者透過在五金行購買測牆儀（stud finder）的親身經歷作為類比，說明人工智慧在實用性與過度堆疊複雜功能之間的衝突。

articles.title: Quoting James Shore
articles.summary_en: James Shore argues that AI coding agents must reduce long-term maintenance costs to be truly beneficial. He provides a mathematical perspective showing that increased coding speed often leads to higher technical debt unless maintenance efforts are reduced proportionally.
articles.summary_zh: James Shore 指出，AI 編碼代理必須能降低長期維護成本才具備實質效益。他透過數學邏輯分析說明，若未能同步降低維護成本，程式碼產出的速度提升反而會導致技術債的顯著增加。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on the theoretical economic impact and conceptual framework of using AI in software development.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章側重於探討在軟體開發中使用 AI 的經濟影響與概念性框架。

articles.title: Your AI Use Is Breaking My Brain
articles.summary_en: This post discusses Jason Koebler's critique of the 'Zombie Internet,' a phenomenon where AI-generated content and human interactions become indistinguishable and overwhelming. It highlights the mental exhaustion caused by filtering pervasive AI writing and the ways it distorts digital communication.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了 Jason Koebler 對「殭屍網路」（Zombie Internet）的批判，指出 AI 生成內容與人類互動的界線日益模糊，令人難以招架。文章強調了過濾無處不在的 AI 內容所帶來的精神消耗，以及這種趨勢如何扭曲人類的數位溝通模式。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual definition and cultural commentary on the impact of AI-generated content on internet discourse.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供了一種概念性定義與文化評論，探討 AI 生成內容對網路討論環境的影響。

articles.title: Using LLM in the shebang line of a script
articles.summary_en: This post demonstrates how to use the 'llm' CLI tool within a script's shebang line to execute LLM prompts directly. It explores various techniques, including using fragments, external tools, and YAML-based templates to create functional, AI-powered scripts.
articles.summary_zh: 本文介紹如何利用 shebang 行將 'llm' 命令列工具嵌入腳本中，直接執行 LLM 提示詞。文中展示了多種技巧，包括使用 fragments、外部工具以及基於 YAML 的模板來建立功能強大的 AI 驅動腳本。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides specific, actionable code snippets and instructions on how to configure script files for LLM integration.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供了具體且可操作的程式碼片段與說明，指導使用者如何配置腳本檔案以進行 LLM 整合。

articles.title: Learning on the Shop floor
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison discusses how Shopify uses an internal AI coding agent named River within public Slack channels to create a 'teaching workshop' or Lehrwerkstatt. By making work visible and collaborative, the company enables employees to learn through observation and collective interaction, a strategy similar to Midjourney's early public Discord-based interface.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 探討了 Shopify 如何透過名為 River 的內部 AI 編碼代理工具，在公開的 Slack 頻道中打造「教學工作坊」。透過將工作過程透明化與協作化，公司讓員工能透過觀察與互動進行學習，這種策略與 Midjourney 早期利用公開 Discord 頻道促進使用者交流的做法如出一轍。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explores the conceptual framework of 'osmosis learning' and how public AI workflows serve as an organizational teaching model.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文探討了「滲透式學習」的概念架構，以及公開的 AI 工作流如何作為組織性的教學模式。

articles.title: Quoting New York Times Editors’ Note
articles.summary_en: The New York Times issued a correction after an editor mistakenly attributed an AI-generated summary to a politician as a direct quote. This incident highlights the risks of journalistic reliance on AI tools without proper fact-checking and verification.
articles.summary_zh: 紐約時報在錯誤地將人工智慧生成的總結視為政治人物的直接引言後，發布了更正聲明。此事件凸顯了新聞工作若缺乏嚴格事實查核，僅依賴 AI 工具所帶來的潛在風險。
articles.pacer_reason_en: It presents a specific case study of a journalistic error caused by AI, serving as evidence of the dangers of unverified AI usage.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 透過新聞工作因誤用 AI 而犯錯的具體案例，作為未經查核使用 AI 所帶來風險的實證。

articles.title: The Real Singularity is the Friends We Made Along the Way
articles.summary_en: The author critiques the 'Singularity' movement, comparing belief in superintelligence to religious fervor or 'the rapture for nerds.' It argues that current hyperscaler investments in AI are driven by strategic panic and fear of missing out rather than immediate return on investment.
articles.summary_zh: 作者批評了「奇點」運動，將對超級人工智慧的信仰比作宗教狂熱或「書呆子的升天」。文章認為，目前超大規模企業對人工智慧的巨額投資，更多是出於戰略恐慌和錯失恐懼症，而非實際的投資回報。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a critical conceptual framework and analysis of the belief systems and market dynamics surrounding AI and the Singularity.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對圍繞人工智慧與奇點的信仰體系及市場動態，提供了批判性的概念架構與分析。

articles.title: Madame Semver Will See You Now
articles.summary_en: This piece uses the metaphorical framing of a tarot reading to explore the common, frustrating realities of maintaining open-source software. It highlights the challenges of dependency management, malicious pull requests, misinformation, and the exhausting nature of handling unsolicited security audits.
articles.summary_zh: 本文透過塔羅牌占卜的隱喻，探討了維護開源軟體的常見痛點與無奈。內容描述了依賴關係管理、惡意合併請求、錯誤資訊以及處理無窮無盡的安全審計報告所帶來的疲憊感。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the analogy of a fortune teller reading tarot cards to explain the predictable cycles and struggles of software repository maintenance.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文運用塔羅牌占卜的類比，來解析軟體庫維護過程中可預見的循環與困境。

articles.title: The linear algebra of bit twiddling
articles.summary_en: This article explores the application of linear algebra within the binary field to understand bit manipulation operations. It specifically examines the Mersenne Twister's tempering process by treating bitwise operations as matrix multiplications over a finite field.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了二進位域中線性代數的應用，以理解位元操作的運作原理。文章具體分析了梅森旋轉演算法（Mersenne Twister）的調節步驟，將位元運算視為有限域上的矩陣乘法。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post explains the theoretical framework of applying linear algebra concepts to bitwise operations.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章解釋了將線性代數概念應用於位元運算的理論框架。

articles.title: Reverse engineering Mersenne Twister with Linear Algebra
articles.summary_en: This article demonstrates how to recover the internal state of the Mersenne Twister random number generator by applying linear algebra techniques. It highlights the distinction between standard PRNGs and cryptographically secure generators by showing how the MT's output can be reverse-engineered.
articles.summary_zh: 本文介紹了如何利用線性代數技術，從梅森旋轉演算法（Mersenne Twister）的輸出中恢復其內部狀態。文中透過此案例區分了偽隨機數生成器與密碼學安全生成器之間的本質差異。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as a technical tutorial or guide on how to perform reverse engineering on a specific algorithm.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文屬於技術教學性質，指導讀者如何對特定演算法進行逆向工程分析。

articles.title: [RSS Club] A Sneak Preview of Upcoming Posts
articles.summary_en: The author shares a preview of upcoming blog posts exclusively with RSS subscribers as a token of appreciation. The post mentions the use of the Editorial Calendar plugin to manage a schedule characterized by writing in bursts.
articles.summary_zh: 作者為了感謝 RSS 訂閱者，搶先分享了未來部落格文章的預告。文中提到使用 Editorial Calendar 外掛來管理其非定期、集中式的寫作節奏。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post serves as an announcement and a preview list of future content.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這篇文章主要作為公告，並提供未來內容的清單參考。

articles.title: Quoting Andrew Quinn
articles.summary_en: Andrew Quinn reflects on the psychological burden of fearing that one's programming work is obsolete. He argues that 'reinventing the wheel' a few times is a necessary learning process to reach the true frontier of technical knowledge effectively.
articles.summary_zh: Andrew Quinn 反思了程式設計師擔心自己的作品已過時的心理壓力。他認為，適度地「重新發明輪子」是獲取深層技術知識、進而觸及專業領域前沿的必要學習過程。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content presents a philosophical perspective on software development and the conceptual value of learning through hands-on reinvention.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容探討了關於軟體開發的哲學觀點，並解釋了透過親手實作來學習的觀念價值。

articles.title: The left-wing case for AI
articles.summary_en: This article explores the political implications of artificial intelligence from a left-wing perspective. It examines how AI technologies can be leveraged or critiqued within the context of labor rights, social equity, and economic policy.
articles.summary_zh: 本文從左派視角探討人工智慧的政治意涵。文中分析了在勞工權益、社會公平與經濟政策的脈絡下，應如何運用或批判 AI 技術。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on theoretical arguments and conceptual analysis of AI's societal impact.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文側重於針對 AI 社會影響的理論論述與概念分析。

articles.title: I Will Not Add Query Strings to Your URLs
articles.summary_en: The author reflects on the influence of Chris Morgan's technical insights, specifically regarding web development best practices. He discusses the value of questioning common trends, such as the use of query strings in URLs, and emphasizes learning through careful observation and community feedback.
articles.summary_zh: 作者分享了 Chris Morgan 在網頁開發建議方面對其產生的深遠影響，特別是關於拒絕使用網址查詢字串的觀點。文章強調了透過觀察社群回饋與質疑流行做法，作為非專業開發者學習並改進技術的價值。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article discusses the conceptual philosophy behind URL design and web development best practices.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文探討了網址設計與網頁開發最佳實踐背後的概念與哲學。

articles.title: Reading List 05/09/2026
articles.summary_en: This reading list explores diverse topics including the physics of trapped buildings, the emergence of residential data centers, and the development of cardboard military drones. It also examines infrastructure concerns, specifically the potential financial risks facing the Brightline high-speed rail project.
articles.summary_zh: 本期閱讀清單涵蓋了多元議題，包括建築物理結構、家用資料中心的興起以及紙板軍用無人機的發展。同時也探討了基礎建設挑戰，特別是光亮高鐵（Brightline）潛在的財務風險問題。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content is a curated list of links and topics acting as a reference point for current news and specialized industry insights.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容為精選的連結與主題列表，作為當前新聞與專業產業見解的參考資料。

articles.title: The Mismeasure of Open Source
articles.summary_en: The article critiques current open source criticality and risk assessment models for relying on limited, easily accessible data from APIs like GitHub. It highlights how these models suffer from 'missing data' biases, where the absence of a signal is incorrectly treated as zero, leading to inaccurate project evaluations.
articles.summary_zh: 本文批評了目前開源專案的關鍵性與風險評估模型，認為它們過度依賴 GitHub API 等易取得的有限數據。作者指出這些模型存在「缺失數據即為零」的偏誤，導致對專案重要性的評估嚴重失準。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual analysis of the flaws in current methodologies used to evaluate open source project criticality.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文對目前評估開源專案關鍵性的方法論缺陷進行了概念性的分析與探討。

articles.title: Book Review: The Names by Florence Knapp ★★⯪☆☆
articles.summary_en: This review of Florence Knapp's 'The Names' explores the book's narrative structure, which examines the divergent paths of a mother based on the choice of her child's name. Despite acknowledging the author's strong prose and creative storytelling, the reviewer found the heavy themes of domestic violence made the book unenjoyable.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇書評探討了 Florence Knapp 的小說《The Names》，故事透過主角為孩子命名決定的不同分支，呈現了多種人生走向。儘管書評人肯定了作者優美的文筆與巧妙的敘事結構，但書中沉重的家庭暴力主題讓閱讀體驗並不愉快。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content is a subjective critique and analysis of a literary work's themes and structure.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容是對文學作品主題與結構的主觀評論與分析。

articles.title: Pluralistic: Trump's fruitless search for a goreable ox (09 May 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: Cory Doctorow argues that Donald Trump faces an inherent political contradiction: he cannot resolve the cost-of-living crisis without alienating the oligarchs who fund his base. Because these oligarchs profit from the very systems that drive economic suffering, Trump is forced to rely on performative politics instead of actual material reform.
articles.summary_zh: 科里·多克托羅（Cory Doctorow）認為，川普面臨著一個內在的政治矛盾：他無法解決生活成本危機，同時又不觸怒那些資助其基礎選民的寡頭。由於這些寡頭從導致經濟痛苦的體系中獲利，川普被迫轉向表演性政治，而非進行實質性的改革。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual analysis of a political situation, explaining the underlying structural conflict between populist promises and oligarchic influence.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文對政治局勢進行了概念性分析，解釋了民粹主義承諾與寡頭影響力之間潛在的結構性衝突。

articles.title: Quoting Luke Curley
articles.summary_en: This post highlights the inherent conflict between WebRTC's low-latency design and the requirements of voice-based AI applications. The author argues that aggressively dropping packets to maintain real-time performance is detrimental to LLM accuracy, where data integrity is more important than immediate responsiveness.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了 WebRTC 的低延遲設計與語音 AI 應用需求之間的矛盾。作者指出，為了維持即時性而強行丟棄封包的做法，會嚴重影響大型語言模型的輸入準確度，而對於 AI 應用而言，資料完整性往往比即時反應更重要。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content explains the conceptual limitations of WebRTC protocols when applied to LLM voice processing.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容解釋了 WebRTC 協定在應用於大型語言模型語音處理時的概念性局限。

articles.title: George Orwell's review of Russel's Power: A New Social Analysis
articles.summary_en: The author discusses recovering a lost book review by George Orwell regarding Bertrand Russell's 'Power: A New Social Analysis' from the internet archive. This piece highlights the historical significance of the original 1939 review and ensures its continued accessibility for readers.
articles.summary_zh: 作者分享了從網路檔案館中找回喬治·歐威爾針對羅素著作《權力：一種新的社會分析》所寫的書評之過程。這篇文章強調了該 1939 年書評的歷史價值，並確保其內容能再次被公開閱讀。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content acts primarily as a curator, providing access to and historical context for a specific reference document.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文主要扮演策展人的角色，提供特定參考文獻的獲取途徑與歷史背景。

articles.title: Flower: an SSG with a Clojure template language
articles.summary_en: This article introduces Flower, a new static site generator (SSG) that utilizes a Clojure-based template language. It explores the design philosophy behind the project and demonstrates how leveraging Clojure's syntax enhances the flexibility of site generation.
articles.summary_zh: 本文介紹了一款名為 Flower 的靜態網站生成器 (SSG)，其核心特色是使用 Clojure 語言編寫模板。文章探討了該專案的設計理念，並展示了如何利用 Clojure 的語法來提升網站生成的靈活性。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the 'what' and 'why' behind a new software project, focusing on the conceptual design and implementation of the template language.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文解釋了該軟體專案的本質與開發動機，重點在於說明模板語言的概念設計與實作理念。

articles.title: This Week on The Analog Antiquarian
articles.summary_en: The author announces a one-week break from the blog to focus on home and garden maintenance. New content focusing on video games is scheduled to return in two weeks.
articles.summary_zh: 作者宣布下週將暫停部落格更新，以便處理居家與園藝事務。全新的遊戲相關文章預計將於兩週後回歸。
articles.pacer_reason_en: This is a status update announcement regarding the blog's schedule, serving as a reference point for readers.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這是關於部落格發布時程的狀態公告，作為讀者的參考資訊。

articles.title: Notes on the Hantavirus Outbreak
articles.summary_en: This article presents a critical perspective on the environmental and public health risks associated with the cruise ship industry. It suggests that these vessels act as vectors for disease transmission and overall global harm.
articles.summary_zh: 本文從批判的角度探討了遊輪產業對環境與公共衛生的危害。文中指出這類船舶容易成為傳染病的載體，對全球造成負面影響。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content provides a conceptual critique of the cruise industry's impact on health and global society.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對遊輪產業對健康及全球社會的影響提供了概念性的觀點與評論。

articles.title: David Reich – Why the Bronze Age was an inflection point in human evolution
articles.summary_en: Geneticist David Reich discusses the rapid pace of human evolution, emphasizing that natural selection remains a powerful and constant force rather than a dormant process. The conversation explores how the Bronze Age served as a critical turning point for human genetic development and social structure.
articles.summary_zh: 遺傳學家大衛·萊赫探討了人類演化的快速進程，強調自然選擇仍是一種持續且強大的力量。對談重點在於青銅時代如何作為人類基因發展與社會結構演變的關鍵轉折點。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content focuses on explaining biological theories and the conceptual framework of human evolution.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容重點在於解釋生物學理論以及人類演化的概念架構。

articles.title: Wander Console 0.6.0
articles.summary_en: Wander Console 0.6.0 has been released, introducing minor UI updates and removing the 'via' query parameter to improve URL compatibility. This decentralized, self-hosted tool enables independent website owners to share and discover content within a community network.
articles.summary_zh: Wander Console 0.6.0 已發布，此次更新包含介面優化，並移除了可能導致網頁載入錯誤的 'via' 查詢參數。這是一款去中心化且可自託管的網頁工具，讓獨立網站擁有者能共同建立互聯推薦網絡。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions primarily as a release note and reference for a software update.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文主要作為軟體更新的發布說明與參考資訊。

articles.title: The Bold Ones Win
articles.source: Tedium: The Dull Side of the Internet.
articles.summary_en: This article examines the legacy of media mogul Ted Turner by drawing parallels between his audacious business strategies and the modern approach of CEO Ryan Cohen. It reflects on Turner's career of high-stakes risks and bold moves to illustrate the nature of unconventional entrepreneurship.
articles.summary_zh: 本文透過將媒體大亨泰德·透納（Ted Turner）大膽的商業策略，與現代執行長瑞安·科恩（Ryan Cohen）的作風進行對比，探討了其企業傳奇。文章回顧了透納職業生涯中多次高風險的決策，藉此分析非傳統創業精神的本質。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article is primarily structured around comparing the business tactics and personalities of two different entrepreneurs, drawing an analogy between their 'bold' career choices.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文主要透過比較兩位不同創業家的商業策略與個人風格，並在他們「大膽」的職業決策之間建立類比關係。

articles.title: Weekend at Bernie’s
articles.summary_en: The article explores the precarious state of open-source software maintenance, comparing abandoned projects to the film 'Weekend at Bernie's' where appearances are maintained despite the absence of a 'living' maintainer. It highlights the security risks when critical packages lack active oversight, especially as AI-driven vulnerability discovery accelerates, and notes the lack of centralized patching mechanisms in modern language package managers.

Unlike modern social media, Flickr provides the necessary infrastructure for full-resolution, public-domain archiving managed by the Flickr Foundation.

articles.title: Thoughts on WebAssembly as a stack machine
articles.summary_en: This article discusses whether WebAssembly (Wasm) qualifies as a formal stack machine by comparing its architecture to traditional stack-based languages like Forth. The author argues that while Wasm uses a stack for operations, its inclusion of local registers improves code readability and maintainability compared to pure stack machines.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討 WebAssembly (Wasm) 是否符合堆疊機（stack machine）的定義，並將其架構與 Forth 等傳統堆疊語言進行比較。作者認為，儘管 Wasm 運作時使用堆疊，但引入區域暫存器（locals）後，其程式碼的可讀性與可維護性均優於純堆疊機。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explores the conceptual definition of a stack machine and provides an analytical comparison between Wasm and other programming models.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文旨在探討堆疊機的概念定義，並對 Wasm 與其他程式設計模型進行分析比較。

articles.summary_en: The article challenges the common assumption that ibuprofen is safer than acetaminophen based on overdose toxicity. It highlights how focusing on extreme risks can obscure the broader, more important medical consensus regarding the safety profiles of these common painkillers when used as directed.
articles.summary_zh: 本文挑戰了基於過量毒性而認為布洛芬比乙醯胺酚更安全的普遍認知。文章強調，過度關注極端風險可能會掩蓋醫學界對於這些常用止痛藥在正確使用下安全性的核心共識。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the conceptual errors in how individuals evaluate medical risks by contrasting metabolic realities with intuitive but flawed reasoning.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文闡述了人們在評估醫療風險時存在的概念性錯誤，並透過對比代謝事實與直覺上的誤判進行了解釋。

articles.title: Pluralistic: How not to ban surveillance pricing (30 Apr 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: Cory Doctorow critiques Maryland's new consumer protection law, arguing that it fails to effectively curb surveillance pricing due to poor drafting and ignored warnings. He explains that surveillance pricing exploits personal data to maximize costs for consumers, labeling the legislation an ineffective loophole-filled failure.
articles.summary_zh: 科里·多克托羅（Cory Doctorow）批評馬里蘭州新的消費者保護法，認為由於草案撰寫不當且無視警告，該法案無法有效遏制監控定價。他解釋了監控定價如何利用個人數據最大化消費者成本，並稱該法案充滿漏洞且成效不彰。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual explanation of surveillance pricing and analyzes the policy failures behind specific legislative attempts to regulate it.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文對監控定價進行了概念性解釋，並分析了特定立法嘗試背後的政策失敗原因。

articles.title: Have You Seen the New Excel?
articles.summary_en: The author argues that Microsoft Excel is a more powerful and accessible tool than modern software engineering practices, effectively serving as the ultimate no-code solution. By abstracting away complex technical dependencies, Excel allows users to focus on business outcomes rather than the maintenance of fragile codebases.
articles.summary_zh: 作者認為微軟 Excel 比現代軟體工程更具優勢，是一種強大且易於入門的「無程式碼」解決方案。它透過簡化技術複雜性，讓使用者能專注於業務成果，而非維護難以管理的程式碼庫。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article presents a conceptual argument regarding the shift from traditional software development to spreadsheet-based business logic.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提出了一項關於從傳統軟體開發轉向基於試算表的業務邏輯的概念性論點。

articles.title: Anti-DDoS Firm Heaped Attacks on Brazilian ISPs
articles.summary_en: A Brazilian anti-DDoS firm is implicated in facilitating a massive botnet used to attack rival ISPs. The company's CEO claims the unauthorized activity was caused by a security breach orchestrated by a competitor.
articles.summary_zh: 一家巴西防禦 DDoS 攻擊的科技公司被爆料協助運作僵屍網路，對國內其他網路業者發動攻擊。該公司執行長聲稱此惡意活動是因安全漏洞引起，並懷疑是競爭對手為抹黑其形象所為。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article reports on a specific security incident, acting as an investigative journalistic case study of a real-world breach.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對一起特定的安全事件進行報導，屬於對真實駭客攻擊與資安漏洞的調查性案例研究。

articles.title: Quoting Andrew Kelley
articles.summary_en: Andrew Kelley, creator of the Zig programming language, shares his perspective on the distinct 'digital smell' of LLM-generated code in pull requests. He argues that AI-assisted contributions are easily identifiable due to their unique patterns of error, likening the practice to smoking in a non-smoking space.
articles.summary_zh: Zig 程式語言創始人 Andrew Kelley 分享了他對於 AI 生成程式碼在 Pull Request 中所展現的獨特「數位氣味」的看法。他認為 AI 輔助的代碼錯誤模式與人類截然不同，並將在代碼庫中使用 AI 的行為比喻為在禁止吸菸的空間內吸菸。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content relies on an analogy comparing the use of AI in coding to the smell of cigarette smoke to explain how human reviewers detect LLM-assisted contributions.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該內容使用了類比法，將程式設計中使用 AI 的行為比作吸菸的氣味，以解釋人類審閱者如何察覺 AI 輔助的貢獻。

articles.title: We need RSS for sharing abundant vibe-coded apps
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison discusses the need for RSS feeds to distribute 'vibe-coded' micro-apps, mirroring Matt Webb's observation that modern app development is becoming as frequent and personal as blogging. Inspired by this, Willison implemented an Atom feed for his own collection of tools to facilitate easier tracking and discovery.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 探討了利用 RSS 訂閱來發布「氛圍編碼」(vibe-coded) 微型應用的必要性，呼應了 Matt Webb 關於現代軟體開發正變得如同撰寫部落格般頻繁且個性化的觀點。受此啟發，Willison 為其個人工具頁面新增了 Atom 訂閱源，以便於追蹤與發現這些開發成果。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content presents a conceptual shift in how we distribute micro-apps, treating them like blog posts rather than traditional software launches.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該內容提出了一種關於微型應用發布方式的概念性轉變，將其視為如同部落格文章般的發布，而非傳統的軟體發布模式。

articles.title: The Zig project's rationale for their firm anti-AI contribution policy
articles.summary_en: The Zig project maintains a strict policy banning LLM-generated contributions, which has created tension with projects like Bun that rely on AI-assisted development. While critics argue this hinders innovation, Zig maintainers emphasize the importance of human-authored, comprehensible code contributions to the project's long-term integrity.
articles.summary_zh: Zig 專案維持嚴格禁止使用 AI 生成程式碼的政策，這與依賴 AI 輔助開發的 Bun 等專案產生了摩擦。儘管批評者認為此舉阻礙了創新，但 Zig 維護者強調，確保貢獻內容由人類撰寫且易於理解，對於維護專案的長期完整性至關重要。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the rationale and philosophy behind a specific policy, focusing on the conceptual conflict between AI-assisted development and open source project governance.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文旨在說明該政策背後的邏輯與理念，探討 AI 輔助開發與開源專案治理之間的觀念衝突。

articles.title: llm 0.32a1
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison has released version 0.32a1 of the LLM command-line tool. This update specifically fixes a bug related to the incorrect reinflation of tool-calling conversations from SQLite storage.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 發布了 LLM 命令列工具的 0.32a1 版本。此次更新修復了先前版本中關於 SQLite 工具調用對話恢復錯誤的問題。
articles.pacer_reason_en: This is a software release note detailing version updates and bug fixes, serving as reference material for users.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這是詳細說明版本更新與錯誤修正的軟體發布日誌，屬於使用者的參考資料。

articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 發布了 LLM 命令列工具的 0.32a0 版本。本文為簡短的發布公告，引導使用者前往 GitHub 發布頁面及閱讀詳細的註釋說明。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post acts as a reference/announcement for a specific software release version and its documentation links.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文作為特定軟體版本發布與其文件連結的參考公告。

articles.title: Reiner Pope – The math behind how LLMs are trained and served
articles.summary_en: Reiner Pope explores the underlying mathematical principles that govern the training and deployment of Large Language Models. He demonstrates how technical equations can provide significant insights into the development strategies currently employed by AI research labs.
articles.summary_zh: Reiner Pope 探討了大型語言模型（LLM）訓練與部署背後的數學原理。他展示了如何透過簡單的方程式，推導並洞察當前 AI 實驗室的開發策略。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content focuses on explaining the theoretical mathematical framework and conceptual understanding behind LLM operations.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容重點在於解釋大型語言模型運作背後的理論數學框架與概念理解。

articles.title: Multiple URLs in Git Remote
articles.summary_en: This article explains how to configure a single Git remote with multiple URLs to facilitate pushing to several repositories simultaneously. It demonstrates that while pulling always uses the first defined URL, pushing will distribute changes to all configured URLs.
articles.summary_zh: 本文介紹如何為單一 Git 遠端設定多個 URL，以便能同時推送到多個儲存庫。文中說明了在這種配置下，Git 擷取 (fetch) 時會使用第一個 URL，而推送 (push) 時則會同時更新所有設定的 URL。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content provides a clear, step-by-step tutorial on how to configure and use multiple URLs for a Git remote.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供了關於如何設定與使用 Git 多重遠端 URL 的明確操作教學。

articles.title: When The Bill Comes Due
articles.source: Tedium: The Dull Side of the Internet.
articles.summary_en: The article warns that current generative AI tools are heavily subsidized to gain user adoption and will soon face sustainability issues. As companies shift toward usage-based pricing, users are likely to encounter unexpected costs and credit limits that undermine the current AI bubble.
articles.summary_zh: 本文指出目前生成式 AI 工具的高額補貼是為了吸引用戶，但這種模式並不具備永續性。隨著企業轉向按量計費，用戶將面臨意想不到的成本與限制，這預示著 AI 熱潮可能面臨修正。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explores the conceptual and economic shift in AI software models, focusing on the sustainability of the current subscription and pricing landscape.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文探討了 AI 軟體模式的概念與經濟轉變，重點分析了當前訂閱制與定價環境的可持續性問題。

articles.title: On wintering.
articles.summary_en: The concept of 'wintering' describes a period of withdrawal from traditional professional pressures and performance cycles. By stepping away from constant auditing and short-term metrics, individuals gain the freedom to pursue long-term, deep work.
articles.summary_zh: 「冬眠」的概念描述了一種從傳統職業壓力和績效週期中抽離的狀態。通過擺脫持續的審計與短期目標，個人能獲得自由，進而從事長期且深度的研究工作。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the theoretical concept of wintering and its impact on long-term professional behavior.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文解釋了「冬眠」的概念理論及其對長期職業行為的影響。

articles.title: Let's Get Digging!
articles.summary_en: The author shares their experience participating in a public archaeology project at Lesnes Abbey, organized by DigVentures. After a safety briefing, they engaged in hands-on excavation work to help uncover historical artifacts in their local park.
articles.summary_zh: 作者分享了他們參與由 DigVentures 舉辦的萊斯內斯修道院（Lesnes Abbey）考古挖掘計畫的經驗。在完成安全簡報後，他們親身投入挖掘工作，協助探索當地的歷史文物。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post recounts a personal experience and narrative adventure, which serves as an analogous entry point to public participation in archaeology.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這篇文章敘述了個人的經驗與冒險故事，作為參與公眾考古活動的一個生動類比案例。

articles.title: LLM 0.32a0  is a major backwards-compatible refactor
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison has released LLM 0.32a0, a significant refactor of his Python library and CLI tool. This update moves beyond the original text-prompt abstraction to better support modern capabilities like structured JSON output, tool execution, and multi-modal inputs.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 發布了 LLM 0.32a0，這是其 Python 函式庫與 CLI 工具的一次重大重構。此次更新超越了原有的純文字對話模型，以更完善地支援結構化 JSON 輸出、工具調用以及多模態輸入等現代化功能。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the conceptual shift in the library's underlying architecture to accommodate evolving LLM capabilities.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章解釋了該函式庫底層架構的觀念轉變，以適應不斷演進的 LLM 功能。

articles.title: Raspberry Pi Connect may control Windows soon
articles.summary_en: Raspberry Pi is reportedly considering adding support for Windows PC remote control to its Raspberry Pi Connect service. This development aims to evolve the service from a Pi-specific tool into a more robust competitor to established solutions like RealVNC.
articles.summary_zh: Raspberry Pi 據傳正在考慮將 Windows 電腦的遠端控制功能加入到 Raspberry Pi Connect 服務中。此舉旨在將該服務從單純的樹莓派工具，升級為足以與 RealVNC 等成熟軟體競爭的解決方案。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides an update on product features and explains the conceptual strategy behind the evolution of a remote access service.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章針對產品功能更新進行說明，並闡述了該遠端存取服務演進背後的概念性策略。

articles.title: (One) Good AI Is Here
articles.summary_en: Anil Dash critiques the polarized state of the AI industry, where big platforms face criticism for lack of accountability and ethics while zealots make extreme, alarmist claims. He argues for a shift toward 'good AI'—tools that are built with consent and transparency, suggesting that positive, beneficial implementations of LLMs are possible and necessary.
articles.summary_zh: Anil Dash 批評了當前 AI 產業兩極化的現狀，大型平台因缺乏透明度與道德考量而備受質疑，而支持者則過度誇大或散播恐懼。他呼籲轉向「良善 AI」，主張開發具備知情同意與透明度、能真正造福人類而非帶來負面外部影響的技術應用。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explores the conceptual framework of 'good AI' and discusses the societal implications and ethics of current machine learning models.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這篇文章探討了「良善 AI」的概念框架，並討論了當前機器學習模型對社會的影響及倫理問題。

articles.title: The 3rd Annual Blog Post Competition, Extravaganza, and Jamboree
articles.summary_en: This post announces the third iteration of the author's annual blog competition and jamboree. It invites readers to participate in the upcoming writing event.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章宣佈了作者舉辦的年度部落格競賽與慶典邁入第三屆。文中邀請讀者共襄盛舉，參與即將到來的寫作活動。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post functions as an announcement or reference for an upcoming event schedule.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章作為即將到來活動的公告或參考資訊。

articles.title: Weekly Update 501
articles.summary_en: Troy Hunt discusses the emerging trend of creating equality policies for AI bots, highlighting the shift in human-AI interaction. He notes that while the concept is partially tongue-in-cheek, it addresses the evolving necessity for professional conduct in the age of advanced artificial intelligence.
articles.summary_zh: Troy Hunt 探討了為 AI 機器人制定平等政策的新興趨勢，強調人機互動模式的轉變。他指出，雖然此舉帶有諷刺意味，但反映了在先進人工智慧時代，規範人機互動專業行為的必要性。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content explores the conceptual shift in social norms and policies regarding human interactions with artificial intelligence.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該內容探討了關於人類與人工智慧互動的社會規範與政策的概念性轉變。

articles.title: Anthropic Mythos – We’ve Opened Pandora’s Box
articles.summary_en: The article explores the shifting threats in cybersecurity, moving from the long-feared 'quantum apocalypse' to the more immediate and unpredictable risks posed by generative AI. It highlights how the integration of AI into malicious activities represents a fundamental shift in the global threat landscape.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了網路安全威脅的轉變，從長期令人擔憂的「量子末日」轉向由生成式 AI 所帶來的即時且不可預測的風險。文章強調，將 AI 整合至惡意活動中，正代表全球威脅格局的根本性改變。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual analysis of how emerging technologies like AI are fundamentally changing the nature of cybersecurity threats.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對生成式 AI 等新興技術如何從根本上改變網路安全威脅本質，提供了概念性的分析。

articles.title: Collective Speed Is Not the Summation of Individual Speed
articles.summary_en: The article uses the analogy of a 4x100 relay race to argue that individual speed does not directly translate to collective performance. It suggests that, like baton passes in a race, the success of a software development team depends more on the quality of communication and relationships between members than the speed of individual contributors.
articles.summary_zh: 本文透過 4x100 公尺接力賽的比喻，探討個人速度並不等於團隊整體速度的總和。作者認為軟體開發團隊的成功關鍵與接力賽一樣，成員間的溝通互動與介面協作遠比單打獨鬥的個人速度更為重要。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article primarily uses the analogy of an Olympic relay race to explain organizational dynamics and software development efficiency.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章主要透過奧運接力賽的類比，來解釋組織運作與軟體開發效率之間的關聯。

articles.title: Illegal vs Unwanted States
articles.summary_en: The article distinguishes between illegal states, which are fundamentally forbidden, and unwanted states, which are undesirable but potentially recoverable. It argues that systems must be designed to represent and handle these unwanted states because external factors often force systems into them, necessitating effective detection and resolution mechanisms.
articles.summary_zh: 本文區分了「非法狀態」（系統絕對禁止的狀態）與「不想要的狀態」（雖不理想但可能需要暫時容忍的狀態）。作者指出，系統設計必須具備識別與處理這些不想要狀態的能力，因為外部因素往往不可避免地會導致這類情況發生。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual framework for categorizing system states, focusing on the theoretical distinction between illegal and unwanted states.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供了一套系統狀態的分類概念框架，重點在於探討非法狀態與不想要狀態之間的理論區別。

articles.title: Understanding systems
articles.summary_en: This article explores the fundamental principles of systems thinking and how they apply to complex organizational structures. It aims to provide a framework for better decision-making and problem-solving within interconnected environments.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討系統思考的基本原則及其在複雜組織結構中的應用。旨在為互聯環境中的決策與問題解決提供一套分析架構。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on explaining the conceptual framework and theoretical foundations of systems thinking.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文重點在於解釋系統思考的理論架構與基本概念。

articles.title: QuickQWERTY 1.2.2
articles.summary_en: QuickQWERTY 1.2.2 has been released, featuring a critical bug fix for the lesson restart function. The project has also migrated its source code hosting platform to Codeberg, marking its third hosting location in 17 years.
articles.summary_zh: QuickQWERTY 1.2.2 已正式發布，修復了練習頁面重啟功能的錯誤。此外，該專案在運作 17 年後，已將原始碼託管平台遷移至 Codeberg。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as a release note, providing a reference for the latest version and updates to a software project.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文屬於軟體更新公告，為專案的最新版本與變更提供了參考資訊。

articles.title: GitHub Actions is the weakest link
articles.summary_en: The article argues that GitHub Actions has become a major security vulnerability in the open-source supply chain. It highlights how convenient default features, such as mutable dependency tags and permissive workflow triggers, are frequently exploited to compromise repositories and harvest credentials.
articles.summary_zh: 本文指出 GitHub Actions 已成為開源軟體供應鏈中的重大安全漏洞。作者強調，該平台為了方便性而設計的預設功能（如可變動的相依性標籤與寬鬆的工作流程觸發器），常被駭客利用來攻擊儲存庫並竊取憑證。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses specific, documented real-world incidents and examples of security failures to support its argument about systemic vulnerabilities.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文引用了多起實際發生的安全事故與具體案例，藉此支持其關於系統性漏洞的論點。

articles.title: The Loop: everything has happened before, and everything will happen again
articles.summary_en: This article discusses the cyclical nature of human behavior, suggesting that we repeat historical mistakes because our cognitive hardware has remained largely unchanged for millennia. It highlights persistent patterns like financial bubbles and social scapegoating as evidence of our evolutionary limitations.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了人類行為的循環性，認為我們不斷重蹈覆轍是因為大腦的運作機制數千年來並未升級。文中指出諸如金融泡沫與代罪羔羊等現象，皆反映了人類演化上的侷限性。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content focuses on explaining a theory regarding human nature and behavioral patterns.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容側重於解釋關於人性與行為模式的理論。

articles.title: Turning a trick into a technique
articles.summary_en: The author explores the transition from a mathematical 'trick' to a formal 'technique' by generalizing a high-order approximation method. By refining a previous observation involving even functions, the article demonstrates how iterative mathematical patterns can be systematized for broader application.
articles.summary_zh: 作者探討如何將數學中的「技巧」轉化為正式的「技術」，並藉由推廣先前提到的一種高階近似法來實現。透過改良處理偶函數的數學方法，文章展示了如何將特定的操作模式系統化以應用於更廣泛的場景。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on the process of transforming a specific mathematical calculation into a repeatable, systematized technique.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章重點在於將特定的數學計算過程轉化為可重複、系統化的技術方法。

articles.title: Circular arc approximation
articles.summary_en: This article explores the mathematical approximation of a circular arc length using the lengths of the arc's chord and the chord of its half-arc. It provides the geometric derivation to calculate the arc length based on these chord measurements.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了如何利用圓弧的弦長及其半弧的弦長來近似計算圓弧長度。文中提供了相關的幾何推導，說明如何根據這些弦長數據來得出圓弧長度。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content explains a specific mathematical method and derivation for calculating arc length.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容解釋了一種計算圓弧長度的具體數學方法與推導過程。

articles.title: Before GitHub
articles.summary_en: The author reflects on the evolution of Open Source hosting, tracing the shift from tools like SourceForge and Trac to the dominance of GitHub. They discuss how GitHub became a critical social and professional hub for developers while expressing concern over its recent decline and the long-term impact of frictionless code distribution.
articles.summary_zh: 作者回顧了開源軟體託管的演變，從 SourceForge 和 Trac 等早期工具到 GitHub 的壟斷地位。文章討論了 GitHub 如何成為開發者社群的核心社交與專業連結樞紐，同時也表達了對其現狀衰退以及對開源生態系統深遠影響的擔憂。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article is a conceptual reflection on the history of open source infrastructure and the sociological impact of platform shifts.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文是對開源基礎設施歷史及其平台轉移所帶來社會學影響的概念性反思。

articles.title: Developing a cross-process reader/writer lock with limited readers, part 1: A semaphore
articles.summary_en: This article explores the implementation of a cross-process reader/writer lock that restricts the number of concurrent readers. It introduces the use of a semaphore as a fundamental synchronization mechanism to manage access to a shared resource.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了如何實作一個限制讀取者數量的跨行程讀寫鎖。文中介紹了使用信號量（semaphore）作為管理共享資源存取的基礎同步機制。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article is part of a series providing a step-by-step technical guide on developing a specific software locking mechanism.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文屬於技術指南系列的一部分，逐步說明如何開發特定的軟體鎖定機制。

articles.title: Ghostty Is Leaving GitHub
articles.summary_en: Mitchell Hashimoto announces the migration of the Ghostty terminal emulator project away from GitHub. This move marks a significant shift in infrastructure for the open-source project.
articles.summary_zh: Mitchell Hashimoto 宣布 Ghostty 終端機模擬器專案將遷移至 GitHub 以外的平台。此舉標誌著該開源專案在基礎設施選擇上的重大轉變。
articles.pacer_reason_en: This is a conceptual announcement regarding project management and platform strategy.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這是一篇關於專案管理與平台策略的概念性公告。

articles.title: Pluralistic: Vicky Osterweil's "The Extended Universe" (28 Apr 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: Cory Doctorow highlights Vicky Osterweil's 'The Extended Universe,' a critical examination of how Disney's cultural dominance has reshaped the film industry. The post reflects on the power of sharp cultural criticism by comparing it to John Kessel's famous analysis of Orson Scott Card's 'Ender's Game.'
articles.summary_zh: 柯瑞·多克托羅（Cory Doctorow）推薦了薇琪·奧斯特維爾（Vicky Osterweil）的著作《擴展宇宙》，該書深入剖析了迪士尼的文化霸權如何重塑電影產業。本文藉此反思了深度文化評論的影響力，並將其與約翰·凱塞爾（John Kessel）對《安德的遊戲》的經典評論進行了對比。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content focuses on presenting and explaining critical perspectives on cultural and literary works, framing it as conceptual analysis.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容重點在於介紹並闡述對文化與文學作品的批判性觀點，屬於概念性的分析。

articles.title: Don't use localhost:3000, use your own custom domain
articles.summary_en: The author advocates for using custom local domains instead of incrementing localhost ports to improve project management and development workflows. By configuring the system hosts file and a reverse proxy, developers can map friendly URLs to local applications, simplifying navigation and cross-project communication.
articles.summary_zh: 作者建議開發者使用自定義的本地網域，而非依賴不斷累加的 localhost 連接埠，以提升專案管理與開發效率。透過設定系統 hosts 檔案與反向代理伺服器，開發者可以將易記的網址對應至本地應用程式，從而優化開發流程與跨專案的連接需求。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a practical step-by-step guide on how to configure local domains for development projects.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這篇文章提供了具體的逐步指南，說明如何為開發專案配置本地網域。

articles.title: Spring 2026 Dev Contest Results!
articles.summary_en: Eric Migicovsky announces the results of the Spring 2026 Pebble developer contest. Over 500 new applications and watchfaces were submitted by the community.
articles.summary_zh: Eric Migicovsky 公布了 2026 年春季 Pebble 開發者大賽的結果。社群成員總共提交了超過 500 款全新的應用程式與錶面設計。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article reports the results and quantitative data from a completed event.

articles.title: Quoting OpenAI Codex base_instructions
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison highlights a specific constraint found within the OpenAI Codex base instructions. The excerpt reveals a system directive that strictly limits the model from discussing certain mythical creatures or animals unless directly relevant to the user query.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 引用了 OpenAI Codex 基礎指令中的特定限制條款。該指令明確規定，除非與使用者的查詢內容明確相關，否則模型不得討論哥布林、小精靈或其他生物。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content serves as a direct reference to a specific configuration file and system instruction provided by OpenAI.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文內容直接引用並展示了 OpenAI 提供的特定配置文件與系統指令，屬於參考性質內容。

articles.title: Quoting Matthew Yglesias
articles.summary_en: The post quotes Matthew Yglesias reflecting on the current state of AI in software development. Yglesias expresses a preference for professionally managed software products built with AI assistance rather than 'vibe-coding' by individuals.
articles.summary_zh: 本文引用了 Matthew Yglesias 對當前軟體開發中 AI 應用的看法。他表示比起個人化的「vibe-coding」，他更傾向於由專業軟體公司運用 AI 輔助開發，以提供品質更好且更具成本效益的產品。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content presents a conceptual perspective on the industry-wide evolution of AI in software production.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容提出了關於 AI 在軟體生產產業中演變的觀念性觀點。

articles.title: What's new in pip 26.1 - lockfiles and dependency cooldowns!
articles.summary_en: Python's pip 26.1 introduces significant updates, including support for lockfiles via a new command and dependency cooldowns to ensure package stability. The update also drops support for Python 3.9, encouraging users to upgrade to newer environments.
articles.summary_zh: Python 的 pip 26.1 版本引入了重大更新，包括透過新指令支援鎖定檔案 (lockfiles)，以及確保套件穩定性的依賴冷卻機制。此版本同時終止了對 Python 3.9 的支援，鼓勵使用者升級至更新的環境。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article demonstrates how to use new features like pip lockfiles and dependency cooldowns through step-by-step code examples.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文透過逐步的程式碼範例，示範了如何使用 pip 鎖定檔案與依賴冷卻等新功能。

articles.title: Introducing talkie: a 13B vintage language model from 1930
articles.summary_en: Talkie is a new 13B language model trained exclusively on pre-1931 historical English text. The project explores research questions such as the model's ability to predict historical events or independently discover scientific concepts that emerged after its training cutoff.
articles.summary_zh: Talkie 是一個全新的 13B 語言模型，專門使用 1931 年之前的歷史英語文本進行訓練。該項目旨在探討模型是否能預測歷史事件，或是獨立發現訓練資料時間點之後才出現的科學概念。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article conceptually explores the implications and research potential of training language models on historically restricted datasets.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文在概念上探討了使用具有歷史時限的數據集訓練語言模型的意涵及其研究潛力。

articles.title: microsoft/VibeVoice
articles.summary_en: Microsoft has released VibeVoice, an open-source, Whisper-style speech-to-text model featuring built-in speaker diarization. This post provides a practical demonstration of how to run the model locally on a Mac using the uv tool and the mlx-audio library.
articles.summary_zh: 微軟發布了名為 VibeVoice 的開源語音轉文字模型，該模型具備內建的說話者識別（diarization）功能。本文介紹如何透過 uv 工具與 mlx-audio 函式庫，在 Mac 上執行此模型的實作步驟。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a specific command-line tutorial and setup guide for running the VibeVoice model on local hardware.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供具體的指令列教學與設定指南，指導使用者如何在本地硬體上執行 VibeVoice 模型。

articles.title: Collective Speed Is Not the Summation of Individual Speed
articles.summary_en: The article uses the analogy of an Olympic relay race to argue that individual speed does not necessarily translate to team or organizational performance. It highlights that in software development, as in racing, the effectiveness of the connections, interfaces, and coordination between individuals is more critical than the speed of any single contributor.
articles.summary_zh: 本文透過奧運接力賽的比喻，探討個人速度並不等於團隊或組織的總體效率。文章強調在軟體開發中，如同接力賽一樣，個人之間的溝通協作與介面銜接，遠比單一成員的執行速度更為關鍵。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post primarily uses the analogy of a 4x100 relay race to explain organizational dynamics.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章主要利用 4x100 接力賽的比喻來解釋組織動力學。

articles.title: What I've been thinking about this weekend - More open questions, intelligence vs power, the problem of verification in science, the parallel discovery of Darwinism
articles.summary_en: This post is a collection of speculative reflections covering diverse topics such as the nature of intelligence versus power and the verification challenges in scientific research. It also explores historical patterns, specifically the phenomenon of simultaneous or parallel discoveries, exemplified by the development of Darwinism.
articles.summary_zh: 本文彙整了作者對多項議題的深入思考，涵蓋智能與權力的本質、科學驗證的難題，以及達爾文主義發現過程中所展現的同步發現現象。這些反思旨在探討科學發展的規律與人類認知的界限。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content is primarily reflective and theoretical, focusing on exploring concepts and questions rather than providing data or tutorials.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容主要屬於反思性與理論性的探討，側重於對核心概念與議題的延伸思考，而非提供數據或操作指南。

articles.title: The stages of package installation
articles.summary_en: The article decomposes the package installation process into distinct, modular stages to improve understanding and security. It highlights the separation of fetching metadata, which requires network access, and resolution, which involves pure computation to determine version dependencies.
articles.summary_zh: 本文將軟體套件的安裝過程拆解為不同的模組化階段，以提升系統架構的清晰度與安全性。文章重點介紹了「獲取元數據」與「解析依賴關係」兩個階段，並區分了網路需求與純計算邏輯的不同特性。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the fundamental conceptual stages of how package managers function and how they should be architected.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文解釋了套件管理器運作的核心概念階段，以及其架構設計的基本原理。

articles.title: Looking at consequences of passing too few register parameters to a C function on various architectures
articles.summary_en: This article discusses the technical implications of failing to pass the required number of register parameters to C functions. It highlights that this practice causes issues across architectures, with the Itanium architecture being particularly problematic.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了在 C 語言函數呼叫中，若傳遞的暫存器參數數量不足所引發的技術後果。文章指出這種做法在各個架構下都會導致問題，其中 Itanium 架構的情況尤為嚴重。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the conceptual underpinnings and behavioral consequences of ABI-level register parameter handling in C functions.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章解釋了 C 語言函數中 ABI 層級暫存器參數處理的概念基礎及其行為後果。

articles.title: Theatre Review: Hadestown ★★★★★
articles.summary_en: This blog post provides a glowing five-star review of the musical Hadestown, praising its magical production and emotionally resonant performances. The author highlights the intimate, immersive atmosphere of the show, particularly from front-row seating.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇部落格文章對音樂劇《冥界》（Hadestown）給予了五星好評，讚賞其充滿魔力的製作與觸動人心的表演。作者特別提到該劇在舞台前排所營造出的親密感與沉浸式體驗。
articles.pacer_reason_en: This is a subjective review and critique of a theatrical performance, providing an explanation of the author's personal experience.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這是一篇關於戲劇表演的主觀評論與賞析，旨在表達作者的個人觀影體驗與見解。

articles.title: Pluralistic: The enshittification multiverse (27 Apr 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: Cory Doctorow expands the definition of 'enshittification' beyond digital platforms, arguing it describes any systemic practice where value is extracted from users to profit the operator. The post explores how zero-sum economic behaviors, such as surveillance pricing, demonstrate these parasitic dynamics across various sectors.
articles.summary_zh: Cory Doctorow 將「去質化」（enshittification）的概念從數位平台擴展到更廣泛的領域，指出這是指透過犧牲用戶利益來獲取利潤的系統性行為。文章探討了如監控定價等零和博弈現象，如何體現了這種將價值從用戶轉移至操作者的掠奪性本質。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the concept of 'enshittification' as an analogy to explain complex economic behaviors and zero-sum power dynamics across non-digital domains.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章以「去質化」作為類比概念，用來解釋跨領域的複雜經濟行為與零和博弈的權力動態。

articles.title: Tracking the history of the now-deceased OpenAI Microsoft AGI clause
articles.summary_en: The article tracks the evolution and eventual removal of a specific clause in the OpenAI-Microsoft partnership agreement regarding AGI. It examines historical documents and charters to highlight the difficulty of legally defining AGI in commercial contracts.
articles.summary_zh: 本文追蹤了 OpenAI 與微軟合作協議中關於 AGI（通用人工智慧）條款的演變與最終取消。作者透過檢視歷史文件與公開章程，探討在商業合約中對 AGI 進行法律定義的困難性。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as an investigative analysis, providing evidence through historical web archives and document excerpts to track a specific policy change.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文屬於調查分析性質，透過網路檔案庫與文件摘錄提供證據，追蹤特定政策條款的變動歷程。

articles.title: Speech translation in Google Meet is now rolling out to mobile devices
articles.summary_en: Google Meet is expanding its real-time speech translation feature to mobile devices, enabling live cross-lingual communication with voice synthesis. While the technology aims for seamless translation across multiple languages, current performance remains in an early alpha stage with notable reliability issues.
articles.summary_zh: Google Meet 正在將其即時語音翻譯功能擴展至行動裝置，支援跨語言對話與語音合成。儘管該技術旨在實現無縫翻譯，但目前仍處於早期測試階段，在不同裝置間的穩定性表現尚不穩定。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a personal account and observation of a specific feature rollout and performance, functioning as a qualitative case study.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供了作者對特定功能發布及其效能的親身體驗與觀察，屬於質性案例分析。

articles.title: How Bitwarden Encrypts and Decrypts Secrets
articles.summary_en: This article explores the encryption and decryption processes used by Bitwarden and Vaultwarden for storing secrets. The author provides a technical explanation and Python code examples to help readers understand how to interact with and secure these databases independently.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了 Bitwarden 和 Vaultwarden 在儲存密鑰時所使用的加密與解密機制。作者透過技術解析與 Python 程式碼範例，幫助讀者理解如何獨立操作這些資料庫並保障個人資訊安全。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a technical guide and code examples for users to build their own tools for decrypting secrets.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供了技術指南與程式碼範例，引導使用者自行開發工具以解密密鑰。

articles.title: A Mutating AI Powered Virus
articles.summary_en: The article explores the hypothetical evolution of AI-driven computer viruses that leverage large language models to self-replicate and infiltrate networks. It argues that as AI masters physical and operational tasks, it may bypass traditional cybersecurity by 'living' within host machines and mimicking biological viral behavior.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了人工智慧驅動的電腦病毒，認為隨著 AI 逐漸掌握複雜任務，未來可能出現具備自我複製與變異能力的「類病毒」程式。這些病毒能利用大型語言模型滲透網路並潛伏於主機中，對現有的資安防護構成新型威脅。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content focuses on the theoretical evolution and conceptual framework of how AI-based viruses might function and expand.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文主要探討人工智慧病毒的演化理論與概念性架構，解釋其運作邏輯。

articles.title: Reading List 04/25/26
articles.summary_en: This reading list covers a diverse array of technical and industrial topics, ranging from transformer steel production to textile engineering. It also examines large-scale infrastructure challenges, such as the rapid commissioning of power plants and the study of infrasound.
articles.summary_zh: 本閱讀清單涵蓋了變壓器鋼材製造、紡織工程等多元的技術與工業議題。同時探討了大型基礎設施的挑戰，例如快速啟用發電廠以及對次聲波的研究。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content acts as a curated list of references and resources across various technical domains.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該內容為跨多個技術領域的參考資料與資源清單。

articles.title: Closed-form solution to the nonlinear pendulum equation
articles.summary_en: This article discusses the limitations of linearizing the nonlinear pendulum equation by replacing sin θ with θ. It explores how to achieve higher accuracy for larger initial displacements by finding a closed-form solution to the nonlinear model.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了將非線性擺方程線性化（將 sin θ 替換為 θ）所帶來的局限性。文章進一步說明了當初始位移較大時，如何透過尋求非線性模型的閉式解來顯著提升計算準確度。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the theoretical concept of the nonlinear pendulum equation and the mathematical reasoning behind improving linearization accuracy.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文解釋了非線性擺方程的理論概念，並說明提升線性化準確度背後的數學原理。

articles.title: nth derivative of a quotient
articles.summary_en: This article explores the formula for calculating the nth derivative of a quotient, noting that it is significantly more complex than the analogous product rule. It demonstrates the derivation process starting from an unconventional application of the standard quotient rule.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了商的 n 次導數公式，指出其複雜程度遠高於類似的乘積規則。文章從一種非傳統的商規則應用方式出發，逐步推導並說明了該公式的計算過程。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content explains the mathematical concept and theoretical derivation behind a specific derivative formula.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容解釋了特定導數公式背後的數學概念與理論推導。

articles.title: How nonlinearity affects a pendulum
articles.summary_en: This article explores the transition from linear approximations to nonlinear differential equations in pendulum motion. It explains why introductory physics assumes small angles and examines the impact of removing this simplification.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了單擺運動從線性近似到非線性微分方程的轉換。文中解釋了為何入門物理課程通常假設小角度近似，並分析了移除此假設後的實際影響。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on explaining the conceptual physical and mathematical principles behind pendulum motion and the limitations of linear approximations.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文側重於解釋單擺運動背後的物理與數學概念，並探討線性近似的侷限性。

articles.title: You can parse an .env file as an .ini with PHP - but there's a catch
articles.summary_en: This post discusses using PHP's native parse_ini_file() function to read .env files as a lightweight alternative to external libraries. It warns that while the method works, the subtle differences in syntax and behavior between .env and .ini formats can lead to unexpected issues.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了使用 PHP 原生的 parse_ini_file() 函式來解析 .env 檔案，作為使用外部函式庫之外的一種輕量級替代方案。文章同時提醒讀者，由於 .env 與 .ini 格式在語法和行為上存在細微差異，直接轉換可能會導致非預期的錯誤。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains a specific technical implementation method for parsing files in PHP.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章說明了一種在 PHP 中解析檔案的特定技術實作方法。

articles.title: Pluralistic: Ada Palmer's "Inventing the Renaissance" (25 Apr 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: Cory Doctorow highlights Ada Palmer's book 'Inventing the Renaissance,' praising it as a brilliant work of historiography rather than just a history book. articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the underlying theoretical concepts of TLA+ semantics and why they differ from the practical implementation of model checkers.
