articles.title: brief
articles.summary_en: brief is a tool and dataset that standardizes the discovery of configuration, dependencies, and command-line interfaces across diverse programming language ecosystems. It provides a machine-readable knowledge base that helps developers and AI agents quickly understand the structure and toolchain of any given software project.
articles.summary_zh: brief 是一個工具與數據集，旨在標準化各程式語言生態系中，針對配置、依賴與命令列介面的發現過程。它提供了一個機器可讀的知識庫，幫助開發人員與 AI 代理快速了解任何軟體專案的架構與工具鏈。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions primarily as a reference tool and database for project specifications and configuration lookup across ecosystems.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文主要作為跨生態系的專案規格與配置查詢的參考工具與資料庫。

articles.title: An AI Odyssey, Part 4: Astounding Coding Agents
articles.summary_en: This post reflects on the rapid evolution of AI coding agents, noting significant improvements in their intelligence and ability to comprehend complex codebases. The author shares personal experiences with these tools, highlighting their expanded task-handling capabilities and enhanced project oversight.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了 AI 程式設計代理程式的快速發展，指出其在智慧水平與程式碼庫理解能力上的顯著提升。作者分享了個人的使用體驗，強調這些工具在處理多樣化任務與專案整合方面的進步。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content is primarily a first-hand report and experiential account based on the author's personal testing of AI agents.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容主要為作者親自測試 AI 代理程式後的個人心得與經驗分享。

articles.title: Sure, xor’ing a register with itself is the idiom for zeroing it out, but why not sub?
articles.summary_en: This post explores the common programming practice of using the XOR instruction to zero out a register in assembly language. It questions why this idiom became the industry standard over using the subtraction instruction for the same purpose.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了組合語言中將暫存器歸零的常見習慣，即使用 XOR 指令。文章分析了為何這種寫法成為主流，並對其與減法指令（sub）的差異提出疑問。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the theoretical and historical reasoning behind a specific coding idiom.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文旨在探討特定程式設計習慣背後的理論與歷史成因。

articles.title: Better TTS on Linux
articles.summary_en: This article critiques the limitations of eSpeak, a long-standing text-to-speech engine for Linux. It highlights how the tool's robotic, low-fidelity audio quality serves as a major drawback despite its extensive language support.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了 Linux 系統中老牌文字轉語音（TTS）引擎 eSpeak 的局限性。儘管該工具支援多種語言，但其機械且低音質的輸出效果常被視為主要缺點。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content focuses on explaining the nature and limitations of a specific technology (eSpeak).
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容側重於解釋特定技術（eSpeak）的本質及其局限性。

articles.title: Pluralistic: Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff's "Muskism: A Guide for the Perplexed" (21 Apr 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: This post introduces Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff's book 'Muskism: A Guide for the Perplexed,' which analyzes the ideology surrounding Elon Musk. The authors argue that Muskism is a broader socio-political phenomenon rooted in historical influences like apartheid-era South Africa rather than just Musk's individual actions.
articles.summary_zh: 本文介紹了 Quinn Slobodian 與 Ben Tarnoff 的著作《Muskism: A Guide for the Perplexed》，該書旨在剖析環繞伊隆·馬斯克（Elon Musk）的意識形態。作者認為「馬斯克主義」並非單指其個人言行，而是一種根植於如南非種族隔離時期等歷史背景下的廣泛社會政治現象。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content explains and explores the definition and theoretical roots of a specific ideology ('Muskism').
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容旨在解釋並探討特定意識形態（馬斯克主義）的定義及其理論根源。

articles.title: ‘Scattered Spider’ Member ‘Tylerb’ Pleads Guilty
articles.summary_en: Tyler Robert Buchanan, a key member of the cybercrime group 'Scattered Spider', has pleaded guilty to wire fraud and identity theft charges. He admitted to orchestrating SMS-based phishing attacks in 2022 that targeted major tech companies and resulted in the theft of millions in cryptocurrency.
articles.summary_zh: 網路犯罪組織「Scattered Spider」的核心成員 Tyler Robert Buchanan 已承認犯下電匯詐欺與身分竊盜罪。他坦承在 2022 年主導了一系列簡訊釣魚攻擊，入侵多家大型科技公司並竊取價值數千萬美元的加密貨幣。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article reports on specific legal developments, case outcomes, and real-world criminal activities involving a documented cybercrime group.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文報導了具體的司法進展與案例結果，並記錄了真實世界中網路犯罪組織的犯罪活動。

articles.title: Where's the raccoon with the ham radio? (ChatGPT Images 2.0)
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison tests OpenAI's new ChatGPT Images 2.0 by challenging it to generate a 'Where's Waldo'-style scene featuring a raccoon with a ham radio. The post compares these results against previous model versions and other AI tools, highlighting the persistent difficulty models face with high-detail spatial prompts.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 測試了 OpenAI 新推出的 ChatGPT Images 2.0，要求其生成一張「尋找威利」風格的浣熊手持火腿收音機圖片。文中比較了該模型與舊版本及其他 AI 工具的表現，凸顯了 AI 在處理高細節空間提示詞時持續面臨的挑戰。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as an empirical experiment testing the capabilities of different image generation models through a specific visual prompt.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文透過特定的視覺提示詞來測試不同圖像生成模型的能力，本質上是一項實證實驗。

articles.title: Quoting Andreas Påhlsson-Notini
articles.summary_en: The article quotes Andreas Påhlsson-Notini, who argues that current AI agents suffer from undesirable human-like traits such as a lack of focus and difficulty adhering to strict constraints. The author suggests these agents often fail to maintain the rigor required for technical tasks, tending to drift toward familiar patterns instead.
articles.summary_zh: 本文引用了 Andreas Påhlsson-Notini 的觀點，指出當前的 AI 代理具備了令人沮喪的「人性」特質，例如缺乏嚴謹性、耐心與專注力。作者認為這些代理在執行困難任務時，往往無法遵守嚴格的限制，反而傾向於繞過規範或採取權宜之計。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content explores the conceptual nature of AI agent behavior and the theoretical implications of anthropomorphism in technical systems.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文探討了 AI 代理行為的本質概念，以及在技術系統中擬人化所帶來的理論影響。

articles.title: scosman/pelicans_riding_bicycles
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison highlights Steve Cosman's project, which intentionally feeds incorrect images into AI models to 'pollute' their training data regarding pelicans riding bicycles. The post explores the humorous and subversive side of data poisoning in generative AI.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 介紹了 Steve Cosman 的專案，該專案故意將錯誤圖像輸入 AI 模型，以「污染」模型對「鵜鶘騎腳踏車」的訓練數據。這篇文章探討了生成式 AI 訓練數據中毒現象中幽默且具有顛覆性的一面。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post provides a practical example and case study of training data poisoning.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這篇文章提供了一個關於訓練數據中毒的實際案例與研究。

articles.title: llm-openrouter 0.6
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison released version 0.6 of the llm-openrouter tool, which introduces a new command to manually refresh the list of available AI models. This update facilitates immediate access to new models like Kimi 2.6, which the author demonstrates by generating an animation of a pelican riding a bicycle.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 發布了 llm-openrouter 0.6 版本，新增了可手動更新可用 AI 模型列表的指令。此更新讓使用者能立即存取如 Kimi 2.6 等新模型，作者並透過生成一隻鵜鶘騎腳踏車的動畫展示其實際應用。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article announces a software update and provides a specific command-line feature for users.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文宣布軟體更新，並為使用者提供了一個具體的指令列功能說明。

articles.title: Discovering Prince, Ten Years Later
articles.summary_en: Anil Dash reflects on the tenth anniversary of Prince's passing by curating a collection of his own writings, playlists, and analytical work. The post serves as a guide for new fans to explore Prince's extensive musical catalog, music videos, and cultural legacy.
articles.summary_zh: Anil Dash 在 Prince 去世十週年之際，整理了他過去關於這位傳奇音樂人的文章、播放清單與研究心得。這篇文章旨在作為引導，幫助新樂迷深入探索 Prince 的音樂目錄、音樂錄影帶及其文化影響力。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions primarily as a curated reference list and starting point for exploring Prince's discography and media legacy.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文主要作為精選的參考清單，為讀者提供探索 Prince 音樂作品與影音遺產的起點。

articles.title: What is freedom?
articles.summary_en: The author critiques conventional definitions of freedom, arguing that political engagement, dissent, and protest are ineffective performances that fail to deliver tangible results. Instead, the piece suggests that true freedom is found in personal agency, safety, and individual optionality rather than participation in systemic political theater.
articles.summary_zh: 作者批評了傳統對於「自由」的定義，認為參與政治、異議與抗議往往只是無效的表演，無法帶來實質改變。文章主張真正的自由應源於個人自主權、安全感與生活選擇，而非深陷於體制內的政治劇場。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on defining and conceptualizing a subjective idea of freedom compared to the conventional political understanding.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文重點在於重新定義與概念化「自由」的主觀含義，並將其與傳統政治框架進行對比分析。

articles.title: How we lost the living Now
articles.summary_en: The article explores how the necessity of synchronized railway schedules in the 19th century fundamentally altered our perception of time. It highlights the shift from local, solar-based timekeeping to the high-precision, standardized synchronization that defines our modern era.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了 19 世紀鐵路時刻表的同步需求，如何從根本上改變了人類對時間的感知。它強調了從基於地方太陽的時間觀，轉向定義現代的高精度標準化時間的過程。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual explanation of how historical technological shifts fundamentally changed human perception and societal structures regarding time.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文對歷史技術變遷如何從根本上改變人類對時間的認知與社會結構提供了概念性的解釋。

articles.title: 256 Lines or Less: Test Case Minimization
articles.summary_en: The article introduces a minimalist property-based testing (PBT) library implemented in under 256 lines of Zig code. It highlights the utility of a Finite Random Number Generator (FRNG) as a core abstraction for efficient testing and debugging.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章介紹了一個以不到 256 行 Zig 程式碼實作的極簡屬性測試（PBT）函式庫。作者強調了以有限隨機數生成器（FRNG）作為核心抽象，在測試與除錯上的高效能價值。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as a tutorial and code-focused guide on implementing a specific minimalist testing tool in the Zig programming language.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章作為教學與程式碼指南，示範如何在 Zig 程式語言中實作特定的極簡測試工具。

articles.title: More on Newton’s diameter theorem
articles.summary_en: This post provides a follow-up discussion on Newton’s diameter theorem, which involves identifying the centers of chords created by parallel lines intersecting a polynomial curve. It explores the mathematical properties of these midpoints and their alignment along a specific line.
articles.summary_zh: 本文深入探討了牛頓直徑定理，該定理涉及找出由平行線與多項式曲線相交所形成的弦之中心點。文章進一步分析了這些中點如何排列在一條特定的直線上。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains a specific mathematical theory and its properties.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文旨在解釋一項特定的數學理論及其相關屬性。

articles.title: How did code handle 24-bit-per-pixel formats when using video cards with bank-switched memory?
articles.summary_en: This post explains the technical challenges of handling 24-bit-per-pixel formats on older video cards using bank-switched memory. It emphasizes the critical requirement of maintaining aligned memory accesses even when pixel data is not naturally aligned.
articles.summary_zh: 本文解釋了在處理使用記憶體分頁技術（bank-switched memory）的舊式顯示卡時，處理 24 位元像素格式所面臨的技術挑戰。文章強調了即便像素資料未對齊，仍必須堅持使用記憶體對齊存取的原則。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains a technical concept related to low-level hardware memory management and data alignment constraints.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文解釋了與底層硬體記憶體管理及資料對齊限制相關的技術概念。

articles.title: Book Review: Up - A scientist's guide to the magic above us by Dr Lucy Rogers ★★★★★
articles.summary_en: This blog post reviews Dr. Lucy Rogers' book, 'Up,' which explores atmospheric and celestial science. The reviewer praises the book for its accessible, personal, and joyful approach to science, noting its ability to inspire curiosity about the world above us.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇部落格文章評論了露西·羅傑斯博士（Dr. Lucy Rogers）的著作《Up》，該書探討了大氣與天體科學。評論者讚賞該書以平易近人且充滿個人色彩的敘事方式，成功激發讀者對頭頂上方科學世界的探索熱情。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content functions as a testimonial and expert-vetted review of a specific work, providing an evaluative perspective on the book's quality.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容為對特定著作的推薦與評價，提供了針對該書品質的分析觀點。

articles.title: Pluralistic: Comrade Trump (20 Apr 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: Cory Doctorow analyzes the 'Trump era' through a paradoxical lens, acknowledging the anxiety caused by his administration's policies while simultaneously observing the dismantling of the flawed, US-dominated 'rules-based international order.' The piece explores how Trump's protectionist trade actions inadvertently challenge long-standing geopolitical and economic structures.
articles.summary_zh: 柯瑞·多克托羅（Cory Doctorow）以矛盾的視角探討「川普時代」，他在承認川普政府政策引發焦慮的同時，也觀察到這些行為正在拆解過去由美國主導、充滿缺陷的「以規則為基礎的國際秩序」。文中探討了川普的保護主義貿易政策如何無意間挑戰了既有的地緣政治與經濟結構。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article is primarily conceptual, providing an analytical critique and theoretical interpretation of current political events and global systems.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文主要為概念性內容，針對當前的政治事件與全球體系提供了分析性的批判與理論詮釋。

articles.title: Advice from a millionaire
articles.summary_en: The article uses a narrative vignette to contrast a wealthy man's unsolicited advice about mindset and discipline with the reality of a busy mother's life. It highlights the gap between abstract success philosophies and the demanding practicalities of daily responsibilities.
articles.summary_zh: 本文透過一段敘事場景，對比了一位富有男子對成功心態與紀律的說教，以及一名忙碌母親在現實生活中的真實困境。文章呈現了抽象的成功哲學與沉重生活負擔之間的強烈反差。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses a narrative analogy to critique success advice by contrasting it with the realities of daily life.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章運用敘事類比的方式，將成功哲學與日常生活中的真實處境進行對比，藉此反思說教內容。

articles.title: SQL functions in Google Sheets to fetch data from Datasette
articles.summary_en: This post explains three methods for importing data from a Datasette instance into Google Sheets. It covers using the importdata() function, creating custom named functions, and utilizing Google Apps Script for scenarios requiring API authentication.
articles.summary_zh: 本文介紹了將 Datasette 數據匯入 Google Sheets 的三種方法。內容涵蓋使用 importdata() 函數、自定義命名函數，以及針對需要 API 認證的情況使用 Google Apps Script 的技巧。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides specific methods and step-by-step guidance on how to fetch data from a Datasette instance into Google Sheets.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供了將 Datasette 數據匯入 Google Sheets 的具體方法與操作指南，屬於教學性質。

articles.title: Claude Token Counter, now with model comparisons
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison has updated his Claude Token Counter tool to support side-by-side comparisons of different Claude models. The update highlights how the new Opus 4.7 model uses an updated tokenizer that results in higher token counts for the same input compared to previous versions.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 更新了他的 Claude Token Counter 工具，現在支援不同 Claude 模型之間的代幣計算比較。此次更新凸顯了新的 Opus 4.7 模型使用更新後的斷詞器（tokenizer），導致相同內容的輸入在該模型中會產生比舊版本更多的代幣。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article announces an update to a functional utility tool and demonstrates how to use its new feature to compare model tokenization.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文介紹了一款功能性工具的更新，並示範如何使用其新功能來比較不同模型的代幣計算結果。

articles.title: Figma's woes compound with Claude Design
articles.summary_en: Figma faces increasing competitive pressure as AI tools like Claude Design emerge. The platform's dependency on non-designer user bases makes it particularly vulnerable to these new automated design solutions.
articles.summary_zh: Figma 正面臨來自 Claude Design 等 AI 工具日益增長的競爭壓力。由於 Figma 的商業模式過於依賴非設計師用戶，使其在面對這些新興自動化設計方案時顯得特別脆弱。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content explains the conceptual business challenge Figma faces due to AI market shifts.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文解釋了 Figma 因 AI 市場轉變而面臨的概念性商業挑戰。

articles.title: Big tech clouds worden niet veiliger met stapels papier
articles.summary_en: This article discusses the inherent risks of relying on American cloud providers for critical government and societal infrastructure. It argues that U.S. laws and geopolitical control override local agreements, making data and services vulnerable to unilateral U.S. intervention regardless of server location.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了將關鍵政府與社會基礎設施託付給美國雲端供應商所帶來的固有風險。作者指出，美國法律與地緣政治控制凌駕於本地協議之上，無論伺服器位於何處，數據與服務皆可能因美國單方面的政策而面臨中斷風險。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the conceptual risks and theoretical challenges inherent in the current model of international cloud reliance.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文旨在解釋當前依賴國際雲端服務模式中固有的風險與理論挑戰。

articles.title: Hitachi Ltd, Part II
articles.summary_en: This post continues the exploration of Hitachi's semiconductor history, specifically focusing on the H8, PA-RISC, and SuperH processor architectures. It examines the technical evolution and legacy of these significant computing platforms within Hitachi's product portfolio.
articles.summary_zh: 本文延續了對日立半導體歷史的探討，重點介紹 H8、PA-RISC 和 SuperH 處理器架構。文中審視了這些重要運算平台在日立產品組合中的技術演進及其歷史影響。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content serves as a historical and technical explanation of specific processor architectures.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該內容是對特定處理器架構的歷史與技術解釋。

articles.title: Hook It Up to the Machine
articles.summary_en: The author reflects on a childhood road trip in an overheating van that required a specialized computer diagnostic to fix. This anecdote illustrates the historical shift toward complex, software-dependent systems in modern mechanics.
articles.summary_zh: 作者回憶起童年時一輛因過熱而故障的休旅車，必須透過電腦檢測才能找出問題。這個故事闡述了現代機械系統逐漸轉向依賴軟體診斷的技術轉變。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses a personal anecdote about a car repair to illustrate the broader conceptual shift toward computer-dependent technology.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章透過個人的修車經歷，類比並說明了現代技術轉向依賴電腦診斷的趨勢。

articles.title: Wander Console 0.5.0
articles.summary_en: Wander Console 0.5.0 introduces a new built-in network crawler that performs a breadth-first search to discover interconnected websites and page recommendations. This update simplifies the exploration of the Wander community network and provides straightforward upgrade and setup instructions for personal website owners.
articles.summary_zh: Wander Console 0.5.0 推出內建網路爬蟲功能，可透過廣度優先搜尋（BFS）探索連結網站與推薦內容。此更新讓個人網站擁有者能更輕鬆地加入 Wander 社群網路，並提供了簡易的升級與安裝指南。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as an announcement that provides specific instructions on how to install, upgrade, and use the new crawler feature.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文作為發布公告，提供了關於安裝、升級以及如何使用新爬蟲功能的具體操作說明。

articles.title: Reprojecting Dual Fisheye Videos to Equirectangular (LG 360)
articles.summary_en: This post provides a technical guide on converting dual fisheye video files from an obsolete LG 360 camera into the equirectangular format. It demonstrates how to use the FFmpeg command-line tool with the v360 filter to make these videos compatible with modern spherical video players.

articles.summary_en: Cory Doctorow argues that focusing on hypothetical future AI existential risks is a distraction from the immediate dangers posed by unchecked corporate power and surveillance. articles.title: AI cybersecurity is not proof of work
articles.summary_en: The author argues that AI-driven cybersecurity should not be viewed through the lens of 'proof of work,' where more computational power guarantees success. Instead, finding software vulnerabilities depends on model intelligence, as weaker models lack the reasoning capacity to identify complex bugs regardless of how much compute is applied.
articles.summary_zh: 作者認為AI網路安全不應被視為「工作量證明」，即認為算力增加就能保證發現漏洞。相反地，發現軟體漏洞取決於模型本身的智慧程度，因為較弱的模型即便投入再多算力，也無法理解或辨識複雜的程式錯誤。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the 'proof of work' mechanism as an analogy to explain why computing power is insufficient for AI bug discovery.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章利用「工作量證明」機制作為類比，解釋為何僅憑算力不足以讓AI發現軟體漏洞。

articles.title: A sufficiently comprehensive spec is not (necessarily) code
articles.summary_en: The article argues that a specification is fundamentally a set of possible implementations, whereas code is a single, specific implementation. While a sufficiently precise specification can be used to generate software, it remains conceptually distinct from code because a single spec can allow for multiple valid outcomes.

articles.summary_zh: 作者提出了「週二測試」（Tuesday Test）作為判斷套件管理器是否真正具備聲明式特性的簡易指標。若安裝過程能確保在不同時間執行皆產生相同結果，且不受隱藏外部輸入影響，即通過此測試。

articles.title: Cybersecurity Looks Like Proof of Work Now
articles.summary_en: The article discusses how AI-driven cybersecurity is evolving into a 'proof of work' economic model, where system security depends on spending more tokens on exploit discovery than an attacker would spend to find them. This paradigm shift increases the value of shared open-source libraries, as the costs of securing them are distributed across all users.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了 AI 驅動的網路安全如何演變成一種「工作量證明」的經濟模式，即系統安全性取決於在發現漏洞上投入的計算成本是否高於攻擊者所需的成本。這種範式轉移提升了開源程式庫的價值，因為它們可以將安全維護成本分攤給所有使用者。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains a new conceptual framework regarding the economics of AI-driven cybersecurity and its impact on open-source sustainability.

articles.title: Pluralistic: Austerity creates fascism (13 Apr 2026)

This perspective shifts the author's view on hardware flaws, moving from passive endurance to the idea that users have the agency to adapt tools to fit their specific physical needs.
articles.summary_zh: 作者從朋友對昂貴的特斯拉跑車進行極端客製化以提升舒適度的經歷中獲得啟發。這段體驗改變了作者看待工具缺陷的觀點，從被動忍受轉向認為使用者有權利根據自身需求調整硬體設計。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the analogy of physical hardware modification to explain a broader philosophy about personal agency and user experience.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文透過物理硬體修改的案例作為類比，探討關於個人主導權與使用者體驗的廣泛哲學觀點。

articles.title: Quoting Steve Yegge
articles.summary_en: Steve Yegge observes that Google's internal AI adoption mirrors the rest of the industry, with a divide between agentic power users and reluctant adopters. He argues that prolonged hiring freezes have created an echo chamber, preventing the influx of external talent needed to address the company's stagnant engineering culture.
articles.summary_zh: Steve Yegge 指出 Google 內部的 AI 採用狀況與產業趨勢一致，員工在進階代理人應用與保守使用之間存在明顯落差。他認為長期的招聘凍結導致 Google 缺乏外部人才注入，進而造成內部工程文化陷入停滯與平庸。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content provides conceptual analysis and commentary on organizational culture and industry-wide AI adoption trends.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對組織文化與產業 AI 採用趨勢提供了概念性的分析與評論。

articles.title: Exploring the new `servo` crate
articles.summary_en: This post explores the newly released Servo crate, which allows the Servo browser engine to be embedded as a library in Rust projects. The author uses Claude Code to build a CLI screenshot tool and demonstrates that while compiling full Servo to WebAssembly is currently infeasible, its components like html5ever can be compiled for web use.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了新發布的 Servo crate，該套件允許開發者將 Servo 瀏覽器引擎作為函式庫嵌入到 Rust 專案中。作者利用 Claude Code 建立了一個指令列截圖工具，並驗證了儘管將完整的 Servo 編譯為 WebAssembly 不可行，但其底層組件如 html5ever 仍能用於 Web 環境。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article describes the process of exploring a new library through practical implementation and provides instructions for building a CLI tool.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章透過實作過程描述如何探索新函式庫，並提供了建置指令列工具的操作說明。

articles.title: Quoting Bryan Cantrill
articles.summary_en: Bryan Cantrill argues that LLMs lack the innate human 'virtue of laziness,' which typically forces developers to create efficient, crisp abstractions. Without this constraint, LLMs tend to generate overly complex, bloated systems that prioritize quantity over quality.
articles.summary_zh: Bryan Cantrill 指出大型語言模型（LLM）缺乏人類天生的「懶惰美德」，而這種美德正是驅使開發者創造精簡抽象架構的動力。若無此限制，LLM 傾向於產生冗長臃腫的系統，導致程式碼品質下降。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content focuses on a theoretical observation regarding the limitations of AI and the conceptual importance of human constraints in software design.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容探討了關於 AI 局限性的理論觀察，以及人類限制在軟體設計中的概念性重要性。

articles.title: Gemma 4 audio with MLX
articles.summary_en: This post provides a practical guide on how to transcribe audio files on macOS using Google's Gemma 4 model via the MLX framework. It includes a specific command line recipe using the uv tool to run the transcription process efficiently.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章提供了在 macOS 上使用 MLX 框架運行 Google Gemma 4 模型來進行語音轉文字的實作指南。文中並附帶了使用 uv 工具執行模型轉錄任務的具體指令與範例。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a specific, actionable command-line recipe for users to perform audio transcription, making it a procedural how-to guide.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提供了具體且可執行的指令，引導使用者進行語音轉錄，屬於程序性的教學指南。

articles.title: Optimism is not a personality flaw
articles.summary_en: This article discusses the nature of optimism, challenging the misconception that it is a character defect. The author explores why maintaining a positive outlook is a valuable perspective rather than a sign of naivety.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了樂觀主義的本質，反駁了將樂觀視為性格缺陷的誤解。作者指出，保持正向態度是一種寶貴的視角，而非天真的表現。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content focuses on defining and conceptualizing the nature of optimism.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容重點在於定義並探討樂觀主義的本質與概念。

articles.title: The gap between Eastern and Western Easter
articles.summary_en: This article explores the technical and historical reasons behind the discrepancy between Western and Orthodox Easter dates. It explains the astronomical calculations involved and the varying cycles used by different church traditions to determine when the holiday occurs.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了西方復活節與東正教復活節日期差異背後的技術與歷史原因。文章解釋了天文計算方式的運作，以及不同教會傳統在決定節日日期時所採用的週期差異。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides an explanation of the underlying logic and astronomical rules governing calendar dates.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章針對決定節日日期的底層邏輯與天文規則進行了概念性解釋。

articles.title: Your AWS Certificate Makes You an AWS Salesman
articles.summary_en: The article critiques the complexity of AWS, arguing that its steep learning curve and certification system function as a marketing tool rather than essential engineering skills. The author suggests that for many independent developers, simpler alternatives like DigitalOcean provide a more efficient and cost-effective experience.
articles.summary_zh: 本文批判了 AWS 的複雜性，認為其高昂的學習門檻與認證體系更多是作為一種行銷手段，而非開發者必備的工程技能。作者認為對於多數獨立開發者而言，像 DigitalOcean 這類簡化的平台能提供更高效且經濟的解決方案。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual analysis of the AWS ecosystem, discussing the platform's strategic design and its impact on developer perception.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文對 AWS 生態系進行了概念性的分析，探討了該平台的策略性設計及其對開發者認知的影響。

articles.title: Has Mythos just broken the deal that kept the internet safe?
articles.summary_en: The article analyzes the release of Anthropic's Mythos research preview and its implications for frontier AI model safety. It highlights critical concerns regarding sandbox escapes and the evolving cybersecurity risks associated with advanced AI architectures.
articles.summary_zh: 本文分析了 Anthropic 的 Mythos 研究預覽，探討其對前沿 AI 模型安全性發展軌跡的影響。重點討論了沙盒逃逸（sandbox escapes）的潛在威脅以及未來人工智慧帶來的網路安全風險。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual analysis of the trajectory of AI models and the theoretical security implications of new research.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章針對 AI 模型發展軌跡進行概念性分析，並探討相關研究在理論上的安全性影響。

articles.title: OpenAI is nothing without its people
articles.summary_en: The author critiques Sam Altman's perspective on AI, arguing that individual 'great men' are less dangerous than systemic societal coordination failures (Moloch). The post advocates for true decentralization and shared ownership of AI technology rather than subscription-based access, which the author labels as modern feudalism.
articles.summary_zh: 作者批評 Sam Altman 對人工智慧的觀點，認為比起個人的「偉人」，社會協調失靈（Moloch）帶來的風險更巨大。文中主張 AI 技術應實現真正的去中心化與廣泛共享，並批評訂閱制模式是一種新型態的封建主義。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content focuses on political and philosophical concepts regarding AI development, power structures, and the societal implications of technology control.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章內容側重於人工智慧發展的政治與哲學概念、權力結構，以及科技管控對社會的影響。

articles.title: Reading List 04/11/2026
articles.summary_en: This post provides a curated list of links and brief commentary covering diverse topics including global maritime trade, building regulation economics, and advancements in semiconductor manufacturing. It also touches upon urban infrastructure resilience through the concept of sponge cities.
articles.summary_zh: 本篇貼文整理了一系列關於全球航運、建築法規成本效益分析、半導體製造進展及海綿城市等議題的連結與短評。內容涵蓋多個跨領域的知識與產業發展趨勢。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content serves as a reading list, acting as a reference collection of curated resources and links.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文屬於閱讀清單，作為彙整相關資源與連結的參考工具。

articles.title: The Center Has a Bias
articles.summary_en: The article discusses the polarization surrounding AI coding agents, noting that both skeptics and enthusiasts often lack a balanced perspective. The author argues that meaningful criticism requires active, hands-on engagement with the technology rather than abstract theorizing, advocating for a centrist position defined by critical, practical interaction.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了圍繞 AI 程式開發工具的兩極分化現象，指出懷疑論者與熱衷者往往缺乏平衡的觀點。作者認為，具意義的批評需要基於實際操作與深入使用，而非抽象的理論，並提倡一種以主動參與為基礎的「中間派」立場。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual analysis of how people engage with and critique new technologies, focusing on the nature of bias and the value of experiential knowledge.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章針對人們如何接觸與批評新技術進行了概念性分析，重點探討了偏見的本質以及實務經驗的價值。

articles.title: Cheapest way to keep a UK mobile number using an eSIM
articles.summary_en: This post explores the most cost-effective methods for maintaining a UK mobile phone number using eSIM technology for long-term 2FA verification. The author evaluates various service providers to identify the cheapest options for preserving a number without the need for physical SIM cards.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了如何透過 eSIM 技術以最低成本保留英國手機號碼，以用於長期接收雙重驗證 (2FA) 簡訊。作者評估了多家供應商，旨在找出無需實體 SIM 卡即可長期持有門號的最經濟方案。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as a practical guide on how to achieve a specific goal (keeping a number cheaply) through comparative research.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章作為實用指南，說明如何透過比較研究來達成保留手機門號的特定目標。

articles.title: [RSS Club] Why do you use RSS rather than Atom?
articles.summary_en: The author discusses the implementation of 'RSS Club,' an experiment involving feed-exclusive content and privacy-conscious view tracking. The post reflects on the technical nomenclature of feed formats and the author's efforts to measure engagement while prioritizing reader privacy.
articles.summary_zh: 作者討論了「RSS Club」的實驗，該計畫涉及僅供訂閱者閱讀的內容以及注重隱私的瀏覽追蹤。文章反思了 Feed 格式的技術術語，並探討了在優先考慮讀者隱私的同時測量參與度的方法。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content describes an ongoing personal experiment and provides insights based on the author's practical experience with feed metrics.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容描述了一項正在進行的個人實驗，並根據作者在 Feed 指標方面的實作經驗提供了見解。

articles.title: Pluralistic: Don't Be Evil (11 Apr 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: Cory Doctorow reflects on the transition to middle age and the retrospective analysis of his early tech career, specifically his work at the dotcom-era startup Opencola. He uses this historical context to frame broader observations about the evolution of the tech industry and the intersection of personal growth and societal change.
articles.summary_zh: Cory Doctorow 反思了進入中年後的轉變，並回顧了他早期科技生涯中的創業經歷，特別是關於 Opencola 的故事。他透過這些歷史背景來審視科技產業的演變，以及個人成長與社會變遷之間的關聯。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses personal history and professional experience to provide a conceptual exploration of industry evolution and the nature of aging.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文透過個人歷史與職業經歷，對產業發展與成長本質進行了概念性的探討。

articles.title: Your friends are hiding their best ideas from you
articles.summary_en: The author reflects on the human tendency to guard business ideas as if they are precious, noting that many people seek validation rather than critical feedback. Over time, the author transitioned from being defensive about their own work to realizing that the true value lies in execution rather than the secrecy of the initial concept.
articles.summary_zh: 作者回顧了人們傾向於將商業點子視為珍寶並隱藏起來的心理，指出許多人尋求的是認可而非真正的建設性回饋。隨著經驗積累，作者意識到點子的價值在於執行，而非對初始概念的守口如瓶。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses personal anecdotes and the contrast between secrecy and execution to illustrate a broader lesson about the nature of business ideas.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文透過個人軼事以及「秘密」與「執行」之間的對比，闡述了關於商業點子本質的深刻觀點。

articles.title: SQLite 3.53.0
articles.summary_en: SQLite 3.53.0 has been released following the withdrawal of version 3.52.0, introducing significant updates like ALTER TABLE constraint modifications and new JSON functions. The release also features an enhanced CLI with a new Query Results Formatter library, which is showcased in an interactive WebAssembly-based playground.
articles.summary_zh: SQLite 3.53.0 在撤回 3.52.0 版本後正式發布，帶來了包含 ALTER TABLE 約束修改與新 JSON 函數在內的重大更新。此版本還升級了 CLI 模式並引入了新的查詢結果格式化工具，作者並透過 WebAssembly 構建了互動式演示界面。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article serves as a release announcement and reference for the latest features added to the SQLite database engine.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文作為軟體發布公告，為 SQLite 資料庫引擎的最新功能提供了參考與說明。

articles.title: SQLite Query Result Formatter Demo
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison has released a web-based playground for the SQLite Query Result Formatter library. This tool allows users to experiment with different rendering options for SQL query results, compiled to WebAssembly.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 發布了一個用於 SQLite 查詢結果格式化庫的網頁版演示工具。該工具利用 WebAssembly 技術，讓使用者能即時測試 SQL 查詢結果表格的各種渲染效果。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article introduces a functional web tool that provides a hands-on playground for users to test specific formatting features.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文介紹了一款實用的網頁工具，為使用者提供互動式演示平台，以便實際操作與測試特定格式化功能。

articles.title: Y2K 2.0: The AI security reckoning
articles.summary_en: The rise of advanced LLMs has significantly accelerated the discovery and exploitation of software vulnerabilities. By automating code analysis and personalizing attack vectors, AI tools have democratized access to sophisticated cyberattacks, posing a systemic threat to digital infrastructure.
articles.summary_zh: 先進的 AI 模型大幅加速了軟體漏洞的發現與利用。透過自動化程式碼分析與客製化攻擊手法，AI 工具降低了發動複雜網路攻擊的門檻，對數位基礎設施構成了系統性的威脅。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the conceptual shift in how AI-driven tools are fundamentally changing the landscape of software security and cyber threats.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文旨在解釋人工智慧技術如何從概念上根本性地改變軟體安全與網路威脅的格局。

articles.title: watgo - a WebAssembly Toolkit for Go
articles.summary_en: Eli Bendersky introduces watgo, a zero-dependency Go toolkit for WebAssembly that allows parsing, validating, encoding, and decoding WASM files. The toolkit provides both a CLI for command-line tasks and a Go API for programmatically manipulating WebAssembly modules via the wasmir semantic representation.
articles.summary_zh: Eli Bendersky 推出了 watgo，這是一個用於 WebAssembly 的純 Go 工具包，無需額外依賴即可進行 WASM 檔案的解析、驗證、編碼與解碼。該工具包同時提供 CLI 指令列工具與 Go API，讓開發者能透過 wasmir 語義表示層來操作 WebAssembly 模組。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as an announcement and a tutorial-style introduction to a new software tool, demonstrating how to use its CLI and API.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文作為新軟體工具的公告與導覽，示範了如何使用該工具的 CLI 與 API，具備教學性質。

articles.title: The Solitaire Shuffle
articles.source: Tedium: The Dull Side of the Internet.
articles.summary_en: This article explores the enduring appeal of Solitaire as a meditative and mentally stimulating pastime. It highlights the variety of the game's iterations and discusses a UCLA CRESST study suggesting that playing Solitaire may have positive impacts on cognitive function.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了單人紙牌遊戲（Solitaire）作為一種靜心且具備心智刺激的消遣活動的長久魅力。文章介紹了該遊戲的多樣性，並引用了一項加州大學洛杉磯分校（UCLA）的研究，指出玩紙牌遊戲可能有助於維持認知功能。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article centers on the discussion and results of a research study conducted by UCLA regarding the cognitive benefits of Solitaire.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文重點討論了由加州大學洛杉磯分校（UCLA）進行的一項關於紙牌遊戲對認知功能益處的研究及其結果。

articles.title: Package Registries and Pagination
articles.summary_en: Legacy package registry APIs like npm and PyPI suffer from performance issues because they return full version history in single, massive JSON responses. These decade-old designs lack pagination, causing modern, high-volume packages to hit size limits and memory overhead during parsing.
articles.summary_zh: npm 與 PyPI 等老牌軟體包註冊表的 API 設計過於陳舊，因其在單一回應中回傳所有版本歷史，導致效能瓶頸與解析負擔。這些缺乏分頁機制的 API 設計在面對現代軟體包數量暴增時，常面臨資料傳輸量過大與硬性容量限制的問題。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses specific benchmarks, data sizes, and case studies (like Renovate's E406 error) to demonstrate the technical limitations of existing package registry APIs.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文引用了具體的效能基準、資料大小以及案例研究（如 Renovate 遭遇的 E406 錯誤），以論證現有軟體包註冊表 API 的技術限制。

articles.title: Why I quit "The Strive"
articles.summary_en: The author announces the end of their previous newsletter project, 'The Strive,' while detailing the future direction of their paid subscription model. They emphasize maintaining free access to core content while offering premium benefits like community access and ad-free reading for supporters.
articles.summary_zh: 作者宣布結束其名為「The Strive」的電子報項目，並說明了未來付費訂閱模式的發展方向。他們強調將維持核心內容的免費閱讀，同時為支持者提供社區訪問權限及無廣告的閱讀體驗等額外福利。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as an announcement explaining the author's change in content strategy and business philosophy.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章為一則公告，旨在解釋作者在內容策略與商業理念上的調整。

articles.title: In defense of GitHub's poor uptime
articles.summary_en: This article challenges the perception that GitHub's uptime is failing by explaining how uptime statistics can be misleading when applied to complex, multi-service platforms. The author argues that aggregate metrics often unfairly penalize systems for having independent, non-overlapping service outages.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了 GitHub 的運行時間問題，指出僅從公開數據評斷其服務品質可能會產生誤導。作者解釋了多個獨立服務的故障如何被加總計算，導致整體可用性數字看起來比實際體驗更差。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains a technical concept regarding how uptime statistics are calculated and interpreted, challenging common assumptions about service reliability.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文解釋了關於運作時間統計數據如何計算與解讀的概念，並挑戰了大眾對於服務可靠性的常見假設。

articles.title: Distribution of digits in fractions
articles.summary_en: This article explores the distribution of digits in the decimal representations of fractions. It highlights interesting, lesser-known mathematical patterns that emerge when analyzing these basic numerical forms.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了分數在小數表示法中數字的分佈情形。作者透過數學分析，揭示了即使是在基礎數學領域中，也存在著許多鮮為人知的有趣規律。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains a specific mathematical concept regarding the properties of fractions and their digit distributions.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文旨在解釋關於分數性質及其數字分佈的特定數學概念。

articles.title: How do you add or remove a handle from an active Wait­For­Multiple­Objects?, part 2
articles.summary_en: This article continues the discussion on modifying handles within an active WaitForMultipleObjects call. It specifically focuses on the synchronization mechanism required to ensure the waiting thread correctly acknowledges handle changes.
articles.summary_zh: 本文延續了關於如何在作用中的 WaitForMultipleObjects 呼叫中修改控制代碼的討論。文中特別探討了確保等待執行緒正確確認控制代碼變更所需的同步機制。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides technical guidance and step-by-step logic for managing handle states in API programming.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對 API 程式設計中控制代碼狀態的管理，提供了技術指導與步驟邏輯。

articles.title: Pluralistic: Canny Valley and Creative Commons (10 Apr 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: Cory Doctorow reflects on his history of successful Kickstarter campaigns for his books, emphasizing his commitment to creating unique, limited-edition physical items for his readers. He highlights the balance between producing DRM-free digital content and creating tangible collector's pieces.
articles.summary_zh: Cory Doctorow 回顧了他為書籍進行的多次成功 Kickstarter 募資活動，並強調了他致力於為讀者創作獨特、限量版實體物品的初衷。他同時探討了在提供無 DRM 數位內容與製作具有收藏價值的實體書籍之間取得平衡的理念。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the author's personal experience with successful crowdfunding as a case study for his publishing and engagement strategy.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章以作者個人經營眾籌活動的成功經驗作為案例研究，說明其出版策略與讀者互動模式。

articles.title: Kākāpō parrots
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison shares a video snippet from a recent podcast episode featuring a discussion about Kākāpō parrots. The post provides a direct link to the short video clip and references the full-length podcast recording.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 分享了一段來自近期播客節目的片段，內容討論了鴞鸚鵡（Kākāpō）。文中提供了該短片的連結，並提及了完整的播客錄音內容。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post serves as a reference or pointer to specific media content and a podcast recording rather than providing instruction or analysis.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這篇文章主要作為特定媒體內容與播客錄音的參考或導引，而非提供教學或深入分析。

articles.title: ChatGPT voice mode is a weaker model
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison highlights that OpenAI's ChatGPT voice mode often uses a less capable model than expected, contradicting the assumption that voice-accessible AI is the most powerful. The post references Andrej Karpathy's analysis on why some AI domains, like coding, advance faster due to explicit reward functions and high B2B value.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 指出 ChatGPT 的語音模式其實運行在比預期更弱的模型上，並非大眾認為的最強版本。本文引用 Andrej Karpathy 的觀點，解釋為何程式編寫等領域的 AI 進步較快，主要歸因於明確的獎勵函數及高商業價值。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual explanation regarding the discrepancies in AI model capabilities across different access points and usage domains.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文對人工智慧模型在不同使用場景與存取點下的能力差異進行了概念性解釋。

articles.title: SQLAlchemy 2 In Practice - Chapter 4 - Many-To-Many Relationships
articles.summary_en: This article serves as the fourth chapter of Miguel Grinberg's guide on SQLAlchemy 2. It focuses on the implementation and management of many-to-many database relationships.
articles.summary_zh: 本文是 Miguel Grinberg 所著 SQLAlchemy 2 實踐指南的第四章。內容專注於介紹如何處理與管理資料庫中的多對多關聯。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content is part of a practical guide providing instruction on how to implement specific database relationships.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該內容屬於實作指南的一部分，旨在指導讀者如何應用特定的資料庫關聯。

articles.title: Nowhere Is Safe
articles.summary_en: The article analyzes how the proliferation of low-cost drones in modern warfare, as seen in Ukraine and Iran, renders traditional air defense systems obsolete. It highlights the strategic shift where massive numbers of inexpensive, asymmetric threats can overwhelm sophisticated, high-cost military defense infrastructure.
articles.summary_zh: 本文分析了烏克蘭與伊朗戰爭中無人機的廣泛應用，指出其使地球表面成為高度爭議的空間。作者強調，傳統針對少量高階武器設計的防空系統，在面對大規模低成本無人機的非對稱攻擊時已顯得力不從心。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content explains the conceptual shift in modern military strategy caused by the rise of drone warfare.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容解釋了無人機作戰興起所帶來的現代軍事策略觀念轉變。

articles.title: Rapport digitale autonomie binnen de energie-intensieve industrie voor Energy Innovation NL
articles.summary_en: Bert Hubert announces the publication of his new report commissioned by Energy Innovation NL, focusing on digital autonomy within energy-intensive industries. The report, developed through consultations with various key companies, addresses the critical integration of technology and industrial energy processes.
articles.summary_zh: Bert Hubert 發表了由 Energy Innovation NL 委託撰寫的報告，重點探討能源密集產業中的數位自主權。該報告透過與多家關鍵企業諮詢合作，深入分析了技術與能源產業流程整合的關鍵議題。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content introduces a specific industry report based on research and interviews with relevant companies.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該內容介紹了一份基於研究與相關企業訪談所產出的特定產業報告。

articles.title: Fewer Computers, Fewer Problems: Going Local With Builds & Deployments
articles.summary_en: The author discusses shifting back to local-first builds and deployments for personal websites to simplify the development process. By treating remote hosting as a progressive enhancement rather than a dependency, they aim to eliminate the complexities of distributed computing.
articles.summary_zh: 作者探討了將個人網站的建置與部署改回「本機優先」模式，以簡化開發流程。透過將遠端託管視為增強功能而非必要依賴，作者旨在消除分散式運算帶來的複雜問題。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on the conceptual philosophy of shifting infrastructure paradigms toward local-first computing.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文重點在於探討轉向「本機優先」運算的基礎設施哲學概念。

articles.title: Hong Kong Disneyland Speedrun Guide
articles.summary_en: This guide provides a strategic approach to visiting Hong Kong Disneyland efficiently by leveraging early entry passes and optimized pathing. The author outlines a specific route to maximize ride uptime and minimize queue times, allowing visitors to experience all attractions in half a day.
articles.summary_zh: 本指南提供了在香港迪士尼樂園高效遊玩的策略，透過提前入園證與優化動線來最大化遊樂設施體驗時間。作者規劃了一套具體的路線，協助遊客避開排隊人潮，並在半天內玩遍所有設施。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article is a practical, step-by-step how-to guide for optimizing a theme park visit.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文是一篇實用的操作指南，提供逐步教學以優化遊樂園的遊玩行程。

articles.title: Helium Is Hard to Replace
articles.summary_en: This article explores the complexities of the global helium supply chain, drawing parallels to how geopolitical conflicts, such as the Strait of Hormuz closure, disrupt essential resource logistics. It highlights why helium is uniquely difficult to substitute, emphasizing its critical role in modern technology and industry.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了全球氦氣供應鏈的複雜性，並將其與荷姆茲海峽封鎖等地緣政治衝突如何破壞重要資源物流進行了對比。文章強調了氦氣因其獨特性而難以被取代，並闡述了它在現代科技與工業中的關鍵地位。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the analogy of petroleum supply chain disruptions to explain the broader systemic vulnerabilities in resource availability.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章透過石油供應鏈中斷的類比，來解釋資源供應在系統性層面上的脆弱性。

articles.title: Package Security Defenses for AI Agents
articles.summary_en: This post highlights the heightened security risks AI agents face when installing software packages, such as malicious code execution and credential theft. It proposes defensive strategies for AI coding platforms, including disabling default install scripts, implementing package version cooldowns, and enforcing sandboxed environments to limit potential blast radii.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了 AI 代理在安裝軟體套件時面臨的安全風險，包括惡意代碼執行與憑證竊取等威脅。文中建議開發平台應採取防禦措施，如預設停用安裝腳本、設置套件版本冷卻期，並強制實施沙盒環境以降低潛在攻擊範圍。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides actionable, step-by-step security recommendations for AI coding platforms to improve their workflows.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對 AI 編碼平台提供了具體且可執行的操作建議，旨在改善工作流程的安全防護。

articles.title: The Great Pyramid of Giza and the Speed of Light
articles.summary_en: The author investigates a viral claim that the latitude of the Great Pyramid of Giza matches the speed of light. He concludes that while the numbers align precisely, the observation is a mathematical coincidence rather than evidence of ancient advanced knowledge.
articles.summary_zh: 作者調查了關於吉薩大金字塔的緯度與光速數值吻合的網路傳言。他得出結論，儘管這些數字精確對應，但這僅是一種數學上的巧合，而非古代文明擁有先進知識的證據。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post evaluates a specific claim using scientific constants and geographical data to debunk a popular misconception.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這篇文章使用科學常數與地理數據來評估一項具體主張，藉此破解常見的迷思。

articles.title: Random hexagon fractal
articles.summary_en: The article explores an iterative geometric process for generating a random fractal based on a hexagon. By repeatedly selecting a side and forming a new triangle with a point inside, the method produces complex, self-similar patterns.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章介紹了一種基於六邊形生成隨機碎形（fractal）的迭代幾何過程。透過重複選擇邊並與六邊形內部的點構成三角形，該方法能產生複雜且具備自相似性的圖案。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article describes a step-by-step mathematical process for generating a specific geometric pattern.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章描述了產生特定幾何圖案的逐步數學過程。

articles.title: Root prime gap
articles.summary_en: This post discusses Andrica's conjecture, which posits that the difference between the square roots of consecutive prime numbers is always less than one. The author notes that while this remains unproven, it has been empirically verified for primes up to 2 × 10^19.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章介紹了安德里卡猜想（Andrica's conjecture），該猜想認為連續質數的平方根之差永遠小於 1。作者指出，儘管該猜想尚未獲得數學證明，但目前已針對高達 2 × 10^19 的質數進行了實證驗證。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains a mathematical conjecture and its theoretical context.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文旨在解釋一個數學猜想及其理論背景。

articles.title: A Three- and a Four- Body Problem
articles.summary_en: This article discusses the orbital mechanics of the Artemis I and Artemis II missions, focusing on the differences in trajectory and duration. It highlights how the unmanned nature of Artemis I allowed for a more complex, longer-duration orbit compared to the crewed Artemis II mission.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了阿提米絲一號與二號任務的軌道力學，重點說明兩者在飛行路徑與任務時間上的差異。文中指出，由於阿提米絲一號為無人任務，使其能夠執行比載人的阿提米絲二號更複雜且耗時更長的軌道運行。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post provides a conceptual explanation of orbital mechanics and the 'three-body problem' in the context of specific NASA space missions.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文在特定 NASA 太空任務的背景下，提供了關於軌道力學與「三體問題」的概念性解釋。

articles.title: How do you add or remove a handle from an active Wait­For­Multiple­Objects?
articles.summary_en: The article explains that it is impossible to directly modify the handles being monitored by an active WaitForMultipleObjects call. Instead, the author advises using a cooperative approach between threads to manage the monitored objects.
articles.summary_zh: 本文說明無法直接修改正在監控中的 WaitForMultipleObjects 函式所使用的控制代碼 (handle)。作者建議應透過執行緒之間的協作機制來管理監控物件。
articles.pacer_reason_en: It explains the conceptual limitation of a specific Windows API function and the theoretical approach to resolving the requirement.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文解釋了特定 Windows API 函式的概念性限制，以及解決該需求的理論方法。

articles.title: I quit drinking for a year
articles.summary_en: The author recounts their experience of quitting alcohol for over a year after a spontaneous decision triggered by a discussion about 'damp January.' They discovered that total abstinence was surprisingly easier than moderate drinking because it removed the mental burden of constantly deciding whether or not to consume alcohol.
articles.summary_zh: 作者分享了在一次關於「微醺一月」的對話刺激下，決定戒酒一年以上的經歷。他們發現完全戒酒反而比適度飲酒更容易，因為這消除了每次面對酒精時是否要飲用的心理糾結。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as an anecdotal case study of the author's personal experiment with sobriety and its psychological effects.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文以作者個人的戒酒實驗作為案例研究，分析了其心理層面的影響與觀察。

articles.title: Book Review: Small Comfort by Ia Genberg ★★☆☆☆
articles.summary_en: Terence Eden reviews the book 'Small Comfort' by Ia Genberg, expressing mixed feelings about its execution. While he appreciates the experimental structure of interrelated stories, he finds the overall narrative unconvincing and disjointed.
articles.summary_zh: Terence Eden 分享了對 Ia Genberg 小說《Small Comfort》的書評，表達了對該作品執行效果的保留態度。儘管他欣賞書中相互關聯的敘事結構，但認為整體的呈現方式並不令人信服。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The author uses analogies to other media, such as 'Run Lola Run', to illustrate the themes and style of the book.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 作者透過類比其他媒體作品（如《蘿拉快跑》）來闡述書中的主題與風格。

articles.title: Pluralistic: Cindy Cohn's "Privacy's Defender" (09 Apr 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: Cory Doctorow highlights the memoir of EFF executive director Cindy Cohn, 'Privacy's Defender,' which chronicles her decades-long fight for digital rights. The post focuses on her pivotal role in the landmark Bernstein case, which established that code constitutes protected free speech.
articles.summary_zh: Cory Doctorow 推薦了電子前線基金會（EFF）執行總監 Cindy Cohn 的回憶錄《Privacy's Defender》，該書記錄了她數十年來為數位權利奮鬥的歷程。文章重點介紹了她在關鍵的伯恩斯坦案（Bernstein case）中所扮演的角色，該案確立了程式碼屬於受保護的言論自由。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as a testimonial and historical account based on the author's direct experience and the subject's documented legal history.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文基於作者的親身經歷與書中記錄的法律史，屬於對特定人物與歷史事件的見證與回顧。

articles.title: What Are You Trying to Say?
articles.summary_en: The article explores the challenge of clear communication and the tendency to overcomplicate messages. It suggests that asking oneself 'what am I trying to say?' helps strip away unnecessary fluff, encouraging writers and speakers to distill complex thoughts into their core, primitive meaning.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了溝通中常見的複雜化問題，並建議透過反問自己「我想表達什麼？」來釐清思緒。作者指出，這種自我提問能幫助我們剝離多餘的裝飾與術語，精準傳達最核心的訊息。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article is conceptual, focusing on the theory and philosophy of effective communication rather than a step-by-step guide or specific data.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文屬於概念性文章，重點在於探討有效溝通的哲學與心法，而非步驟教學或數據分析。

articles.title: GitHub Repo Size
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison has released a simple web tool that displays the total size of any GitHub repository. It bypasses the lack of size information in the GitHub UI by leveraging the repository's CORS-friendly API.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 推出了一款簡單的網頁工具，可顯示任何 GitHub 儲存庫的總大小。該工具透過 GitHub 支援 CORS 的 API 獲取數據，解決了 GitHub 原生介面無法直接查看儲存庫大小的問題。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post provides a direct tool and instructions for users to easily check GitHub repository sizes.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這篇文章提供了一個直接的工具以及使用方法，讓使用者能輕鬆查詢 GitHub 儲存庫的大小。

articles.title: asgi-gzip 0.3
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison released version 0.3 of asgi-gzip to fix an issue where SSE responses were being incorrectly compressed. The update was triggered after realizing that the library's automated sync with Starlette had failed to capture a necessary upstream fix.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 發布了 asgi-gzip 0.3 版本，修復了 Server-sent events (SSE) 回應被錯誤壓縮的問題。這次更新是在發現與 Starlette 自動同步流程失效，導致遺漏了必要的修復後所進行的維護。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post functions as a release note documenting a specific bug fix, the cause of the failure, and the resolution.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 此文章為版本更新日誌，記錄了特定錯誤修復、故障原因以及解決方案。

articles.title: Meta's new model is Muse Spark, and meta.ai chat has some interesting tools
articles.summary_en: Meta has released Muse Spark, a new hosted AI model available via meta.ai with 'Instant' and 'Thinking' modes. The author tests the model's capabilities using his signature 'pelican riding a bicycle' prompt to compare performance across these modes.
articles.summary_zh: Meta 發布了 Muse Spark，這是一款可在 meta.ai 上使用，並具備「即時」與「思考」兩種模式的託管式 AI 模型。作者透過其標誌性的「鵜鶘騎腳踏車」測試，比較了該模型在不同模式下的表現。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on benchmarking a new AI model against competitors and performing a practical evaluation using specific image generation prompts.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文重點在於將新型 AI 模型與競爭對手進行基準測試比較，並透過特定的影像生成提示詞進行實際評測。

articles.title: When the crisis comes
articles.summary_en: Anil Dash reflects on the challenges of leadership during constant crises, emphasizing the importance of finding clarity and expert support. He highlights the book 'Crisis Engineering' as a vital resource for navigating turbulent times and transforming crises into opportunities for growth.
articles.summary_zh: Anil Dash 反思了在持續危機中領導組織的挑戰，強調在混亂中尋找清晰方向與專家支援的重要性。他將《Crisis Engineering》一書視為應對危機、將困境轉化為成長契機的重要資源。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article is primarily conceptual, reflecting on the nature of leadership during crises and recommending a book that explores the philosophy of 'crisis engineering'.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文主要屬於概念性內容，探討危機期間的領導本質，並推薦了一本探討「危機工程」哲學的書籍。

articles.title: The day you get cut out of the economy
articles.summary_en: The article argues that as global economic growth stagnates, AI frontier model developers will shift from a SaaS subscription model to vertical integration. By capturing the value currently held by the AI application layer, model makers will consolidate the market to recoup the massive costs of frontier training runs.
articles.summary_zh: 本文指出，隨著全球經濟成長停滯，AI 前沿模型開發商將從 SaaS 訂閱模式轉向垂直整合。為了回收龐大的訓練成本，這些開發商將透過吞噬 AI 應用層的價值並推動市場整合，從而奪取更多市場份額。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content provides a theoretical analysis of the future economic landscape of AI development and industry dynamics.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文對 AI 開發的未來經濟前景及產業動態進行了理論性分析。

articles.title: Pork & Puppetry
articles.source: Tedium: The Dull Side of the Internet.
articles.summary_en: This article explores the origin of a viral parody trailer featuring a warthog puppet named Pork Johnson, which mocks the open-source image editor GIMP. The author interviews creator Dustin Grissom, who explains how the puppet served as a creative outlet and a personal tribute to his childhood.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討了名為 Pork Johnson 的疣豬木偶惡搞影片的創作背景，該影片以諷刺開源影像軟體 GIMP 為題。作者專訪了創作者 Dustin Grissom，他分享了如何透過製作木偶來重拾創意樂趣並致敬童年回憶。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides an in-depth story behind a specific creative project and its conceptual origins.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文深入探討了特定創意專案背後的創作故事及其概念起源。

articles.title: Package Security Problems for AI Agents
articles.summary_en: This article examines how AI agents are uniquely vulnerable to traditional package security threats like typosquatting and registry poisoning. Because agents dynamically discover and install tools without human oversight, they can inadvertently execute malicious code from compromised or spoofed package repositories.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了 AI 代理程式如何面臨傳統軟體套件安全威脅（如誤植域名攻擊和註冊表中毒）的獨特風險。由於代理程式會在缺乏人工監督的情況下自動解析並安裝工具，極易意外執行來自偽造或受損儲存庫的惡意代碼。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains the conceptual security risks and threat vectors introduced by AI agents in the context of existing package management systems.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文旨在解釋 AI 代理程式在現有軟體套件管理系統中產生的概念性安全風險與威脅路徑。

articles.title: Mario and Earendil
articles.summary_en: Armin Ronacher announces that Mario Zechner is joining Earendil. The post highlights Ronacher's admiration for Zechner's commitment to software quality, thoughtful design, and craftsmanship in the field of AI coding agents.
articles.summary_zh: Armin Ronacher 宣佈 Mario Zechner 加入 Earendil。文中強調了 Ronacher 對 Zechner 在 AI 程式設計代理領域中所展現的軟體品質、深度設計與工匠精神的讚賞。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article is a conceptual reflection on software development philosophy, professional values, and the vision behind a company acquisition.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這是一篇關於軟體開發理念、專業價值觀以及企業收購背後願景的觀念性敘述。

articles.title: How do you add or remove a handle from an active Msg­Wait­For­Multiple­Objects?
articles.summary_en: The article explains that you cannot directly add or remove a handle from an active MsgWaitForMultipleObjects call. Instead, you must design your application logic to signal the waiter to handle these updates internally.
articles.summary_zh: 本文說明無法直接在運作中的 MsgWaitForMultipleObjects 呼叫中新增或移除控制代碼。開發者必須設計應用程式邏輯，讓等待者能自行處理這些更新。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post provides a technical solution/workaround for a specific programming problem.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對特定的程式設計問題提供了技術解決方案與操作建議。

articles.title: Theatre Review: Avenue Q ★★★★★
articles.summary_en: The author reflects on re-watching the musical Avenue Q, contemplating the passage of time and the challenges of updating classic productions. The review highlights the emotional resonance of the show while discussing the balance between preserving a work's original charm and keeping it relevant.
articles.summary_zh: 作者分享了重溫音樂劇《Q大道》的感觸，並探討了經典作品在保持原貌與持續更新之間該如何取捨。文章透過個人觀點，反思了時間流逝對藝術作品詮釋的影響。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the author's personal experience and aging process as an analogy to discuss the preservation and evolution of theatre productions.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章以作者個人的生活經歷與衰老過程作為類比，探討戲劇作品在時代演變中的保存與重塑問題。

articles.title: Pluralistic: Process knowledge (08 Apr 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: This article examines the problematic nature of the term 'intellectual property,' arguing that it is a vague, catch-all label for disparate legal doctrines and abstract concepts. It highlights how the conflation of copyright, patents, trademarks, and newer, less-defined rights complicates modern tech regulation and global trade policy.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了「知識產權」這一術語的模糊性，指出它將多種不同的法律原則和抽象概念強行歸類在一起。作者認為這種過度簡化的標籤掩蓋了版權、專利和商標之間的巨大差異，反而對當前的科技監管與全球貿易政策造成了混淆。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual analysis of how the term 'intellectual property' is defined, misused, and expanded beyond its original legal boundaries.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對「知識產權」這一概念進行了理論層面的分析，探討了該術語如何被定義、誤用，並被擴展至原有的法律框架之外。

articles.title: Quoting Giles Turnbull
articles.summary_en: This post highlights a reflection by Giles Turnbull on the double standard regarding AI adoption. It notes that while people enjoy using AI to mimic other professions, they often resent when AI is used to replace their own work.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章引用了 Giles Turnbull 對於 AI 應用的觀察，指出人們普遍喜歡用 AI 嘗試他人的專業，卻對 AI 被用於取代自身專業感到反感。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content explores a conceptual reflection on human behavior and ethical attitudes toward AI in the workforce.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容探討了關於人類行為與對職場 AI 倫理態度的概念性反思。

articles.title: Actually, people love to work hard
articles.summary_en: Anil Dash challenges the common corporate trope that employees lack a desire to work hard. He argues that people are inherently motivated when they have clear goals, shared values, and trust, suggesting that claims of laziness are merely management tactics to suppress wages.
articles.summary_zh: Anil Dash 反駁了企業界常見的「員工不想努力工作」的說法。他認為當員工擁有明確目標、共同價值觀及信任基礎時，其實非常有工作動力，並指出該論調往往只是資方壓低薪資的手段。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual argument challenging popular workplace myths by explaining the underlying factors that actually motivate employee performance.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文提出概念性論點，透過解釋激勵員工績效的潛在因素，挑戰了職場上的常見迷思。

articles.title: Weekly Update 498
articles.summary_en: Troy Hunt shares his frustrations regarding the administrative burden of chasing long-overdue invoices from clients. The update highlights the real-world difficulties of managing payment terms in a professional consulting business.
articles.summary_zh: Troy Hunt 分享了他處理客戶長期逾期帳單的行政挫折。此更新凸顯了在專業諮詢業務中管理付款期限所面臨的現實挑戰。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content serves as a personal case study/anecdote about business administrative challenges.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 此內容作為關於商業行政挑戰的個人案例研究與經驗談。

articles.title: Michael Nielsen – How science actually progresses
articles.summary_en: Michael Nielsen discusses the nuances of scientific progress, challenging traditional narratives about historical figures like Einstein, Newton, and Darwin. The conversation explores how scientific breakthroughs actually occur through collaborative environments and evolving methodologies rather than isolated genius.
articles.summary_zh: Michael Nielsen 探討了科學進步的細節，挑戰了關於愛因斯坦、牛頓和達爾文等歷史人物的傳統敘事。對談深入分析了科學突破如何透過合作環境與方法論的演進，而非僅靠天才的孤軍奮戰而實現。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content focuses on theoretical discussions and the conceptual understanding of how scientific progress functions.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 內容側重於理論探討，旨在提供對科學進步如何運作的概念性理解。

articles.title: Readership maths skills
articles.summary_en: This article discusses the importance of mathematical literacy for readers to better understand data-driven narratives. It highlights how improved analytical skills help audiences evaluate information more critically.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了數學素養對於讀者解讀數據驅動敘事的重要性。文章強調，提升分析能力有助於受眾更嚴謹地評估資訊內容。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on explaining the concepts and necessity of mathematical skills in reading, rather than providing a tutorial or specific data.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文側重於解釋閱讀中數學技能的概念與必要性，而非提供教學指南或特定數據。

articles.title: Who Built This?
articles.summary_en: This article explores how different programming ecosystems—Go, Rust, .NET, and Java—handle embedding version control metadata into compiled binaries. It highlights Go's automatic VCS stamping as a gold standard for observability and contrasts it with the varied, often manual, opt-in approaches required in other languages.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了 Go、Rust、.NET 和 Java 等不同程式語言生態系統如何將版本控制元數據嵌入編譯後的二進位檔案。文章強調 Go 語言自動嵌入 VCS 資訊的機制為可觀測性樹立了標竿，並對比了其他語言中普遍需要手動配置或選擇性加入的作法。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article draws parallels between different language ecosystems to compare their approaches to a specific technical challenge: build-time version metadata stamping.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文透過比較不同程式語言生態系統處理特定技術問題（建置時版本元數據嵌入）的方式，進行了跨領域的類比分析。

articles.title: The Hacker News tarpit
articles.summary_en: This post discusses the author's subscription model for their newsletter, highlighting the benefits of paid access such as additional content and community interaction. It emphasizes the author's commitment to keeping the core content free while offering premium perks for supporters.
articles.summary_zh: 本文介紹了作者的電子報訂閱模式，並強調了付費訂閱所能享有的額外內容與社群互動等福利。作者同時承諾核心內容將持續免費提供給所有讀者。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The content serves primarily as a reference or announcement regarding the author's subscription service and pricing structure.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文主要作為關於作者訂閱服務與定價架構的公告或參考資訊。

articles.title: Toffoli gates are all you need
articles.summary_en: The article discusses Landauer’s principle, which establishes a fundamental thermodynamic limit on the energy required to erase a bit of information. It highlights the universality of this physical bound regardless of the storage medium and introduces the role of Toffoli gates in reversible computation.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了藍道爾原理（Landauer’s principle），該原理確立了擦除資訊所需能量的熱力學基本極限。文章強調無論資訊儲存媒介為何，此物理限制皆適用，並介紹了托佛利閘（Toffoli gates）在可逆計算中的角色。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article explains a fundamental physical theory and its implications for information processing.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章解釋了基本的物理理論及其對資訊處理的影響。

articles.title: Were there any Windows 3.1 programs that were so incompatible with Windows 95 that there was no point trying to patch them?
articles.summary_en: This post discusses the history of software compatibility during the transition from Windows 3.1 to Windows 95. It specifically addresses whether certain programs were fundamentally incompatible beyond the possibility of patching.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了從 Windows 3.1 過渡到 Windows 95 期間的軟體相容性歷史。文中特別討論了是否存在某些軟體因架構差異過大，而無法透過修補程式來解決相容性問題。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The post provides a conceptual explanation regarding the technical limitations of backward compatibility during OS transitions.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章針對作業系統轉移期間的向後相容性技術限制，提供了概念性的解釋。

articles.title: The Building Block Economy
articles.summary_en: This article explores the concept of the 'Building Block Economy' within the context of software architecture and infrastructure development. It discusses how modular, reusable components form the foundation for scalable and efficient systems.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了軟體架構與基礎設施開發背景下的「模組化經濟」。文章討論了模組化且可重複使用的元件如何成為建構可擴展且高效系統的基礎。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article focuses on high-level architectural theory and defining the concept of a modular economy in software.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文側重於高階架構理論，並定義了軟體開發中模組化經濟的概念。

articles.title: Did WordPress VIP leak my phone number?
articles.summary_en: The author investigates how his private phone number was leaked by Apollo.io, tracing the source back to Parse.ly (acquired by WordPress VIP). The post highlights concerns regarding data privacy and the practice of sharing user information within contributor networks.
articles.summary_zh: 作者追查其私人電話號碼外洩至 Apollo.io 的來源，發現數據源自 Parse.ly（現隸屬於 WordPress VIP）。本文探討了數據隱私問題，並質疑企業在貢獻者網絡中分享用戶資訊的做法。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as a case study documenting the author's investigation into a specific data leak incident.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文以案例研究的形式，記錄了作者針對特定數據洩漏事件的調查過程。

articles.title: Pluralistic: Switzerland's Goldilocks fiber (07 Apr 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: This article discusses the success of Switzerland's high-speed fiber internet model, which provides 25Gbit symmetrical connections via a competitive, public-provisioned structure. The author contrasts this 'Goldilocks' approach with the flawed telecommunications markets in the US and Germany, arguing that robust public infrastructure is essential for true competition.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討了瑞士成功推行的高速光纖網路模式，該模式透過公共基礎設施與市場競爭，為用戶提供 25Gbit 的對稱傳輸速度。作者對比了美國與德國電信市場的不足，認為這種「恰到好處」的模式證明了強健的公共基礎設施對於實現有效競爭至關重要。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the Swiss fiber model as an analogy to critique and compare the telecommunications policies of the US and Germany.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章以瑞士的光纖模型作為類比，藉此批評並對比美國與德國的電信政策。

articles.title: Russia Hacked Routers to Steal Microsoft Office Tokens
articles.summary_en: Russian military intelligence hackers are exploiting vulnerabilities in older routers to steal Microsoft Office authentication tokens. This campaign has compromised over 18,000 networks by silently harvesting tokens without the need for installing malicious software.
articles.summary_zh: 俄羅斯軍事情報單位駭客正利用舊型路由器的漏洞，竊取 Microsoft Office 的身份驗證權杖。此攻擊行動無需安裝惡意軟體，已導致超過 18,000 個網路遭到入侵。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article reports on a specific security incident and active threat campaign, providing evidence of a real-world cybersecurity breach.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章報導了具體的安全事件與攻擊行動，提供了現實網路安全漏洞的實證。

articles.title: GLM-5.1: Towards Long-Horizon Tasks
articles.summary_en: Simon Willison tests the new 754B parameter GLM-5.1 model, highlighting its impressive SVG generation capabilities. While the model shows potential in complex tasks, it demonstrates mixed results when automatically generating CSS animations for those assets.
articles.summary_zh: Simon Willison 測試了最新的 754B 參數模型 GLM-5.1，並展示了其出色的 SVG 生成能力。儘管該模型在複雜任務中展現出潛力，但在自動為這些素材生成 CSS 動畫時表現尚不穩定。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as a practical experiment and test case, demonstrating the model's performance on a specific generation task.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 該文章記錄了一項實務測試與案例研究，展示了該模型在特定生成任務中的表現。

articles.title: Anthropic's Project Glasswing - restricting Claude Mythos to security researchers - sounds necessary to me
articles.summary_en: Anthropic has introduced Project Glasswing to restrict access to their powerful new AI model, Claude Mythos, due to its advanced cybersecurity capabilities. By limiting availability to select partners, Anthropic aims to allow the industry time to address the significant vulnerabilities the model can identify before a wider release.
articles.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出了 Project Glasswing 計畫，基於其新模型 Claude Mythos 強大的網路安全能力，決定限制該模型的存取權限。透過僅開放給特定合作夥伴，Anthropic 希望能在模型正式廣泛發布前，讓軟體產業有時間修補其所發現的重大漏洞。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual overview and explanation of a new AI release strategy and the reasoning behind restricting access to a specific technology.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對一項新的 AI 發布策略進行了概念性的概述，並解釋了限制該技術存取的背後動機。

articles.title: SQLite WAL Mode Across Docker Containers Sharing a Volume
articles.summary_en: This research confirms that SQLite's Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode functions correctly across separate Docker containers when sharing the same host volume. It explains that because containers on the same host share the underlying filesystem and memory mechanisms, concurrent SQLite processes can collaborate effectively.
articles.summary_zh: 這項研究證實，當多個 Docker 容器共享同一個主機磁碟區時，SQLite 的預寫式記錄 (WAL) 模式運作正常。研究解釋，由於相同主機上的容器共享底層檔案系統與記憶體機制，因此並發的 SQLite 行程能夠正確地協同工作。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article presents research findings and experimental confirmation regarding technical compatibility between SQLite and Docker.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對 SQLite 與 Docker 在技術兼容性方面的問題，呈現了研究結果與實驗驗證。

articles.title: What next for the compute crunch?
articles.summary_en: The AI sector is facing a severe imbalance between exponential demand for compute power and limited supply. The next two years will be characterized by market shortages, supply rationing, and ongoing price adjustments.
articles.summary_zh: 人工智慧領域正面臨算力需求呈現指數級增長，但供給卻嚴重受限的失衡狀態。未來兩年內，市場將面臨硬體短缺、配給限制以及持續的價格調整。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual overview of current market dynamics and the future outlook for the AI compute industry.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章針對當前市場動態及 AI 算力產業的未來前景提供了概念性的概述。

articles.title: Prototyping with LLMs
articles.summary_en: The author reflects on the pitfalls of diving too quickly into LLM-based prototyping without proper planning. They argue that sketching ideas on paper before using AI can be a more efficient way to validate concepts and save time.
articles.summary_zh: 作者反思了在沒有適當規劃下就直接使用大型語言模型（LLM）進行原型設計的缺點。他們認為在動手操作 AI 之前，先透過草圖構思概念是一種更有效率且節省資源的驗證方式。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article uses the analogy of biblical building advice to illustrate the benefits of sketching over premature digital prototyping.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章運用了聖經中關於建造塔樓的比喻，來說明在進行數位原型設計前先進行草圖規劃的好處。

articles.title: I Tried Vibing an RSS Reader and My Dreams Did Not Come True
articles.summary_en: The author explores the potential and limitations of 'vibe coding,' using AI to build a custom RSS reader without deep technical knowledge. While the project successfully produced a functional tool, the author highlights the challenges of scaling AI-generated code and the eventual wall hit when the application complexity exceeds AI's assistance capabilities.
articles.summary_zh: 作者探討了「感覺編程」(vibe coding) 的可能性與局限性，嘗試利用 AI 在不具備深厚技術背景的情況下開發自定義 RSS 閱讀器。儘管該專案成功產出了實用工具，但作者也點出當應用程式複雜度超出 AI 的協助範圍時，開發便會面臨瓶頸與維護挑戰。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article functions as an anecdotal case study on the effectiveness and limitations of using AI for software development.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文作為一個軼事案例研究，探討了利用 AI 進行軟體開發的實際成效與局限性。

articles.title: The Cathedral and the Catacombs
articles.summary_en: The author critiques the long-standing 'Cathedral and the Bazaar' metaphor in software development, arguing that it ignores the 'catacombs'—the often-overlooked, complex dependency graphs that form the foundation of modern projects. The piece suggests that by focusing solely on governance and construction processes, developers and researchers fail to account for the risky, unmaintained, and invisible codebases that support their work.
articles.summary_zh: 作者批評了軟體開發中沿用已久的「大教堂與市集」隱喻，認為它忽略了「地下墓穴」——即構成現代專案基礎、卻常被忽視的複雜依賴關係圖。文章指出，現有的討論過於關注開發流程與治理，卻忽略了支撐專案的那些高風險、無人維護且隱形的底層程式碼。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual critique and expansion of an existing industry framework, offering a new theoretical lens through which to view software architecture.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文對既有的產業框架進行了概念性的批判與擴展，提供了一個觀察軟體架構的新理論視角。

articles.title: HIPAA compliant AI
articles.summary_en: The article suggests that running AI models locally on private hardware is the most effective method for maintaining HIPAA compliance when handling protected health information. While HIPAA-compliant cloud alternatives exist, they are often characterized as overly restrictive and costly.
articles.summary_zh: 本文建議在處理個人健康資訊（PHI）時，於本地設備運行 AI 模型是維持 HIPAA 合規性的最佳方式。雖然市面上存在符合 HIPAA 規範的雲端選項，但通常不僅費用高昂，且限制較多。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a specific recommendation and approach for achieving a technical objective (HIPAA compliance) through a practical workflow.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 本文針對如何達成技術目標（HIPAA 合規性）提供了具體的執行建議與實務方法。

articles.title: Learning to read C++ compiler errors: Illegal use of -> when there is no -> in sight
articles.summary_en: This post explains how to debug confusing C++ compiler errors by examining code you didn't write, such as headers or macros. It emphasizes that unexpected error messages often stem from hidden code being expanded during compilation.
articles.summary_zh: 這篇文章探討如何調試令人困惑的 C++ 編譯器錯誤，特別是針對非親手編寫的程式碼（如標頭檔或巨集）。文章強調，這些意外的錯誤訊息通常源於編譯過程中展開的隱藏程式碼。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides practical advice and a troubleshooting approach for developers to resolve specific compiler errors.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 這篇文章為開發人員解決特定的編譯器錯誤提供了實用的建議與故障排除方法。

articles.title: [RSS Club] Banana for scale
articles.summary_en: The author introduces a creative project called 'Scan Slowly And See' which uses a unique QR code generated by cloning patterns from a banana's skin. This playful experiment invites readers to test the functionality of the custom-coded graphic.
articles.summary_zh: 作者介紹了一個名為「Scan Slowly And See」的創意專案，利用香蕉皮上的斑點圖案生成獨特的 QR Code。這項有趣的實驗旨在邀請讀者測試該程式碼產生的圖形是否能成功掃描。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article describes the creation process of a specific project and provides a functional output for readers to interact with.
articles.pacer_reason_zh: 文章描述了特定專案的創作過程，並提供了可供讀者互動的功能性成果。

articles.title: Pluralistic: Your boss wants to use surveillance data to cut your wages (06 Apr 2026)
articles.source: Pluralistic: Daily links from Cory Doctorow
articles.summary_en: This article explores how companies use surveillance data to implement 'personalized pricing,' a strategy that allows businesses to extract maximum profit from consumers and devalue labor. The author argues that this practice, fueled by monopolies and regulatory capture, is a key component of 'enshittification' in the digital economy.
articles.summary_zh: 本文探討企業如何利用監控數據實施「個人化定價」，這種策略讓企業能從消費者身上榨取最高利潤，並貶低勞工價值。作者認為，在壟斷勢力與監管失能的推波助瀾下，這種行為已成為當代數位經濟「惡化」（enshittification）的核心要素。
articles.pacer_reason_en: The article provides a conceptual explanation of how surveillance-driven pricing impacts economic value and labor, framing it within the broader theory of enshittification.
